### **Your Task**

We are seeking a **Team Coordinator - German Language** to coordinate daily team operations and ensure smooth execution of HR processes and service requests. This role requires **6 to 9 years of experience** and candidates must have a **notice period of 0 to 30 days**. The Team Coordinator will act as the primary point of contact for German-speaking employees, stakeholders, and business partners.

* Coordinate daily team operations and ensure smooth execution of HR processes and service requests

* Handle HR queries and employee requests in German and English, ensuring timely and accurate resolution
* Monitor team workloads, track service levels (SLAs), and ensure adherence to quality standards and deadlines
* Support the preparation and maintenance of employment contracts, letters, certificates, and other HR-related documentation
* Maintain and update employee records in HR systems, ensuring data accuracy and compliance
* Identify process gaps, resolve operational issues, and escalate complex cases when necessary
* Prepare reports, analyze operational metrics, and provide regular updates to management
* Coordinate with internal departments and external agencies, including government authorities, insurance providers, and other stakeholders

* Support onboarding, offboarding, and other employee lifecycle activities

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field
* 6 to 9 years of experience
* 2-5 years of experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, Team Coordination, or Customer Service environments
* **Fluency in German (B2/C1 level or higher) is mandatory**
* **Fluency in English is mandatory**
* Strong German communication skills (written and verbal)
* Excellent coordination abilities
* Excellent stakeholder management abilities
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong multitasking skills
* Ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Problem-solving capabilities
* Decision-making capabilities
* High attention to detail and data accuracy
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Customer-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills

* Experience working with HRMS/ERP systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, or Oracle HCM
* Experience supporting international or European clients
* Experience in HR Shared Services or Global Business Services (GBS)
* Knowledge of German labor practices and HR processes
* Experience leading or coordinating small operational teams

**T-Systems Information and Communication Technology India Private Limited (T-Systems ICT India Pvt. Ltd.)** is a certified **Great Place To Work®**, proudly recognized for its strong people-first culture and commitment to employee excellence. As a wholly owned subsidiary of T-Systems International GmbH, T-Systems India operates out of Pune and Bangalore, with a dynamic team of over **4,200 professionals** delivering high-value IT services to group customers worldwide.

T-Systems India plays a key role in this global vision by delivering integrated, end-to-end IT solutions and sector-specific software to drive transformation across industries, including **automotive, manufacturing, logistics, transportation, healthcare, and the public sector**.

For over **25 years**, T-Systems International GmbH has been at the forefront of digital innovation, driving progress and fostering digital optimism. With a global workforce of **26,000 employees across 26 countries**, we set industry benchmarks in efficiency, sovereignty, security, and reliability—empowering organizations to unlock their full digital potential.

title: Senior Performance Lead
description:
**Organization:**  
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.

**Job Title:** Strategy & Business Management Lead

**Location:** Bengaluru, Manyata Tech Park

**Business & Team:** Office of CTO India. The role reports directly to the Engineering General Manager – Office of CTO India and works closely with India and global leadership teams to drive strategic priorities and business outcomes.

**Impact & Contribution:** As the Strategy & Business Management Lead, you will partner with India and global leadership to drive strategic priorities, operational excellence, brand equity, stakeholder alignment, and organisational effectiveness for the India entity. You will act as a trusted advisor and execution lead to accelerate business outcomes, strengthen governance, and enhance the entity’s internal and external brand.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**  
**Strategy Execution & Governance** – Partner with the CTO India and Leadership Teams to drive strategy execution, operating rhythms, governance, and business performance, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and measurable outcomes.
  
**Portfolio & Transformation Management** – Lead portfolio planning, prioritisation, and transformation oversight, managing dependencies and risks across strategic initiatives.
  
**Performance Management & Reporting** – Develop and manage executive dashboards, scorecards, OKRs, KPIs, and board-level reporting, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support decision-making.
  
**Technology Business Management** – Drive technology business management activities including budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, vendor governance, financial performance management, and cost optimisation initiatives.
  
**Leadership Engagement** – Establish and facilitate leadership forums, executive reviews, offsites, and stakeholder engagements, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and execution across business and technology functions.
  
**Strategic Partnership** – Act as a trusted advisor to the CTO, partnering with senior leaders across Technology, Finance, Risk, HR, Strategy and global leadership teams to improve organisational effectiveness, strengthen governance, and deliver sustainable business outcomes.

**Essential Skills:**

* 15+ years of experience in business management, strategy, business analysis, and process improvement within large-scale technology organisations, with experience in a global bank.

* Proven experience supporting leadership at an Executive level in driving strategic planning, execution governance, and organisational transformation.

* Experience leading large-scale technology or business transformation programmes in complex, matrix organisations.

* Demonstrated ability to develop and operationalise technology strategies, annual operating plans (AOPs), OKRs, roadmaps, and business performance frameworks.

* Experience in portfolio management, prioritisation, investment planning, and strategic resource allocation.

* Experience developing executive-level dashboards, balanced scorecards, KPI frameworks, and performance reporting for senior leadership teams and boards.

* Ability to facilitate executive workshops, strategic planning sessions, leadership offsites, and decision-making forums.

* Experience coordinating leadership team cadences for the CTO and relevant initiatives.

* Experience working in Agile environments with the ability to translate strategy into executable initiatives, user stories, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and insights to shape business and technology strategy.

* Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders across Technology, Product, Finance, Risk, HR, Procurement, and Enterprise Strategy functions.

* Ability to influence senior executives and drive outcomes through collaboration rather than authority.

* Experience working across global teams and geographies to align strategic priorities and execution outcomes.

* Ability to act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the CTO and the wider Technology Leadership Team.

* Ability to work as a liaison between technology strategy and business management teams in CBA India and CTO Global.

* Strong communication, storytelling, and executive presentation skills, with experience preparing materials for executive committees, boards, and regulatory reviews.

Demonstrated ability to drive organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, talent strategy, and succession planning.  



**Education Qualification:** Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree.

title: Consultant, Coupa Core & Procurement Technology
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Consultant, BPA will support Northern Trust’s Coupa Spend Management platform, with primary responsibility for day-to-day application support, configuration, maintenance, testing, and continuous improvement of Coupa Core capabilities.

The role will work closely with Procurement, Finance, Technology and other business stakeholders to support stable and effective procure-to-pay processes. The individual will investigate application issues, support business users, maintain system configurations, participate in testing and implementation of enhancements, and assist with Coupa releases and integrations.

The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with both business and technology teams in a global environment.

**Major Duties**
----------------

* Provide day-to-day functional and application support for **Coupa Core**, with emphasis on Procure-to-Pay processes.
* Investigate and resolve production issues and user-reported incidents, including performing root-cause analysis and coordinating resolution with appropriate business, technology, and vendor teams.
* Configure and maintain Coupa functionalities such as users, roles and permissions, approval workflows, content groups, account groups, chart of accounts, custom fields, submission blockers and warnings.
* Support purchasing and invoicing processes, including requisitions, purchase orders, catalogs, supplier-related activities and invoice processing.
* Support Coupa integrations with ERP and other enterprise applications, including investigation of integration errors and coordination of issue resolution.
* Assist with configuration and implementation of approved system enhancements and business requirements.
* Participate in requirements gathering and translate business requirements into functional system changes.
* Prepare and execute functional testing, regression testing and user acceptance testing for system changes, enhancements and Coupa releases.
* Support quarterly Coupa release activities, including impact assessment, validation and regression testing.
* Maintain application documentation, standard operating procedures, configuration documentation, test evidence and user support materials.
* Provide guidance and support to Coupa users and assist with user training and knowledge transfer.
* Monitor recurring application issues and identify opportunities to improve system stability, support processes and user experience.
* Follow established change management, access management, security, risk and control procedures.
* Collaborate with global Procurement and Technology teams to support departmental priorities and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Knowledge**
-------------

* Working knowledge of **Coupa Spend Management**, particularly Coupa Core and Procure-to-Pay processes.
* Understanding of procurement processes, including requisitioning, purchasing, purchase orders, supplier management and invoicing.
* Knowledge of Coupa configuration concepts including approval workflows, user access, roles and permissions, content groups, account structures and custom fields.
* Understanding of application support and incident management principles.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle concepts, including requirements, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
* Understanding of system integrations and data flows between Coupa and ERP or other enterprise applications.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to document system processes and communicate technical concepts to business users.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively within a global team.

**Experience**
--------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant qualification.
* Relevant experience supporting procurement technology, enterprise applications, Procure-to-Pay platforms or related business systems.
* Hands-on Coupa experience, particularly Coupa Core / Procure-to-Pay.
* Experience with production support, incident investigation, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
* Experience with application configuration, functional testing and user acceptance testing.
* Experience working with business and technology stakeholders in a global organization.
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar incident/change management tools preferred.
* Coupa certification or relevant Coupa training preferred.
* Experience supporting Coupa integrations with ERP platforms such as SAP, PeopleSoft or Workday preferred.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: TechOps-SAP-AMS-SAP Commissions Senior
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 29, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752582

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Senior SAP Commissions Solution Architect (Callidus Cloud Finance) – TechOps SAP**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an Senior SAP Commissions Solution Architect (Callidus Cloud Finance) to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP Commissions in Life Insurance domain handling commissions and compensations across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high-quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 6-7 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP Commissions (Finance Life Insurance Background) preferably with Global client.
* Lead architecture and delivery of SAP Commissions (Callidus Cloud) solutions for Life Insurance commission and incentive calculations. (Commissions and Compensations)
* Design end-to-end commission and finance integration processes.
* Drive SAP S/4HANA RISE transformation initiatives and SAP Finance integration.
* Partner with business, actuarial, finance and operations stakeholders.
* Provide solution governance, design reviews and production support leadership.
* Mentor teams and establish solution standards.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have following Skillset:**

* Well versed with FICO module – In Insurance domain with Commissions and Compensations.
* With the criteria below:
  + 10+ years of SAP experience with 7+ years in SAP Commissions/Callidus Cloud.
  + Strong expertise in commission calculations, incentive compensation and reconciliation.
  + Deep SAP Finance background (FI/CO, GL, AP, AR).
  + Architect-level experience in SAP Commissions and SAP S/4HANA on RISE.
  + Experience integrating SAP Commissions with S/4HANA and enterprise platforms.
  + Mandatory Life Insurance industry experience.
  + Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in FI integration points with other SAP modules like MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
* SAP Certification in SAP FICO is added advantage.

  

**What will you do:**

Provide day-to-day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist

Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.

Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP Finance - Commissions solutions and designs.

Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.

Mentor and train junior SAP FICO Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.

Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation

Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.

Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)

  

**What we look for**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
* Preferred Skills – S/4 Finance and Group Reporting (GR),SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, Central Finance, SAP BPC, Fiori.

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodation you may need.

**Our Commitment:** As a commitment, we persistently Endeavor to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

**Professional Development:** From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

**People and Culture:** In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**Benefits:** Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

**How to Apply:** If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

Job Description – Information Security Awareness Training Specialist (KnowBe4)
  
  
Position Title
  
  
Information Security Awareness Training Specialist (KnowBe4 Administrator)
  
  
Position Location
  
  
India Remote
  
  
Position Level
  
  
L2 (Band 7)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Information Security Awareness Training Specialist is responsible for planning, administering, and continuously improving the organization's security awareness program using the KnowBe4 Security Awareness Training platform. The role focuses on building a strong security culture by delivering engaging training, conducting phishing simulations, measuring user behavior, and reporting program effectiveness to management. The specialist works closely with Information Security, HR, Compliance, Privacy, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure employees understand and comply with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Security Awareness Program Management
  

* Develop and execute the annual Information Security Awareness and Training Plan.
* Administer the KnowBe4 platform, including user provisioning, campaign scheduling, and content management.
* Design role-based awareness programs for employees, contractors, privileged users, executives, and third parties.
* Maintain the security awareness calendar aligned with business initiatives and regulatory requirements.
* Continuously improve awareness content based on emerging cyber threats and organizational risk.

KnowBe4 Administration
  

* Configure and maintain KnowBe4 campaigns, learning paths, and automated enrollment.
* Schedule and manage mandatory security awareness training assignments.
* Configure phishing simulation campaigns with varying difficulty levels.
* Maintain user groups, Smart Groups, and automated training workflows.
* Manage platform settings, integrations, notifications, and reporting dashboards.
* Coordinate platform updates and adoption of new KnowBe4 features.

Phishing Simulation User Behaviour Management
  

* Design and execute phishing simulations across the organization.
* Monitor phishing susceptibility, reporting rates, and repeat offender trends.
* Conduct remedial training for users who fail phishing simulations.
* Analyze campaign outcomes and recommend targeted awareness initiatives.
* Measure improvements in user behaviour through defined KPIs and metrics.

Content Development Communications
  

* Develop awareness communications, newsletters, security advisories, posters, and intranet content.
* Deliver security awareness sessions, webinars, workshops, and onboarding training.
* Promote cybersecurity campaigns during Cybersecurity Awareness Month and other organizational initiatives.
* Customize awareness content to address organization-specific risks and recent security incidents.
* Collaborate with communications and HR teams to maximize employee engagement.

Compliance Governance
  

* Ensure awareness activities support ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, PCI DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, DPDP Act, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain records of training completion and audit evidence.
* Support internal and external audits by providing awareness program documentation and reports.
* Review awareness policies, standards, and procedures periodically.

Reporting Metrics
  

* Generate monthly and quarterly management reports from KnowBe4.
* Track key metrics including:
* Training completion rates
* Phishing failure rates
* Repeat click rates
* Credential submission rates
* Reported phishing emails
* User risk scores
* Campaign participation
* Present awareness program effectiveness and improvement recommendations to management.
* Maintain KPI and KRI dashboards.

Stakeholder Collaboration
  

* Coordinate with HR for new hire onboarding and mandatory training.
* Work with IT teams to integrate KnowBe4 with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft 365, or Google Workspace.
* Partner with Incident Response teams to develop awareness based on security incidents.
* Support business units with targeted awareness initiatives.

Continuous Improvement
  

* Evaluate awareness effectiveness using industry benchmarks and user feedback.
* Recommend enhancements to awareness campaigns, phishing scenarios, and training content.
* Stay current with emerging cyber threats, phishing techniques, and awareness best practices.

Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in Information Security Awareness, Security Governance, Risk Compliance (GRC), or Information Security.
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience administering the KnowBe4 Security Awareness platform.

Required Technical Skills
  
  
Security Awareness Platforms
  

* KnowBe4 Security Awareness Training
* KnowBe4 PhishER (preferred)
* KnowBe4 Phish Alert Button
* Learning Management Systems (LMS)

Information Security
  

* Security Awareness Program Management
* Phishing Simulation
* Security Culture Development
* Social Engineering Awareness
* Email Security
* Information Security Policies
* Cyber Hygiene Best Practices

**About the team:**

**About the role:** Yes — then the role should be positioned as **Global Benefits Operations**, not Europe-focused. I would change the scope throughout the JD to explicitly cover **EMEA, North America, APAC and Africa**.

### **Revised Purpose of Role**

The **Junior Manager – Global Benefits Operations** will be responsible for the effective delivery, governance and continuous improvement of employee benefits administration across **EMEA, North America (NAM), APAC and Africa**.

The role will manage critical benefits operations including **benefits enrolment, annual enrolment, vendor management, Purchase Order creation and management, invoice validation and reconciliation, benefits reporting, employee query management and operational controls**.

Working closely with Global Reward, Payroll, HR, Finance, Procurement and external benefit providers, the role will ensure employees are enrolled accurately and on time, vendors deliver against agreed service levels, and benefit-related financial transactions are appropriately controlled and reconciled.

A key objective will be to **standardise and simplify benefits processes across regions**, while recognising market-specific regulatory, vendor and operational requirements.

### **Core Accountabilities**

* **Benefits Enrolment:** Manage and govern employee benefits enrolment across **EMEA, NAM, APAC and Africa**, including new joiners, life events, benefit changes and leavers.
* **Annual Enrolment:** Coordinate end-to-end annual enrolment activities across applicable markets, including planning, vendor readiness, employee data validation, communications, enrolment monitoring, issue resolution and post-enrolment reconciliation.
* **Vendor Management:** Manage operational relationships with global and local benefit providers, including **SLA/KPI monitoring, issue resolution, service reviews, escalations and continuous improvement**.
* **PO Management:** Coordinate **Purchase Order creation, amendments, extensions and funding requirements** for benefit vendors, ensuring appropriate financial governance and timely availability of POs.
* **Invoice Management & Reconciliation:** Validate vendor invoices against **employee eligibility, enrolment records, contractual rates and POs**, resolve discrepancies and ensure timely payment.
* **Financial Controls & Governance:** Perform required **CARM controls, reconciliations and governance activities**, ensuring appropriate evidence and timely resolution of exceptions.
* **Data & Reporting:** Reconcile benefit data across **Workday, payroll, vendor platforms and financial records**, and deliver accurate operational and management reporting.
* **Employee Experience:** Ensure benefits queries are resolved accurately and within SLA and that employees receive clear communications relating to eligibility, enrolment and benefit changes.
* **Process Governance:** Maintain and regularly update **Work Instructions, process maps, Benefits Matrices, Benefit Guides, Factsheets and FAQs** across markets.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to **simplify, standardise and automate** benefits administration and reduce manual intervention, errors and employee queries.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Partner effectively with **Reward, Payroll, HR, Finance, Procurement and external vendors** across multiple regions, markets and time zones.

### **Experience Required**

I would make the essential experience more specific:

**Strong hands-on experience in Benefits Operations**, preferably supporting multiple countries or regions, with demonstrated experience in **benefits enrolment and annual enrolment, vendor management, Purchase Order management, invoice** **validation/reconciliation** **and employee benefits administration**.

Candidates should also demonstrate experience working across **multiple regions/time zones**, ideally including exposure to **EMEA, NAM, APAC and/or Africa**, and be comfortable managing both global vendors and market-specific providers.

Strong experience with **Workday, Excel, benefits data reconciliation, operational controls, reporting and process documentation** should be preferred. The role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical capability, attention to detail and the ability to independently drive operational issues through to closure.

title: Compensation Senior Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 391674
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Compensation Senior Specialist Advisor to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
Role Purpose
  

* Work closely with People Culture, Total Rewards colleagues, and business stakeholders to support the full Total Rewards lifecycle across a complex organization, supporting sustainable growth through competitive, compliant, inclusive, and scalable reward solutions.
* Guide and support Total Rewards activity for an assigned portfolio within NTT DATA Inc., including implementation and governance of the company pay philosophy, reward policies, pay programs, and related decision frameworks.
* Manage Performance Development for the assigned portfolio, partnering with People Culture and business leaders to enable goal setting, quality conversations, evidence-based feedback, and effective year-end outcomes that support a great employee experience.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Compensation Strategy Programs
  

* Support the planning, governance, and execution of compensation processes, including:
* annual compensation review cycles and salary planning
* bonus calculations and short-term and long-term incentive programs
* variable bonus program changes
* benchmarking, market pricing, and salary survey participation
* job evaluation, job architecture, and grading
* salary structures, salary increase budgets, and salary structure movement recommendations
* pay governance, compensation policies, and remuneration program documentation
* Support the evolution of an aligned compensation framework that enables consistency, transparency, competitiveness, and scalability across the organization.
* Ensure compensation programs align with the company reward philosophy, business strategy, workforce planning priorities, attraction and retention needs, and financial objectives.
* Monitor salary structures and recommend actions that balance cost control, affordability, internal equity, market competitiveness, and employee attraction and retention.
* Partner within the broader Total Rewards CoE to design, build, test, validate, and continuously improve pay ranges and salary structures, using market data, internal equity, affordability, and employee experience considerations.
* Analyze remuneration data, trends, cost implications, and cost-containment opportunities to inform business decisions and reward program design.
* Drive continuous enhancement of compensation structures, methodologies, and processes to improve effectiveness and employee experience.

Recognition Strategy Employee Value Proposition
  

* Partner in the development and implementation of global recognition programs that reinforce company values, high-performance culture, and employee engagement.
* Ensure recognition initiatives are scalable, inclusive, and aligned with organizational culture and talent priorities.
* Evaluate recognition program effectiveness using participation, engagement, and impact metrics.

Business Partnership Stakeholder Management
  

* Model NTT DATA values in how work is delivered: actively seek and respect diverse perspectives, create space for constructive challenge, and ensure stakeholders feel heard and included in reward decisions.
* Collaborate across the Total Rewards CoE and broader People Culture organization, sharing expertise, solving problems collectively, and prioritizing enterprise outcomes over functional or individual ownership.
* Think big and be bold by challenging established approaches, using data and insight to test new ideas, and translating innovative reward concepts into practical, scalable solutions.
* Partner closely with the broader Total Rewards CoE and People Culture Business Partners to deliver solutions that balance enterprise consistency with market and business needs.
* Consult with and advise People Culture teams and business leaders on reward and remuneration policy interpretation, new hire offers, promotions, salary adjustments, market analysis, job evaluation, and other reward initiatives.
* Support Performance Development for the assigned portfolio, including process planning, stakeholder enablement, adoption tracking, quality conversations, evidence-based feedback, and leader guidance.
* Review proposed salary adjustments for conformance with established guidelines and recommend corrective or alternative actions to resolve compensation-related issues.
* Build strong, collaborative relationships with Finance, IT, Legal, Payroll, People Culture, Total Rewards colleagues, and business stakeholders to ensure effective delivery and governance of reward programs.
* Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on compensation-related matters including pay decisions, incentive design, job evaluations, market competitiveness, and remuneration governance.

Job Evaluation, Benchmarking Analytics
  

* When required, conduct job evaluation and salary benchmarking in partnership with Total Rewards colleagues and internal stakeholders to support internal equity and external competitiveness.
* Interpret compensation surveys to understand the company competitive position across relevant labor markets.
* Extract and validate data required to compile weekly, monthly, and annual reporting, including remuneration analysis, cost modelling, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare clear insights, recommendations, and documentation to support reward decisions, governance forums, audit requirements, and stakeholder communications.

Governance, Compliance Operational Excellence
  

* Ensure reward programs comply with applicable legislation, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards.
* Maintain robust governance frameworks, controls, documentation, and audit trails across reward processes.
* Support efforts to improve operational efficiency, automation, and process simplification across compensation and recognition activities.
* Collaborate with HR technology teams to optimize reward tools, systems, reporting, and data integrity.
* Administer or support reward and remuneration programs as required.

Transformation Change
  

* Support organizational transformation initiatives, including MA integration, organizational redesign, and harmonization of legacy reward programs.
* Lead or contribute to enterprise reward projects focused on modernization, digital enablement, process standardization, and scalable policy implementation.
* Develop communication materials, training, and change management plans to support successful adoption of reward initiatives.

Qualifications Experience
  

* 8-10+ years of progressive experience in compensation, remuneration, and Total Rewards within complex, multinational organizations.
* Strong expertise in compensation strategy, salary structures, incentive design, variable pay, benchmarking, job evaluation, job architecture, grading, and pay governance.
* Demonstrated experience executing annual compensation review cycles, bonus calculations, salary planning, and complex reward projects.
* Experience supporting Performance Development processes, including goal setting, manager enablement, evidence-based feedback, and year-end conversations.
* Strong analytical capability with experience interpreting market data, remuneration trends, compensation analytics, cost impacts, and salary survey outputs.
* Knowledge of compensation and benefits regulations, pay transparency trends, pay equity practices, audit requirements, and compliance processes across multiple jurisdictions.
* Experience supporting employee recognition programs within a complex organizational environment.
* Experience working in transformation, integration, or high-growth environments is highly desirable.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, and organizational levels.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex reward concepts into practical business insights and clear recommendations.
* Experience with HRIS and compensation management tools (e.g., Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar platforms).
* Bachelor degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or related discipline preferred.
* Demonstrated behaviors aligned to NTT DATA values, including Respect Every Voice, strong collaboration and teamwork, and the courage to Think Big. Be Bold.
* Professional certifications (e.g., WorldatWork CCP/GRP or equivalent) are advantageous.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Summary**  
We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect - Data to provide architectural leadership across enterprise data, reporting, and analytics initiatives. The role will define scalable solutions across data platforms, integration services, semantic models, and business intelligence while ensuring security, governance, performance, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution and data architecture, including target-state designs, conceptual and logical data models, integration patterns, data flows, security controls, lineage, and technology standards.
* Partner with enterprise architects and governance teams to guide solutions through Permit to Design, Permit to Build, and Permit to Operate, ensuring design, security, risk, infrastructure, support, and operational-readiness requirements are addressed.
* Define scalable engineering and integration patterns across Snowflake, cloud platforms, APIs, batch processing, and event-driven services, balancing resilience, performance, security, and cost.
* Own reporting and analytics architecture, including Performance Reporting, Client Reporting, Power BI, and semantic models. Establish standards for Import, DirectQuery, hybrid models, aggregation, incremental refresh, caching, and query optimization.
* Lead resolution of complex performance issues across source systems, data platforms, transformations, calculation layers, semantic models, and Power BI.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for performance, scalability, availability, resilience, data freshness, observability, security, supportability, and cost.
* Establish reusable patterns for data modeling, metadata, lineage, data quality, auditability, governance, and access control to reduce technical debt.
* Provide architectural leadership across client, account, product, legal agreement, performance, benchmark, reference, and other strategic data domains.
* Act as a senior design authority by reviewing solutions, challenging technical choices, identifying risks and dependencies, mentoring teams, and communicating decisions to business and technology stakeholders.
* Maintain concise architecture deliverables, including diagrams, data models, integration flows, architecture decisions, deployment views, and operational-readiness documentation.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms and data-driven applications.
* Deep expertise in Snowflake, data warehousing, relational and dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT, metadata, lineage, data quality, and audit controls.
* Strong experience with Power BI architecture, semantic models, DAX, Import and DirectQuery patterns, incremental refresh, aggregation, and performance optimization.
* Experience diagnosing performance across SQL, transformation, semantic, and visualization layers.
* Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, services, batch and event-driven integration, security, observability, and operational resilience.
* Proven ability to define target-state architecture, reusable technical patterns, roadmaps, and measurable non-functional requirements.
* Strong technical leadership, stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Technical Skills**

* **Data & Analytics:** Snowflake, advanced SQL, Power BI, semantic modeling, DAX, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, data modeling, performance optimization, metadata, lineage, and data quality.
* **Cloud & Integration:** Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, REST APIs, microservices, batch and event-driven integration, security, Key Vault/secrets management, observability, and resiliency patterns.
* **Application Engineering:** Python, FastAPI or similar service frameworks, React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and modern application architecture patterns.
* **Architecture & Governance:** Solution and data architecture, architecture lifecycle governance including Permit to Design, Permit to Build, and Permit to Operate, non-functional requirements, security architecture, operational readiness, and architecture decision records.
* **Engineering Practices:** CI/CD, DevSecOps, source control, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code concepts, production supportability, and performance monitoring.
* **Leadership:** Architecture reviews, design authority, technical roadmaps, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and collaboration across engineering, security, infrastructure, data governance, and enterprise architecture teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Investment management, asset management, financial services, or another highly governed data environment.
* Performance and client reporting, benchmark and reference data, account and client hierarchies, and legal-entity or agreement data.
* Modernization of legacy reporting and analytics solutions, architecture governance, data catalogs, business glossaries, and regulatory reporting.
* Applied knowledge of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and modern analytics within established security and governance standards.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Application Engineer- Intelligent Operations (10-20 yrs.), Location- Devanahalli Campus (Bangalore)
description:
**Company Description**

Work in SAP's global development ecosystem where expertise is valued. You will collaborate across regions, share insights, and contribute to shaping industry-leading practices.

 **Job Description**

You will design and deliver complex features, resolve critical issues, and set standards for development excellence. You will influence architecture and mentor across teams.

Intelligent Operations | CIS FDE Technology & Operations

"We support and guardrail AI forward deployed engineering engagements across SAP industries — ensuring quality, security and lasting impact."

What you’ll bring

You know what it takes to keep AI-native solutions running in production — not in a lab, but in customer environments where uptime, data boundaries, and contractual SLAs are non-negotiable. You’ve worked hands-on with LLM-based systems, agentic workflows, and distributed architectures, and you understand that building something is only half the job — the other half is making sure it stays healthy after go-live.

You bring deep experience in observability, incident management, and production reliability across cloud environments. You can spot drift in agentic application behavior before it becomes a customer escalation. You’ve operated in regulated or enterprise-grade settings where compliance, security posture, and operational governance aren’t optional. And you can translate that experience into standards, playbooks, and repeatable processes that a growing team can follow.

You’re comfortable working across organizational boundaries — with delivery squads, engineering/ platform teams, and customers/ external partners — and you can hold your ground in a room full of architects who built the thing you now need to run.

What you’ll build

You’re building Intelligent Operations from the ground up. This capability doesn’t exist at scale yet — you’ll define how it works.

Concretely, that means:

**Handover model:** Take care of what “production-ready” looks like when an FDE engagement transitions from Value Delivery to Value Operation. You own the handover framework — what needs to be in place before your team takes over.

**Run-team operations:** Build the monitoring, alerting, and incident response capability for deployed AI solutions. Ensure contractual SLA commitments are met — not by heroics, but by design.

**AI quality in production:** Drift detection, performance benchmarking, guardrails validation, retraining triggers. The solutions we deploy use LLMs and agents — production quality assurance looks fundamentally different here than in classical software.

**Operational governance:** Establish best practices for production security, data boundaries, and compliance across customer engagements. Work with other engineers to ensure the enterprise bar holds post-deployment and establish self-healing capabilities.

**Scalable operations:** What works for one customer engagement needs to work for fifty. You’ll design the operational model to scale — tooling, automation, partner integration — so that every new go-live doesn’t require reinventing the wheel.

You’ll work closely with the Knowledge & IP team to capture operational learnings and feed them back into the delivery lifecycle, so the next collaboration starts stronger.

Where you belong

T&O is the engineering backbone of CIS Forward Deployed Engineering. Our mission: ensure quality, security, and lasting impact across AI engagements for SAP’s industry customers.

You’ll sit in the Intelligent Operations pillar — the part of T&O that owns what happens after go-live. Deployed solutions stay healthy and improve. That’s the mandate.

In this role, you’ll mentor engineers, set operational standards, and build the technical capabilities of a team that’s being assembled now. You’ll work globally, across FDE squads and hubs, with external delivery partners, and directly with customers when production demands it.

If you’ve spent your career at the intersection of SRE, AI systems, and enterprise operations — and you want to build something new rather than maintain something existing — this is the role.

Join SAP's senior engineering network, collaborating globally and shaping standards that elevate platform engineering practices worldwide.

SAP AI Product & Engineering is a key driver of the Autonomous Enterprise, bringing AI capabilities to enterprise applications and helping customers unlock the value of their business data. ● Experience working with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server) and writing

● Familiarity or foundational knowledge of modern healthcare data standards,

title: Assistant Manager - Global Benefits Operations
description:
**Job Description :**

**Context and scope**
=====================

Global Benefits Operations delivers benefits administration through consistent processes, reliable data, effective controls and responsive employee support. The Assistant Manager leads the assigned team across markets and time zones, translating approved benefit policies into accurate, timely and controlled operational delivery.

The scope includes annual benefit enrolment, joiner, mover and leaver administration, vendor data exchanges, purchase orders, invoice reconciliation, reporting and query management. Benefits may include health insurance, pensions, product allowances, car benefits and other locally approved arrangements, where assigned to the team.

**Purpose of the role**
=======================

Own the day-to-day performance of the assigned benefits operations service, protecting employee benefit continuity and financial accuracy. Build a capable team, resolve operational escalations and improve processes through standardisation, simplification and automation in line with the global payroll and benefits strategy.

**Financial responsibilities**
==============================

  

* Manage benefits purchase order creation, invoice validation and reconciliation within procurement requirements and delegated authority; coordinate timely payment with Finance and Accounts Payable.
* Reconcile vendor charges to approved rates, eligibility and enrolment data. Investigate discrepancies, recover or correct errors and escalate unresolved liabilities before service continuity is affected.
* Monitor assigned operational costs and spend against approved plans; provide variance insights and identify measurable efficiency opportunities.

**Market complexity**
=====================

  

* Lead service delivery across the assigned markets, accommodating local benefit rules, enrolment calendars, currencies, languages, vendor arrangements and time zones.
* Coordinate accurate and timely joiner, mover and leaver data and benefit changes across Workday, benefit platforms, vendors and Payroll. Validate payroll-impacting deductions, allowances and taxable benefit inputs within agreed cut-offs.
* Partner with Reward, market HR, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, Tax and Digital teams to resolve dependencies and clarify ownership at process hand-offs.
* Implement approved policy and regulatory changes with guidance from Reward, HR, Tax and Legal; maintain market-specific procedures and operational evidence.
* Manage sensitive employee data through approved access, transfer and retention controls. Maintain service continuity during peak enrolment, organisational changes and vendor or system transitions.

**Leadership responsibilities and capabilities**
================================================

  

* Lead Benefits Junior Managers and Case Specialists with clear accountabilities, work allocation, performance expectations and escalation routes.
* Plan capacity for routine activity and peak cycles; establish trained backups, maintain knowledge coverage and address capability gaps through coaching and development.
* Review service performance, aged cases, control exceptions and recurring failures. Hold team members and partners accountable for corrective actions and sustained results.
* Make timely operational decisions within delegated authority. Escalate material employee, financial, compliance and service risks with clear impact, options and recommended action.
* Build constructive relationships across functions and vendors; challenge missed commitments and resolve issues through evidence and clear ownership.
* Create an inclusive team environment where colleagues raise concerns early, learn from errors and take responsibility for employee outcomes.
* Deliver improvements with the Process Excellence and Transformation teams, ensuring implementation readiness, control integrity and measurable benefits.

**Decision rights and governance**
==================================

The role owns operational work allocation, quality assurance, service escalations and improvement delivery within the agreed scope. Approvals for expenditure, benefit changes and vendor commitments must follow delegated authority. Reward and market HR retain benefit policy and plan design decisions; Tax and Legal provide specialist interpretation. Vendor governance, including pensions, follows the agreed ownership model for each market.

**Top five accountabilities**
=============================

1. Benefits service delivery and employee experience

  

* Own accurate and timely delivery of assigned benefits administration, reporting, vendor data exchanges and annual enrolment activities against agreed service levels and calendars.
* Manage complex cases and escalations, prioritising employee impact and benefit continuity. Ensure timely updates, clear resolution ownership and follow-through.
* Maintain readiness plans for peak cycles, absence cover and service disruption; resolve upstream dependencies before deadlines are missed.

**2. Financial control compliance and assurance**
-------------------------------------------------

* Ensure assigned CARM controls, reconciliations and quality checks are performed, evidenced and independently reviewed in line with control design.
* Oversee purchase orders, vendor invoices and reconciliation exceptions, maintaining clear audit trails and appropriate segregation of duties.
* Coordinate audit requests and close findings; investigate control failures, implement root-cause actions and escalate material risks promptly.

**3. Vendor and stakeholder management**
----------------------------------------

  

* Manage operational performance of assigned benefits vendors through service reviews, action tracking and escalation of missed commitments.
* Work with Finance, Procurement and vendor owners to resolve billing and payment issues; support renewal and service improvement discussions with performance evidence.
* Agree responsibilities and cut-offs with Reward, HR and Payroll, ensuring unresolved issues have a named owner and escalation route.

**4. Digital enablement and process excellence**
------------------------------------------------

  

* Maintain accurate process maps, work instructions, benefits matrices, guides, factsheets and FAQs; ensure changes are approved, communicated and supported by training.
* Use Workday, benefits platforms and case management tools to improve data quality, reporting and workflow visibility.
* Deliver prioritised standardisation and automation initiatives with relevant partners, validating employee outcomes, controls and realised efficiency.

**5. Team leadership and capability building**
----------------------------------------------

  

* Set individual objectives, review performance and coach the team in benefits administration, financial controls, problem-solving and stakeholder communication.
* Maintain skills assessments, training plans and backup coverage for critical processes; address underperformance with clear expectations and support.
* Embed ownership, respectful challenge and continuous learning; ensure delivery quality is sustained during staffing and scope changes.

**Measures of success**
=======================

Performance will be assessed against agreed annual targets for service accuracy, timeliness and case SLAs; enrolment and benefit continuity; invoice and reconciliation completion; control execution and audit closure; vendor performance; backup coverage; and verified improvement benefits.

**Core skills required**
========================

  

* Benefits operations expertise – understand eligibility, enrolment, lifecycle changes and links to payroll, finance and employee experience.
* People leadership – plan work, coach colleagues, manage performance and build capability and backup coverage.
* Stakeholder management and communication – explain issues clearly, manage expectations and influence resolution across markets and functions.
* Analytical problem-solving and business acumen – investigate data and cost discrepancies, assess employee and financial impact and act on root causes.
* Governance and ethical judgement – apply controls, protect confidentiality and make proportionate decisions within delegated authority.
* Change agility and resilience – maintain operational discipline through competing priorities, peak cycles and process changes.

**Digital and technical skills required**
=========================================

  

* Practical experience with Workday or comparable HRIS, benefits administration platforms and case management systems.
* Advanced Excel capability, including formulas, pivot tables and reconciliation of data from multiple sources.
* Working knowledge of purchase order and invoice workflows, vendor reconciliation, access controls and secure employee data handling.
* Ability to produce service dashboards, maintain process documentation and validate interfaces and payroll-impacting benefit data.

**Advanced skills preferred**
=============================

  

* Exposure to European and multi-country benefits administration, including insurance and pensions operations.
* Experience with workflow automation, Power BI or equivalent reporting tools and structured process improvement methods.
* Experience supporting annual enrolment, vendor transitions, system changes or shared services transformation.

**Qualifications and experience required**
==========================================

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Typically 8–10 years of progressive experience in benefits, HR operations or related payroll service delivery, including at least 2 years of team supervision or operational leadership.
* Demonstrated experience in benefits administration, vendor coordination, financial reconciliations and control execution in a multi-country or shared services environment.
* Proven ability to lead a team, resolve complex operational issues and deliver measurable service or process improvements.
* Strong analytical capability, attention to detail and professional English communication. Payroll knowledge and relevant HR, benefits or process improvement qualifications are advantageous.

**Barriers to success in the role**
===================================

  

* Managing activity without taking ownership of employee outcomes, deadlines and unresolved exceptions.
* Weak capacity planning, insufficient backup coverage or failure to address capability and performance gaps.
* Late escalation of benefit interruptions, billing discrepancies, control failures or vendor issues.
* Inaccurate data, incomplete reconciliations or weak documentation and audit evidence.
* Poor collaboration across Reward, HR, Payroll, Finance and vendors, leaving process hand-offs unowned.
* Resistance to simplification, or implementing changes without validating operational readiness and controls.
* Discouraging constructive challenge, withholding concerns or disengaging when decisions are made.

**Flexible working statement**
==============================

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you are supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. Working arrangements should support the agreed service model, market time zones and critical benefits delivery periods.

**Diversity statement**
=======================

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. Creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued and belongs is central to this purpose. We welcome people of different genders, ethnicities, abilities, ages, sexual orientations, social backgrounds, educational backgrounds and experiences. The role holder will help build a team that values different perspectives, provides equitable development opportunities and delivers respectful service to employees across our markets.

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

title: Digital Content Author & Publisher
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Specialist, Digital Content Author & Publisher will create, update, validate, schedule, and publish web content using Adobe Experience Manager and related digital tools. The role combines hands-on content production with publishing operations, quality assurance, governance support, and optimization discipline. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a structured, regulated environment where accuracy, accessibility, metadata, approvals, documentation, and first-time-right execution are essential to delivering a trusted digital experience.

**What This Role Owns**
-----------------------

* **Authoring and publishing execution:** Build, update, schedule, publish, and unpublish web pages and digital assets using AEM templates, components, content fragments, experience fragments, workflows, and approved publishing processes.
* **Publishing operations:** Support intake validation, request coordination, status tracking, release readiness, post-publish checks, content lifecycle updates, and recurring website maintenance.
* **Quality and compliance:** Apply brand, editorial, legal, regulatory, accessibility, metadata, and SEO standards before content moves live.
* **Operational documentation:** Maintain publishing logs, authoring instructions, page records, issue notes, and standard operating procedure updates to strengthen repeatability and reduce key-person dependency.
* **Optimization support:** Use analytics, site-health observations, SEO inputs, accessibility checks, and stakeholder feedback to identify practical improvements to content structure, findability, usability, and page performance.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Create, edit, format, schedule, publish, and maintain content across Northern Trust’s enterprise web properties using Adobe Experience Manager and related publishing tools.
* Build pages from approved requirements, content, designs, wireframes, templates, component guidance, and digital experience standards.
* Upload, organize, tag, and maintain digital assets, including images, documents, videos, PDFs, disclosures, and supporting media within AEM Assets or other approved repositories.
* Apply required metadata, page titles, descriptions, alt text, tagging, structured content guidance, internal linking, and SEO fundamentals to support discoverability and content quality.
* Perform pre-publish and post-publish quality checks for content accuracy, responsive display, link functionality, asset rendering, accessibility, metadata, and component consistency.
* Support content lifecycle management by updating, retiring, replacing, or escalating outdated content and ensuring published pages remain current and aligned to business requirements.
* Coordinate with marketing, content, UX, design, SEO, accessibility, analytics, compliance, legal, technology, and regional stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver work through approved workflows.
* Track assigned work, publishing status, issues, dependencies, and approvals using tools such as Workfront, Confluence, SharePoint, or comparable workflow platforms.
* Identify recurring publishing, component, content, asset, metadata, or workflow issues and escalate them with clear documentation, examples, and recommended next steps.
* Support continuous improvement of authoring standards, QA checklists, intake guidance, publishing procedures, documentation, and team knowledge-sharing materials.
* Assist with global, multi-site, and localized content updates, including language-copy or market-specific publishing workflows where applicable.
* Contribute to optimization efforts by reviewing performance signals, analytics inputs, SEO findings, accessibility observations, and stakeholder feedback to recommend content and page-level improvements.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s or above degree

* 2+ years of experience in digital content authoring, web publishing, CMS operations, digital production, or a related web experience role.
* Working knowledge of web publishing fundamentals (Templates, components, assets, metadata, workflows, approvals, staging, publishing, and content versioning).
* Foundational understanding of SEO, accessibility, metadata, & responsive design
* Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, follow-through
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Direct experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), particularly AEM Sites and AEM Assets
* Experience with more advanced AEM capabilities such as AEM Cloud/6.5, Multi Site Manager, Live Copies, language copies, content fragments, experience fragments, or publishing workflows.
* Experience supporting enterprise, global, multilingual, or multi-site websites.
* Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry such as banking, insurance, healthcare, or pharmaceuticals.
* Familiarity with analytics/optimization platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Adobe Target, or like.
* Experience with workflow/documentation platforms such as Workfront, Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, or SharePoint.
* Basic HTML/CSS troubleshooting and/or basic image preparation and optimization skills.
* Familiarity with taxonomy, structured content, content lifecycle management, content reuse, or AI/search discoverability.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

At Enterprise Bot, we're building AI solutions that help global enterprises transform customer experiences. As we grow, we're looking for someone who's passionate about finding great talent and loves working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

If you enjoy meeting new people, solving hiring challenges, and being part of a company that's scaling globally, we'd love to meet you.

* Own end-to-end hiring for technical and business roles.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and build recruitment strategies.
* Source exceptional talent through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and creative sourcing techniques.

* Coordinate interviews and keep candidates engaged throughout the hiring journey.
* Manage offers, reference checks, and pre-boarding activities.
* Build strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring.

* Respond to employee queries related to HR policies and benefits.

--------------------------

* 2-4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment.

* Strong sourcing skills using LinkedIn, job portals, and professional networks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

If you're excited about people, recruitment, and startups—and want to build your career in AI—we'd love to hear from you.

---------------------------------------

You will have taken on the active recruitment pipelines, streamlined onboarding coordination for incoming team members, and integrated smoothly into our Bengaluru hybrid setup. Through close collaboration with hiring managers, you will have gained a solid grasp of our GenAI technology landscape and team structures.
