title: HR Professional II
description:
Category: Human Resource Management

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Your impact begins here**

As HR Professional II, you will make sure every requisition reaches the right recruiter, quickly and accurately. You will keep global recruitment teams moving by applying the allocation matrix, coordinating assignments and handling salary range information with care. Your work helps hiring teams get started sooner and helps Novo bring in the people who turn science into progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

  

**What you’ll bring**

* An undergraduate degree in Human Resources or a related HR field.

* Experience with stakeholder management and solid business knowledge.

* An understanding of Talent Acquisition processes and the recruitment workflow.

* Good spoken and written English, and the ability to adapt your style for recruiters, team leads, sourcers and administration teams.

* A structured, detail-oriented and service-minded approach, with the discipline to follow up professionally.

* Curiosity, a proactive mindset and the ability to apply critical thinking when something does not fit the process.

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Experience coordinating with recruiters, team leads, sourcers and administration teams.

* Exposure to salary range management or compensation alignment.

  

**What you’ll do**

You will be the link between incoming requisitions and the recruiters who act on them, keeping the process accurate, clear and on time.

* Dispatch requisitions to the right recruiter using the allocation matrix, based on region, legal entity and organisational unit.

* Coordinate recruiter assignments across global recruitment teams to support balanced, process-compliant workload distribution.

* Hand over requisition information accurately, monitor process touchpoints, and escalate gaps, missing information or assignment conflicts.

* Track routing queries and help resolve them quickly, keeping stakeholders updated on status, dependencies and next steps.

* Support salary range management and compensation alignment by validating inputs, sharing them with the right stakeholders and flagging exceptions or mismatches for review.

* Handle sensitive compensation information with care and within defined process boundaries, while contributing to documentation discipline, service quality and continuous improvement.

  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join People, Organisation & Corporate Affairs, where colleagues help create an engaging, inclusive workplace and attract and develop the talent needed to support Novo’s purpose. This is an individual contributor role with daily global stakeholder interaction.

Your closest partners will be recruiters, recruiter teams, team leads, sourcers and administration colleagues across global recruitment teams. You will also work with the stakeholders involved in salary range and compensation alignment. Clear, timely communication from you keeps requisitions moving and helps people across regions and legal entities work with the same information.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will work in an international setting where your expertise is valued and your voice is heard. You will build deep knowledge of the Talent Acquisition process and see how recruitment operations support hiring across Novo, which opens the door to new skills and wider experience across the value chain.

You will be trusted to take ownership, supported to perform at your best, and expected to raise the bar through honest feedback and continuous improvement. When something stalls, you will speak up, decide and follow through.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring accuracy, clarity and a service mindset to global recruitment, apply for the HR Professional II role by 5 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Senior HR Executive- Immediate Joiner Only
description:
**Note : Immediate Joiner Only**

**The role**

You will be the owner of the HR function at Enview.ai . This is a hands-on generalist role in a growing company: you will build processes where none exist and execute them yourself.

Recruitment comes first in this role: Enview.ai hires continuously across field, sales and software teams, and we need someone who can personally source and close people, not just run the process.

Reporting to the Founder, you will run recruitment, payroll inputs, statutory compliance, employee relations and HR operations end to end for a workforce deployed across India.

**Location:** Whitefield, Bengaluru (on-site) · **Type:** Full-time · **Reports to:** Founder

**Key responsibilities**

**Recruitment & onboarding**

* Own hiring end to end: field technicians, pre-sales and network engineers, sales, software engineers and data-labeling/annotation staff across India - sourcing, screening, interviews, offers and closures.
* Build pipelines for each talent pool: job portals, referrals and institute tie-ups for ITI/diploma technicians and CCTV/network engineers; LinkedIn, campus and referral channels for software, data-labeling and sales roles.
* Run background and police verification for staff deployed at sensitive customer sites (defence, banking, judiciary, atomic energy) and keep verification records audit-ready for tenders.
* Onboard new joiners: documentation, ESI/PF enrolment, induction, tools and safety briefing for field staff.
* Track hiring metrics- time-to-hire, offer acceptance, source effectiveness, joining ratios- and give hiring managers clear, timely updates on every open role.

**Payroll, compliance & HR administration**

* Own monthly payroll inputs- attendance, leave, overtime, travel and site allowances.
* Manage statutory compliance with our external partners- EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, Gratuity, Karnataka S&E Act, CLRA — keeping challans, registers and returns accurate and on time.
* Maintain compliance documentation (challans, registers, returns) required for government and PSU tender submissions.
* Maintain employee records, contracts, offer and relieving letters in the HRMS.
* Build SOPs, checklists and templates so routine HR work runs consistently through the team.
* Maintain a simple HR dashboard- headcount, open roles, attrition, probation status. Update leadership regularly on staffing risks and compliance deadlines.

**Performance, training & safety**

* Run the appraisal cycle- scheduling, documentation, follow-through. Support managers on reviews and feedback.
* Coordinate technical certification and OEM training (e.g., CCTV, networking, cybersecurity partners) and track skill development.
* Monitor site-safety compliance for field staff: PPE, work-at-height norms, incident reporting.
* Run probation reviews and confirmations; conduct exit interviews and analyse attrition patterns to improve retention.

**Employee relations & engagement**

* Be the first point of contact for office and field employees on policies, pay queries and grievances; resolve issues quickly and fairly.
* Keep field staff connected: regular check-ins with site-deployed engineers, clear escalation paths, timely reimbursements.
* Run engagement initiatives, celebrations and recognition suited to a small, distributed team.

**What we're looking for**

* 4–6 years of HR experience with recruitment at its core, including at least a year running recruitment independently.
* A track record of personally sourcing and closing difficult roles, not just coordinating the process; experience in a system integrator, engineering services or similar field-workforce company strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance: EPF, ESI, PT, Gratuity, POSH, Karnataka S&E Act; exposure to compliance paperwork for government/PSU tenders is a big plus.
* Comfortable with an HRMS/payroll tool (e.g., Keka, greytHR, Zoho People) and an ATS; strong Excel.
* High integrity with confidential information; organized, proactive, and comfortable leading a two-person team while staying hands-on yourself.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.

**Compensation & benefits**

* Provident Fund and statutory benefits (ESI/gratuity as applicable)
* Paid time off and paid sick leave
* Health insurance
* A role with real ownership: you build the HR function, directly with the founder

Pay: ₹420,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

**Retail HR Business Partner – Store Operations & Training**

**1. Position Details**

* **Designation:** Retail HR Business Partner (HRBP)
* **Department:** Human Resources
* **Experience:** 3–4 years
* **Industry:** Retail – preferably fashion, jewellery, lifestyle, or organised retail
* **Location:** Corporate Office - Bangalore with regular travel to stores across India
* **Reporting To:** AVP – Human Resource (People & Culture)

**2. Role Purpose**

To act as a strategic and operational HR partner for retail store teams by driving employee engagement, talent management, performance management, employee relations, and HR operational excellence. The role will also be responsible for delivering effective training and development programmes to store employees, including Store Managers, Assistant Store Managers, Sales Executives, and other frontline team members.

The ideal candidate should have strong retail HR exposure, excellent communication and facilitation skills, and the ability to work closely with business teams to improve employee productivity, customer experience, and overall store performance.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. HR Business Partnering & Store Support**

* Partner with Store Managers, Cluster Managers, and Regional Managers to understand business needs and provide effective HR solutions.
* Conduct regular store visits to assess employee morale, workplace culture, manpower requirements, and HR compliance.
* Support store teams in workforce planning, manpower budgeting, and deployment of resources.
* Act as the first point of contact for store employees and managers on HR-related matters.
* Support the implementation of HR policies, processes, and people initiatives across retail locations.

**B. Talent Acquisition & Manpower Planning**

* Coordinate with the recruitment team to fulfil store-level manpower requirements within defined timelines.
* Support recruitment, screening, interview coordination, and onboarding of frontline retail employees.
* Monitor manpower availability, vacancies, attrition, and hiring turnaround time across assigned stores.
* Ensure effective onboarding and induction of new employees.

**C. Learning & Development – Retail Store Training**

* Identify training needs through store visits, employee feedback, performance data, and discussions with business leaders.
* Design and deliver engaging training programmes for frontline retail employees and store leadership teams.
* Conduct classroom, on-the-job, and virtual training sessions as required.
* Develop training calendars, learning materials, presentations, and practical activities relevant to retail operations.
* Evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, observation, and business performance indicators.
* Conduct refresher training and coaching sessions to reinforce learning and improve workplace behaviour.

**D. Employee Engagement & Retention**

* Drive employee engagement initiatives, recognition programmes, and store-level team-building activities.
* Analyse attrition trends and recommend initiatives to improve employee retention.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, performance-oriented culture across stores.
* Identify people-related challenges impacting store productivity and recommend corrective actions.

**E. Performance Management & Talent Development**

* Support the implementation of performance management processes for store employees and managers.

**F. Employee Relations & HR Operations**

* Handle employee grievances, workplace conflicts, disciplinary matters, and employee counselling.
* Support investigations and documentation relating to misconduct and violations of company policies.
* Coordinate with payroll and HR operations teams to resolve employee-related queries.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, statutory requirements, and applicable labour laws.

**G. HR Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain periodic HR dashboards and reports for assigned retail locations.
* Track key metrics such as headcount, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, training hours, and employee engagement.
* Analyse trends and identify areas requiring management intervention.
* Monitor training effectiveness and its impact on employee performance and customer experience.
* Share actionable insights and recommendations with HR leadership and retail business teams.

**4. Role Competencies**

**A. Functional Competencies**

* Help store leaders set performance goals and communicate expectations clearly.
* Monitor performance review completion and facilitate performance feedback discussions.
* Identify high-potential employees and support succession planning for key store positions through development programmes.

**Competency**

**Expected Proficiency**

Retail HR Business Partnering

Strong

Strong

Learning & Development / Training Delivery

Strong

Employee Engagement & Retention

Strong

Intermediate to Strong

Performance Management

Intermediate to Strong

Intermediate to Strong

**B. Behavioral Competencies**

* **Business Acumen:** Understands retail business priorities, store productivity, sales performance, and manpower requirements.
* **Communication & Presentation:** Communicates clearly and confidently with frontline employees, store managers, and senior stakeholders.
* **Relationship Management:** Builds trust with store teams and maintains productive relationships with business stakeholders.
* **Problem-Solving:** Identifies root causes of people-related challenges and recommends practical solutions.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** Takes responsibility for outcomes and proactively addresses challenges.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The role will be evaluated on the following measurable outcomes:

* **Manpower Fulfilment:** Timely closure of approved store vacancies in coordination with recruitment.
* **Employee Attrition:** Improvement in controllable frontline employee attrition.
* **Training Delivery:** Achievement of the approved training calendar and coverage targets.
* **Training Effectiveness:** Improvement in post-training assessment scores and demonstrated on-the-job application.
* **Employee Engagement:** Improvement in engagement feedback and participation in people initiatives.
* **New Hire Retention:** Retention of employees during the initial 90-day period.
* **HR Process Compliance:** Timely completion of onboarding, performance reviews, documentation, and other HR processes.
* **Grievance Resolution:** Timely resolution and appropriate escalation of employee concerns.

**6. Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

* 3–4 years of relevant experience in HR, preferably in organised retail.
* Prior experience supporting multiple stores or frontline retail teams is preferred.

* Working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, HRMS, and HR reporting.

description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. **Role Description**

The Consultant, Business Process Analysis will support Transfer Agency transformation and operational delivery. Working with operations, technology, product, risk, compliance and external vendors, the role will analyse business needs, document requirements, support critical applications and contribute to the implementation of controlled, scalable solutions. The successful candidate will support activities from initial problem definition through requirements, testing, implementation and ongoing application support, with particular focus on investor onboarding, AML/KYC and core Transfer Agency platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business analysis and requirements:** Support discovery, requirements elicitation, analysis, validation and documentation across business, technology and control stakeholders; translate defined problem statements into business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and traceability outputs.
* **Process and operating-model design:** Assess current-state processes, data flows, hand-offs and controls; identify gaps and define future-state requirements for investor onboarding, AML/KYC, static data, documentation, reporting and related Transfer Agency services.
* **Target operating model support:** Contribute to the definition, validation and implementation of target operating models by analysing roles, capabilities, governance, process ownership, technology enablement, controls, service delivery and organisational impacts; help translate the agreed model into practical transition activities and implementation requirements.
* **Solution delivery:** Work with project managers, product owners, operations, technology, risk, compliance and vendors to support analysis through scoping, design, detailed requirements, implementation readiness and post-implementation review.
* **Testing and quality assurance:** Develop test strategies, scenarios and plans; execute or coordinate system, regression and user-acceptance testing for Fenergo, ICON, Multifonds and other Transfer Agency applications; analyse results, manage defects and confirm acceptance criteria.
* **Stakeholder engagement:** Participate in and, where appropriate, facilitate workshops and working sessions; clarify assumptions, resolve requirements questions and support alignment across regional and cross-functional teams.
* **Risk, control and regulatory analysis:** Identify operational, data, control and regulatory considerations; assess jurisdiction-specific requirements and ensure these are documented, communicated and reflected in solution design and delivery.
* **Governance and continuous improvement:** Prepare process maps, data mappings, governance materials, training content and implementation artefacts; contribute to improvements in analysis standards, templates, controls and ways of working.
* **Change support:** Support transformation initiatives and adoption of new processes and systems, working with regional functional managers to help ensure effective communication and smooth implementation.

**Experience, Skills & Qualifications**

* Relevant business analysis, change delivery or application-support experience within funds, asset servicing, Transfer Agency, investor onboarding, AML/KYC or financial-services operations; typically 5–7 years of relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of Transfer Agency operating models, controls, service delivery and applications; experience with Multifonds, ICON or comparable platforms is highly desirable.
* Proven capability in requirements management, process mapping, data analysis, test planning, UAT, defect management and implementation readiness.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity, manage priorities and deliver to agreed timelines.
* Self-driven and accountable, with the initiative to work independently, progress priorities proactively and take ownership from problem identification through delivery.
* Ability to connect end-to-end business processes, data, systems, controls and customer outcomes, identifying upstream and downstream dependencies and translating insights into practical, scalable improvements.
* Strong stakeholder-management, workshop-facilitation, communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate effectively between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgement and the ability to influence cross-regional teams without direct authority.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential; experience with Visio, Power BI, SharePoint, Aha!, Azure DevOps, Jira or Confluence is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree, equivalent professional experience

* 24 Months as a Technical Coordinator /Associate Consultant to move as a Consultant
* Movement within TL and Consultant Level will be 12 months

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

title: Head of Workplace Identity & End User Computing
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the Role:**

  

The **Product Director, End User Computing & Identity** is accountable for the strategy, product direction, governance, and end-to-end lifecycle of Haleon’s workforce identity, access, endpoint, and virtual workplace capabilities. The role brings these services together as one integrated product portfolio, ensuring colleagues and partners can securely access the right applications, data, devices, and digital workspaces from the right location and at the right time.

The portfolio includes Active Directory, authentication and access services, joiner-mover-leaver enablement, privileged and conditional access integration, endpoint and mobile device management, standard device builds, application access and delivery, workplace security controls, virtual desktop and remote access services, and governance of workplace accessory policies. The role owns the product and technology lifecycle across these capabilities, from strategy and investment through design, engineering, adoption, service performance, modernisation, and retirement.

As Product Director, the role leads a multidisciplinary team of product, engineering, and service specialists and directs strategic partners. It works across Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Applications, HR, and business teams to deliver a coherent colleague experience, strengthen identity-led security, simplify the technology estate, and improve reliability, cost, and user experience at global scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and communicate the global vision, strategy, target architecture, roadmap, and investment priorities for Workplace Identity & End User Computing.

* Own the integrated product portfolio covering workforce identity, authentication, access, endpoints, device builds, application delivery, virtual desktops, and secure remote access.

* Provide end-to-end lifecycle ownership for Active Directory and cloud identity capabilities, ensuring resilient, scalable, and well-governed directory, authentication, federation, and access services.

* Partner with Cyber Security and application owners to embed identity-first and Zero Trust principles, including strong authentication, conditional access, least privilege, access recertification, and effective control of privileged access.

* Ensure identity and access services support efficient joiner, mover, and leaver journeys, role-based access, external-user access, and reliable integration with HR, SaaS, cloud, and enterprise applications.

* Own the endpoint and mobile product strategy and lifecycle across laptops, desktops, smartphones, tablets, shared devices, and specialist workplace endpoints, including procurement standards, enrolment, configuration, compliance, refresh, support, secure disposal, and oversight of workplace accessory policies and standards.

* Set the direction for modern endpoint management, standard device builds, operating system currency, patching, configuration, application packaging and deployment, endpoint security, and user experience.

* Own virtual desktop, application virtualisation, and remote access products, ensuring they provide secure, performant, and cost-effective access for employees, partners, specialist users, and regulated use cases.

* Create a seamless access experience across physical and virtual endpoints so that identity, device trust, application entitlement, and security policy operate as one coherent control framework.

* Maintain prioritised product roadmaps and backlogs, balancing colleague needs, security risk, regulatory obligations, resilience, technical debt, lifecycle exposure, cost, and strategic value.

* Define and track product outcomes and service measures covering user experience, adoption, access success, device compliance, service availability, security posture, lifecycle health, cost, and business value.

* Lead major modernisation, simplification, migration, and decommissioning initiatives across identity, endpoint, and virtual workplace technologies, with effective service transition and change adoption.

* Provide senior ownership of service health, major incidents, problem management, continuity, capacity, obsolescence, audit actions, and material risks across the portfolio.

* Manage strategic technology providers and delivery partners, setting clear outcomes and ensuring strong commercial control, licensing optimisation, performance, innovation, and accountability.

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team, establishing clear accountability, succession plans, capability development, and an inclusive product-led culture.

**About You**

  

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Significant senior leadership experience across enterprise workplace technology, identity and access, or end user computing within a large, complex, global organisation.

title: People Business Partner
description:
**Why Join Evotix?**
====================

At **Evotix**, we’re transforming the way businesses approach health, safety, and wellbeing. Our team thrives on bold ideas, celebrates diversity, and embraces the power of collaboration.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.
* **Support for You:** Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
* **Growth Opportunities:** Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
* **Team Culture:** Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

**The Role**
============

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded **People Business Partner** to support our teams across Bangalore and Hyderabad.

Based primarily in our Bangalore office, you will partner with managers located in India, as well as managers in other countries who lead employees and teams based in India. You will help managers make effective people decisions, build strong and accountable teams and address employee matters fairly, consistently and promptly.

This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can move confidently between **strategic business partnering** and **practical delivery**. You will provide clear advice, use people data to identify priorities and ensure that our People practices support business performance and an engaging employee experience.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Business and Manager Partnership**

* Build trusted relationships with managers, acting as the primary People partner for India-based employees and teams, including managers based outside India.
* Develop a strong understanding of business priorities, team structures and capability needs, providing pragmatic and commercially balanced People advice.
* Support managers to make timely, fair and evidence-based decisions, constructively challenging where necessary.
* Coach managers to strengthen their confidence and capability in managing people effectively.

**Performance and Capability**

* Support managers across goal setting, performance conversations, development planning and year-end reviews.
* Help managers address underperformance early and guide them through performance improvement and capability processes.
* Support talent reviews, succession planning and employee development, identifying broader capability gaps requiring action.
* Embed **ELITE: Excellence, Leadership, Impact, Trust and Empowerment** into performance, recognition and everyday management practices.

**Employee Relations**

* Manage employee relations matters including performance, conduct, attendance, grievances and workplace concerns.
* Guide managers through appropriate processes, documentation, investigations and risk considerations, ensuring fair and consistent treatment.
* Maintain accurate and confidential case documentation and engage external advisers where specialist Indian employment law guidance is required.
* Identify recurring themes and recommend preventative actions to reduce future employee relations issues.

**Organisational Effectiveness and Change**

* Partner with managers on organisational change, restructuring, role design and workforce planning.
* Provide People input into business growth, team design and future capability requirements.
* Support consultation, communication and implementation during change, helping leaders understand the practical people impact of decisions.
* Support wider integration and transformation initiatives affecting India-based teams.

**Employee Experience and Engagement**

* Build a visible and trusted People presence across Bangalore and Hyderabad, including quarterly visits to Hyderabad.
* Use employee feedback and engagement data to identify priorities and work with leaders to turn these into measurable actions.
* Support initiatives that strengthen communication, collaboration, inclusion and connection across locations.
* Promote an employee experience consistent with the organisation’s culture and values.

**People Operations and Governance**

* Partner with People Operations to deliver a smooth employee lifecycle, covering onboarding, probation, internal moves, promotions and exits.
* Ensure People policies, processes, documentation and systems are applied and maintained accurately and consistently in India.
* Support payroll, benefits and compliance activities through accurate and timely People information.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve the manager and employee experience.

**People Data and Insights**

* Use people data to identify trends, risks and priorities across retention, absence, performance, engagement and workforce capability.
* Translate data and business context into meaningful insights and practical recommendations for managers.
* Track agreed People actions and hold managers accountable for delivery, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data protection standards.

**What You Bring**
==================

**Required**

* Strong experience in a People Business Partner, HR Business Partner or senior HR generalist role in India.
* Practical knowledge of Indian employment practices and experience managing employee relations matters.
* Experience partnering with managers across different locations, functions and countries.
* Confidence advising international managers who may be unfamiliar with Indian employment practices or local workplace expectations.
* A track record of coaching managers and improving management capability.
* Experience supporting performance management, organisational change and employee engagement.
* Strong judgement, with the ability to balance employee experience, legal risk and commercial priorities.
* A practical, calm and solutions-focused approach.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Confidence working with people data and translating it into clear actions.
* High levels of discretion, integrity and attention to detail.
* Experience using People systems and maintaining accurate employee information.

**Desirable**

* Experience working in a fast-paced, international technology or software business.
* Experience supporting teams across Bangalore and Hyderabad.
* Experience working within a growing or changing organisation.
* Exposure to global People programmes and cross-border stakeholder management.
* A relevant postgraduate HR qualification or professional HR accreditation.

*Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.*

**Interview Process**
=====================

We aim to keep our interview process transparent, fair, and respectful of your time. While steps may vary slightly by role, you can typically expect:

* **Initial chat:** A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn more about your background, motivations, and answer any initial questions.
* **Hiring Manager interview:** A role-focused discussion exploring your experience, skills, and how you approach real-world scenarios relevant to the role.
* **Executive Leader interview:** A role-focused discussion exploring your approach to working with leaders in the wider business.
* **Final interview:** A conversation with a senior leader in India, assessing fit to the cultural requirements of the office.
* **Offer:** If successful, we’ll move quickly to share an offer and next steps.

We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**  
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!  
  
*Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.*

* Strong project/program management, communication, analytical, and results-orientation skills.
* Ability to lead complex, cross-functional learning initiatives from intake and diagnosis through execution and impact measurement.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
Bengaluru, India

**About Ushur**
---------------

Ushur delivers the world's first Customer Experience Automation platform built specifically for regulated industries. With guardrails and compliance-ready infrastructure, Ushur powers vertical AI Agents for healthcare, financial services, and insurance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Ushur is backed by Third Point Ventures, Tiger Global, 8VC, Iron Pillar, Aflac Ventures, and Pentland Ventures, with a sizable Fortune 500 customer base. Our Bengaluru office is one of two principal locations and is central to how the company is built and run.

We build AI agents for regulated enterprises, and we run our own operations the same way.

About Ushur | Ushur Platform

**Role Details**
----------------

* **Title:** People Operations Specialist
* **Experience:** 5–7 years
* **Location:** Bengaluru, India
* **Work Mode:** Hybrid
* **Reports To:** Director, People Operations

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a hands-on People Operations Specialist to independently manage and continuously improve HR operations for Ushur's India organization, working closely with our global People and Operations teams. You'll own the day-to-day: payroll inputs, benefits, onboarding and exits, HR systems, recruitment operations and employee support. You'll also make that work better. When you see a manual process, you'll simplify it, automate it, or turn it into self-service, using AI and automation where they help, with care for employee data. You'll build and improve these workflows yourself, not just identify them.

**AI-Native Operations**
------------------------

At Ushur, we believe modern People Operations should be increasingly intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. You will actively explore how AI, automation, and better system integration can improve the quality and efficiency of HR operations.

* Identify repetitive, manual processes and implement practical automation.
* Improve employee self-service through digital workflows, knowledge resources, and intelligent assistance.
* Leverage AI tools for appropriate administrative, analytical, reporting, and recruitment-support activities.
* Measure improvements in turnaround time, data accuracy, employee experience, and manual effort.
* Apply human oversight, privacy safeguards, and sound judgment, particularly when handling confidential employee information or supporting people-related decisions.
* We value practical improvements that deliver measurable results, not technology adoption for its own sake.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Payroll and Statutory Compliance**

* Independently manage monthly payroll inputs, validation, reconciliations, and coordination with Finance and payroll partners.
* Administer full and final settlements, including applicable notice-period adjustments, leave encashment, gratuity, and recoveries.
* Manage employee tax declarations, investment proofs, Form 16, and payroll-related queries.
* Implement approved changes to compensation structures, payroll policies, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate employee, compensation, attendance, and leave records.

### **Benefits and Vendor Management**

* Administer employee benefits, including health insurance, life insurance and wellness programmes.
* Coordinate enrolments, changes, claims support and benefits queries.
* Prepare annual benefits reviews and renewals using data analysis, vendor comparisons and recommendations.
* Manage relationships with insurers, brokers and other partners, monitor service quality, and coordinate the related admin and invoicing.

### **Onboarding and Offboarding**

* Manage onboarding from pre-joining documents through orientation and HR systems setup, so every new hire has a consistent, welcoming start.
* Coordinate lifecycle changes, including transfers, promotions, compensation updates and documentation.
* Manage offboarding: exit documents, clearances, F&F coordination and benefits transitions.

### **HR Systems and Data**

* Administer our HRIS and applicant tracking system: records, workflows, reporting and data integrity.
* Configure, build and improve HR workflows, approvals and self-service, and fix them when they break.
* Build and maintain operational reports and dashboards that support decisions.
* Respond to employee queries on policies, benefits, documents and HR processes, and prepare employment letters and verifications.

### **Hiring Operations**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment operations: job postings, sourcing, initial screening, interview coordination, offers and background verification.
* Coordinate interviews and candidate communication across distributed teams.
* Keep the applicant tracking system and hiring reports accurate, and improve the candidate experience.

### **Compliance, Audits and Calendars**

* Coordinate HR compliance activities, statutory reporting, POSH-related administration, and required employee training.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation to support internal and external audits.
* Maintain key People Operations calendars, compliance deadlines, and recurring administrative processes.

### **Performance, Engagement and Recognition**

* Support performance review cycles, compensation administration, and employee recognition programmes.
* Coordinate employee engagement initiatives, feedback surveys, and related activities.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

### **By Day 90**

* Build a strong understanding of Ushur's HR processes, systems, policies, and stakeholders.
* Independently manage core People Operations activities with accuracy and reliability.
* Establish effective working relationships across India and global teams.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to simplify or automate existing processes.

### **By Month 12**

* Demonstrate consistent accuracy, timeliness, and compliance across core HR operations.
* Improve operational efficiency and the employee experience through measurable process improvements.
* Implement meaningful automation or self-service enhancements.
* Build scalable, well-documented processes that support organizational growth.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Essential**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related technical field (B.Tech, BE, BCA, BSc CS or similar).
* 5–7 years in HR operations, ideally at a startup or scale-up.
* 3+ years preparing accurate monthly payroll inputs (joiners, exits, LOP, variable pay), with a working knowledge of India statutory benefits (PF, ESI, PT, gratuity) to answer employee queries and check F&F inputs.
* Proof that you build things and don't just use them: workflows, reports, trackers or automations you set up yourself in an HRIS, Google Sheets, Apps Script, Zapier or similar.
* You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT every day to create real work, and you check what they give you before you rely on it.
* You're comfortable reading, testing, and fixing formulas, workflow rules, and simple scripts. You don't wait for someone else to do it.
* Hands-on setup of a modern HRIS and ATS: fields, workflows, permissions and reports.
* You can run onboarding, exits, benefits, employee queries and recruitment operations on your own from start to finish.
* You're careful with data and treat confidential information that way.
* You write and speak clearly with teams in India and the US.

### **Nice to Have**

* An MBA or Master's in HR alongside your technical degree.
* Experience with Rippling or a similar all-in-one HRIS.
* Basic SQL, scripting or working with APIs.
* Experience with benefits renewals, audits or performance review admin.
* Experience at a global B2B SaaS company.

**You'll enjoy this role if** you see a manual process and want to fix it rather than repeat it, and you'd like HR to be an area where operations and technology meet.

**Attributes**
--------------

* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for outcomes, follows through, and proactively resolves issues.
* **Operational discipline:** Maintains accuracy, confidentiality, and consistency, even under deadline pressure.
* **Problem-solving:** Identifies inefficiencies and takes practical steps to improve them.
* **Service orientation:** Approaches employees, candidates, and stakeholders with empathy and professionalism.
* **Adaptability:** Responds constructively to change, feedback, and evolving business requirements.
* **AI and automation mindset:** Curious about new technologies, willing to experiment, and thoughtful about where human judgment remains essential.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

### **Meaningful Ownership**

Take responsibility for a broad range of People Operations activities and shape how they evolve.

### **AI-Native Environment**

Work in a company at the forefront of enterprise AI, with opportunities to apply automation to real operational challenges.

### **Global Collaboration**

Partner with colleagues across geographies and functions.

### **Company Culture**

A values-driven workplace built on respect, inclusion, and collaboration.

### **Paid Time Off**

Twenty days of flexible paid time off annually.

### **Health and Wellness**

Medical insurance for employees and eligible dependents, preventive health initiatives, and wellness programmes.

### **Compensation and Equity**

Competitive compensation and stock options.

### **Professional Development**

Opportunities for continuous learning, professional certifications, and access to internal learning resources.

title: IT Leader
description:
**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry's most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean's agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry's broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC's Disruptor 50, Bloomberg's AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner's Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we're helping the world's largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you're excited to shape how the world works, you'll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

**About the Role:**

Glean is looking for a hands-on IT Leader to join our Bangalore IT Support organisation as a technical leader, people manager, and driver of AI-powered IT operations.

In this role, you will lead a team of full-time IT engineers and contractors and take ownership of our identity, endpoint, SaaS, and infrastructure ecosystem, including platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, and Kandji. You will stay close to the technology, resolve high-stakes escalations, guide architecture decisions, and champion automation, while building a high-performing, AI-fluent team that delivers a secure, reliable, and exceptional employee experience.

You will partner closely with Security, HR, Finance, Engineering, and external vendors to architect and maintain IT services that are both secure and scalable. You will also bring a strong AI-first mindset, using AI and automation to transform how IT work gets done across the employee lifecycle.

**You will:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of IT engineers (L1-L3), including full-time employees and contractors, setting clear goals, priorities, and expectations.
* Manage contractor and vendor relationships end to end, including staffing, performance, SLAs, onboarding, renewals, and cost, and ensure consistent quality across the extended team.
* Balance workload and priorities with the other IT Leader in Bangalore, ensuring strong coverage, clear ownership, and operational continuity across IT Support.
* Remain hands-on technically and act as a senior escalation point for complex issues across identity, infrastructure, endpoints, networking, and SaaS applications.
* Own the roadmap, administration, and optimization of Okta, Google Workspace, Kandji, and related identity and endpoint-management platforms.
* Drive AI and automation initiatives across IT: identify high-value workflows, then design, build, and deploy solutions that reduce manual effort and improve employee experience.
* Apply AI to IT workflows such as ticket triage and deflection, knowledge-base creation, onboarding and offboarding, access requests, provisioning, compliance checks, and reporting.
* Lead and deliver IT projects and cross-functional programs from planning through execution, including scoping, timelines, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and outcome tracking.
* Design and implement automation for provisioning, access management, compliance, reporting, and asset lifecycle workflows using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
* Lead root-cause analysis for major incidents and drive long-term corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor system health, endpoint compliance, patch status, alerts, and operational risks, and take proactive action.
* Lead proof-of-concept projects to evaluate new IT, security, endpoint, AI, and automation solutions.
* Partner with Security, HR, Finance, and Engineering on identity governance, employee lifecycle management, asset management, and operational workflows.
* Own ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management processes and continuously improve them.
* Ensure accurate SOPs, technical runbooks, knowledge-base articles, system documentation, and process workflows.
* Support ISO 27001, SOC 2, internal audit, policy implementation, and compliance-readiness activities.
* Define and track operational metrics (SLAs, CSAT, ticket trends, automation impact), and communicate risks, trends, and improvement outcomes to senior management.
* Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, efficiency, and employee experience across IT services.

**About you:**

* 14+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, IT operations, endpoint management, or a related field, including 3+ years leading IT teams.
* Strong technical foundation with a track record of staying hands-on while leading others; you are comfortable going deep when it matters.
* Proven experience managing people and contractors, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and building team culture across employees and an extended workforce.
* Experience managing vendors, MSPs, or staff-augmentation partners, including SLAs, performance reviews, and commercial discussions.
* Demonstrated AI fluency: you have worked on AI-related projects and have used AI to automate or improve IT workflows (for example, AI-assisted support, agents, workflow automation, or LLM-powered tooling).
* Strong hands-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, MFA, lifecycle automation, application integrations, and access policies.
* Strong experience administering Google Workspace, including user lifecycle management, groups, access controls, and security settings.
* Hands-on experience with Kandji, Jamf, Intune, or a similar MDM platform.
* Advanced troubleshooting experience across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routing, and firewalls.
* Experience with automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar tools.
* Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or Freshservice.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management.
* Familiarity with endpoint security, identity governance, access control, patch compliance, and security operations.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, internal audits, or similar compliance programs.
* Strong documentation, communication, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work with global teams.
* Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and take ownership from investigation through resolution.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred but not required.

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)

**Compensation & Benefits:**

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We're committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-HYBRID

**AI-First Mindset at Glean:**

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

description:

Do you enjoy understanding how services, workflows, knowledge, data, and systems connect end to end—and shaping ServiceNow HR Service Delivery solutions that work in practice? We are now looking for a Product Specialist to act as a functional subject matter expert for ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD). title: Manager HR Operations
description:
Pretium is a specialized investment manager with ~$53B in assets under management (AUM) focused on real estate, mortgage finance, and corporate debt. Pretium manages more than 96,000 single-family rentals (SFRs) in the United States and has a global employee base of ~4,400.

Pretium Enterprise Operations India Private Limited (PES India), based in Bangalore, is integral to the growth, innovation, and transformation of Pretium’s global operating companies. With 700+ employees, PES India delivers with excellence, ownership, and a relentless focus on scalable growth.

**Job Description:**

*About the role:*

The Manager HR Operations India is a key delivery role within the HR function, responsible for executing and overseeing the day-to-day HR operations processes that keep the employee lifecycle running accurately and on time — from Day 1 to exit. This role ensures that the operational heartbeat of HR is consistent, compliant, and employee-centric.  
We are looking for a detail-obsessed, process-driven, and dependable HR Ops Team Lead who can own their workstreams end-to-end, support and guide junior team members, and serve as the first point of operational escalation within the team. This role works closely with the HR Ops Assistant Manager and Manager, the HRBP, Finance, and external vendors to deliver seamless HR operations for our 700+ employees.

*What you will do at PES India:*

*Employee Lifecycle Management*

* Execute and oversee end-to-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle — onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, role changes, and exits — ensuring accuracy and timeliness at every stage
* Coordinate weekly induction logistics and ensure every new joiner has a smooth Day 1 — system access, documentation, and orientation completed before they arrive
* Manage the offboarding process — exit documentation, clearance coordination, full and final settlement inputs, and real-time HRMS updates
* Prepare and issue all HR letters — offer, confirmation, transfer, promotion, and exit — with accuracy and turnaround speed
* Coordinate background verification (BGV) with vendors and ensure timely, accurate completion for all new joiners

*HR Documentation & Compliance*

* Maintain accurate, audit-ready employee records across both physical and digital systems
* Ensure compliance with company HR policies and applicable statutory requirements; flag gaps proactively to the Assistant Manager
* Support internal and external HR audits with well-organised documentation and trackers
* Assist in updating HR policy documents and process SOPs as directed by the HR leadership

*Payroll & Attendance Support*

* Compile and validate monthly payroll inputs — attendance, leaves, shift data, arrears, and variable pay — and share with the payroll processing team on time, every cycle
* Track leave balances, attendance records, and shift schedules; resolve discrepancies before they become payroll errors
* Coordinate with Finance and the payroll vendor to ensure smooth monthly cycles; flag exceptions and unresolved issues to the Assistant Manager

*Benefits Administration*

* Manage the end-to-end medical insurance process — enrolments, additions, deletions, claim coordination, and annual renewal support
* Administer other employee benefits including shift allowances, weekend allowances, and any other applicable benefits programmes
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee benefit queries; resolve with speed and clarity; escalate complex cases appropriately
* Coordinate with benefits vendors — track SLAs, follow up on pending items, and flag performance issues to the Assistant Manager

*HRIS & Data Management*

* Ensure all employee data in Workday is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational standards always
* Prepare standard HR reports, MIS dashboards, and data extracts for the HR team and leadership — on time and in the right format
* Identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting processes; flag automation or efficiency ideas to the Assistant Manager
* Maintain strict adherence to data privacy, confidentiality, and information security requirements

*Employee Query Management*

* Respond to employee queries on HR policies, processes, benefits, and documentation — promptly, accurately, and with a helpful tone
* Maintain a query log to track recurring themes and surface them to the HRBP or Assistant Manager for policy-level intervention
* Support HR initiatives, engagement activities, and culture programmes with operational and logistical coordination

*Team Support & Process Oversight*

* Guide and support junior HR Ops team members on day-to-day execution – reviewing their work, answering process queries, and ensuring quality and consistency
* Serve as the first point of escalation within the team for operational issues before they are raised to the Assistant Manager
* Contribute to process documentation, SOP maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives within the HR Ops function

*What we are looking for:*

*Must-have*

* 10–15 years of experience in HR Operations or an HR generalist role with strong ops exposure
* Hands-on experience managing employee lifecycle processes end-to-end — with a track record of ownership, not just support
* Proficiency in Workday — prior experience with HCM, Absence, and Reporting modules strongly preferred
* Strong MS Office skills — especially Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data validation) and PowerPoint
* Experience coordinating payroll inputs and benefits administration
* Working knowledge of Indian statutory compliance requirements — PF, ESI, Gratuity, POSH, Shops & Establishment Act
* High attention to detail — someone who finds errors before anyone else does
* Good communication skills in English, both written and verbal

*Good to have*

* Experience working in a GCC, shared services, or fast-paced multinational environment
* Exposure to ServiceNow or a ticketing / query management system
* Familiarity with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
* Prior experience supporting or guiding junior team members

*Education*

* MBA/PGDM in HR (preferred)
* Bachelor’s degree with strong relevant experience will also be considered

*Perks & Benefits:*

We believe great people deserve to be taken care of – here’s what working at PES India looks like beyond the job:

* **Competitive Compensation –** Market-aligned salary with performance-linked bonus
* **Shift & Weekend Allowances –** Additional allowances over and above fixed salary
* **Insurance Coverage –** Group health cover for self and family + term and personal accident cover for self
* **Hybrid Flexibility –** 3 days on-site, 2 days remote
* **Career Growth –** A growing organisation where strong ops talent gets noticed and moved up

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description**

  

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

The People Technology Service & Experience Senior Product Specialist will work with business stakeholders to understand service challenges, user needs and desired outcomes, translating these into practical, scalable and supportable digital solutions across the People Service & Experience portfolio.

Reporting to the People Technology Service & Experience Product Manager, you will collaborate with Project Managers, People teams, business regions, IT, technical specialists and external delivery partners. You will bring strong knowledge of ServiceNow, particularly HR Service Delivery, across capabilities such as case management, service catalogue, knowledge, self-service, lifecycle events and workflow automation.

This is a hands-on product delivery role. You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape service and functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate incidents and defects and deliver service improvements. You will also help design joined-up People services and lifecycle journeys involving other functions, while those functions remain responsible for their own services and activities.

You will maintain the configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation required for governance, auditability, service continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.

Although primarily aligned to People Service & Experience, you may support other People Technology domains where demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.

Key responsibilities

* Work with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand service challenges, business problems, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.

* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, translating business and service requirements into clear options, service designs, functional requirements, workflow designs and acceptance criteria.

* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, bringing strong platform knowledge, leading practices and service insight into business and delivery decisions.

* Deliver authorised ServiceNow configuration, administration, enhancements, workflow improvements and optimisation within agreed access, security, data-protection, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.

* Take ownership of assigned changes from discovery through design, configuration, testing, release, operational handover and early-life support, maintaining appropriate traceability, documentation and evidence throughout the lifecycle.

* Analyse People services, processes, user journeys, case-management requirements, service-catalogue structures, knowledge needs, workflows, roles, permissions and integrations to shape effective end-to-end solutions.

* Support the development of consistent global People services and ways of working, simplifying, standardising and automating processes while recognising legitimate regional and regulatory requirements.

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description**

  

* We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.
* The People Technology Foundation Senior Product Specialist will work closely with business stakeholders to understand their problems, requirements and desired outcomes, translating these into practical, scalable and supportable digital solutions across the People Foundation portfolio.
* Reporting to the People Technology Foundation Product Manager, you will work alongside another Senior Product Specialist and collaborate with Project Managers, People teams, business regions, IT, architecture, data, integration teams and external delivery partners.
* You will bring strong knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and related Foundation capabilities. The portfolio currently includes Employee Central, employee and workforce data, Position Management, Organisation Management, employee lifecycle processes and OpenText, with future scope expected to include Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation services.
* This is a hands-on product delivery role. You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate defects and deliver product improvements. You will ensure that stakeholders remain focused on the business problem and required outcomes, while People Technology brings the product expertise needed to determine the most effective solution.
* You will also create and maintain the detailed configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation needed to support effective governance, auditability, continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will help strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.
* Although primarily aligned to People Foundation, you will also support other People Technology capability domains when concentrated demand, delivery priorities, holiday cover, business continuity or development opportunities require additional capacity.
  

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Work directly with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand business problems, requirements, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.
* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, constructively challenging assumptions and translating business requirements into clear options, recommendations, functional designs and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and assigned Foundation capabilities, bringing relevant platform knowledge, leading practices and product insight into business and delivery decisions.
* Deliver authorised configuration, product administration, enhancements and optimisation activity directly within agreed access, security, control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Take ownership of assigned product changes from discovery through functional design, configuration, testing, release and early-life support, progressing work through established change and release controls with accurate status, traceability, decisions and evidence.
* Work with the Foundation Product Manager and Project Managers on larger initiatives, providing product expertise, detailed requirements, scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, decisions and delivery information.
* Analyse People processes, workforce data structures, business rules, roles, permissions, integrations and operational impacts to support effective end-to-end solution design.
* Assess Foundation-related incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolution or improvement routes.
* Assess SAP SuccessFactors release updates and product-roadmap changes, identifying relevant impacts, risks and opportunities and coordinating the testing, documentation, stakeholder readiness and adoption activity required.
* Create and maintain configuration workbooks, configuration records, requirements, functional designs, process documentation, solution decisions, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live product and supports auditability, operational continuity, supportability and future change.
* Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria, undertake or coordinate functional and regression testing, support user acceptance testing and ensure defects, decisions and test evidence are recorded appropriately.
* Monitor product health, data quality, recurring defects, adoption and operational performance, identifying and delivering opportunities to simplify processes, improve configuration, reduce manual activity and increase business value.
* Work confidently with support and implementation partners, leading or contributing to workshops, reviewing designs and deliverables, challenging recommendations and ensuring agreed documentation and knowledge transfer are completed.
* Maintain and develop relevant SAP SuccessFactors expertise through product learning, release awareness, practical delivery and appropriate certification.
* Share product knowledge, methods, documentation and lessons with colleagues, reducing single points of failure and increasing the resilience of the People Technology team.
* Contribute to the Foundation People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, support adoption and improve the effective use of Foundation capabilities.
* Support other People Technology domains where demand and capacity require, providing flexible delivery capacity, holiday cover and broader development while maintaining accountability for assigned Foundation responsibilities.
  

**Candidate Specification:**

  

* **Essential**
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, including practical configuration, functional design, testing and delivery of controlled product changes.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes, employee lifecycle activities, workforce data, organisational structures, Position Management and related People Foundation capabilities.
* Experience leading discovery and requirements workshops, keeping stakeholders focused on business problems and desired outcomes rather than predetermined technology solutions.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear process designs, functional requirements, solution options, configuration decisions and acceptance criteria.
* Experience coordinating product and vendor-release cycles, including impact assessment, regression testing, business readiness, deployment, operational handover and post-release review.
* Experience assessing incidents, defects, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, including impact analysis, root-cause investigation and recommendation of appropriate solutions.
* Experience producing and maintaining configuration workbooks, functional designs, process documentation, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge.
* Confidence working with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Project Managers, technical specialists and third-party partners, including constructively challenging designs, configuration, testing outputs and documentation.
* Ability to deliver authorised configuration and product improvements directly while observing security, access, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Commitment to maintaining deep product expertise, completing relevant learning or certification and sharing knowledge to reduce single-person and external-partner dependency.
* Ability to support adjacent People Technology products or capability domains when demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.
  

* **Desirable**
* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification.
* Additional SAP SuccessFactors experience or certification in Position Management, Time Management, Platform Foundations, Employee Central Payroll or related capabilities.
* Experience with OpenText or comparable enterprise employee document and records-management solutions.
* Experience with Time Off, Absence Management, Workforce Administration, payroll processes or payroll integrations.

* Experience supporting SAP SuccessFactors release planning, regression testing and adoption of new platform capabilities.
* Experience working with integrations, data structures, security roles, permissions, business rules and downstream system dependencies.

* Experience working with super-user groups, champion networks, communities of practice or a People Technology Community.
