title: Manager Business Systems
description:
Overview:

**Manager, Atlassian Products**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Director, Business Technology

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

People Manager – Mid/Senior

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian tools – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – sit at the center of how work gets planned, tracked, and documented across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Manager, Atlassian Products is a player-manager responsible for leading HealthEdge's Atlassian platform team while remaining technically engaged in the work. You will manage a globally distributed team of Atlassian Administrators – supporting thousands of users across engineering, IT, product, and business functions. Reporting to the Director, Business Technology, you are accountable for platform health, governance, stakeholder relationships, and team development.

This is a growth environment. The Atlassian team today spans approximately 14 people and is expected to grow toward 24 as HealthEdge's platform needs expand. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and developing talent for a 6-8 person group while ensuring the platform continues to meet the demands of a complex, fast-moving organization.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Team Leadership & Development**
---------------------------------

* Lead, manage, and develop a globally distributed team of Atlassian Administrators in India
* Drive hiring for open roles on the Atlassian Products team, partnering with HR and the Director, Business Technology to scale the team toward its target size
* Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, conduct performance reviews, and support career development for all direct reports
* Build a high-performing team culture grounded in platform rigor, user focus, and continuous improvement
* Manage team capacity, workload distribution, and prioritization across the support queue and project backlog

**Platform Strategy & Governance**
----------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform roadmap in partnership with the Director, Business Technology – defining priorities, driving improvements, and aligning with organizational needs
* Establish and enforce governance standards for project structure, permissions, naming conventions, workflows, and Confluence space management across the organization
* Lead the evaluation and lifecycle management of Atlassian Marketplace apps — assessing fit, managing licenses, and governing usage
* Oversee Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, security policies, and license management
* Drive platform hygiene initiatives and ensure the environment remains clean, well-documented, and audit-ready

**Technical Oversight & Solution Design**
-----------------------------------------

* Serve as the escalation point for complex platform issues and solution design decisions that exceed senior administrator scope
* Guide the design and implementation of advanced Jira, JSM, and Confluence configurations including complex workflows, automation frameworks, and cross-project solutions
* Oversee the development and maintenance of scripts and automation rules across the platform
* Ensure platform changes follow change management practices with appropriate testing, documentation, and rollback planning
* Stay current on Atlassian product developments, roadmap changes, and best practices, and translate these into team guidance

**Stakeholder Management**
--------------------------

* Serve as the primary business relationship owner for Atlassian products across IT, Engineering, Product, and business functions
* Partner with senior stakeholders to understand evolving platform needs and translate them into prioritized, scalable solutions
* Run regular stakeholder touchpoints, communicate platform changes and improvements proactively, and manage escalations professionally
* Partner with the ITSM team to ensure JSM is optimized for IT service delivery – SLAs, queues, automations, and reporting

**Operations & Reporting**
--------------------------

* Own the Atlassian support queue at a team level – ensuring SLA compliance, queue health, and consistent quality of delivery
* Produce and present regular reporting on platform health, team performance, license utilization, and open initiatives
* Manage the Atlassian vendor relationship including renewal negotiations, support cases, and TAM engagement
* Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access, configuration, and data governance

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 5+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, with deep expertise in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* 2+ years of people management experience, including hiring, developing, and performance-managing technical team members
* Proven ability to lead a team in a global, distributed environment
* Strong platform governance experience – designing and enforcing standards across a large, complex Atlassian environment
* Experience with Atlassian Cloud administration including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and security policy management
* Hands-on experience with Jira automation (native) and advanced automation tooling
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business requirements into platform solutions
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or equivalent) strongly preferred
* Experience managing Atlassian teams or platforms through growth, migrations, or consolidation projects
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and applying them within JSM for enterprise ITSM
* Experience with Atlassian Marketplace apps at scale (ScriptRunner, Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, Elements Connect, or similar)
* Exposure to REST API integrations with Atlassian platforms
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT integration or multi-instance Atlassian environments

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have a clear picture of the current team, platform state, and stakeholder landscape, have identified the highest-priority gaps in governance and delivery, and have begun filling open roles. Within six months, the team is operating with clear standards, the support queue is consistently within SLA, and key stakeholders have a trusted partner in you. Within a year, the Atlassian Products team has grown toward its target size, platform governance is mature and well-documented, and you have established the function as a reliable, high-performing part of the Business Technology organization.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll lead a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates. With Jira Software driving engineering and product delivery, JSM powering IT service management, and Confluence serving as the organization's knowledge backbone, the platform this team manages touches every function in the company. It's a high-visibility role with real impact — and a team and roadmap that reflect a serious, long-term investment in the Atlassian platform.

**Geographic Responsibility: This position is located in Bangalore**
  
**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**  
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**  
**Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**
* **Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.**
* **Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.**
* **May require travel dependent on company needs.**

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.*  
  
*HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.*

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**Information about the business**

Aon is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement, and health solutions. Our colleagues provide clients in over 120 countries and sovereignties with advice and solutions that give them the clarity and confidence to make better decisions to protect and grow their business.

General description of role:

The Global Offer Management Specialist supports the global offer management process from offer acceptance through the employee’s start date. This role coordinates offer documentation, pre-hire requirements, background check activity, candidate communications, stakeholder follow-up, and system updates to help ensure a smooth, timely, and compliant onboarding experience for new hires and internal transfers. The Specialist works closely with Talent Acquisition, HR, hiring managers, and regional partners to maintain accurate data, resolve routine issues, and support consistent execution of global offer processes.

**Job responsibilities**:

The colleague is responsible for:

**End-to-End Offer Process Management**

* Support the offer lifecycle globally from offer acceptance through start date, ensuring required steps are completed accurately and on time.
* Prepare, review, and issue offer documentation using approved templates and regional guidance.
* Coordinate and track pre-hire activities, including background checks, work authorization, references, and other market-specific requirements.
* Monitor offer-related milestones and service-level expectations, following up with candidates and stakeholders as needed.
* Identify routine delays or data discrepancies, resolve where possible, and escalate more complex issues to the appropriate partner.

**Candidate Experience & Communication**

* Serve as a key point of contact for candidates after offer acceptance, providing timely updates and clear guidance.
* Guide candidates through pre-employment requirements and onboarding tasks in a professional, supportive manner.
* Respond to routine candidate questions related to documentation, start dates, pre-hire requirements, and onboarding logistics.
* Ensure candidate communications are accurate, consistent, and aligned with the company’s employer brand.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, hiring managers, Compensation & Benefits, Payroll, and regional HR teams to confirm offer details and pre-hire readiness.
* Coordinate with local teams to support country-specific legal, compliance, documentation, and onboarding requirements.
* Provide regular status updates and flag potential risks or delays to collaborators throughout the pre-hire process.
* Support hiring managers by confirming start dates, tracking readiness achievements, and sharing relevant pre-start updates.

**Compliance, Data Integrity & Documentation**

* Follow established offer and pre-hire processes in alignment with local labor requirements, internal policies, and data privacy standards.
* Maintain accurate candidate and offer data in HR systems, including ATS, HRIS, background screening platforms, and related tools.
* Prepare contracts, addenda, and supporting documentation using approved terms and templates.
* Maintain complete and audit-ready records for assigned offer and pre-hire activities.

**Process Improvement & Standardization**

* Support the documentation and consistent execution of standardized global offer management processes.
* Find opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and enhance candidate and collaborator experience.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives, pilots, and system enhancement activities related to offer management and onboarding.
* Track and maintain offer-related data and metrics, such as pre-hire completion status, start-date readiness, and issue trends.

**Systems & Tools**

* Use applicant tracking systems, HRIS, background screening platforms, digital signature tools, and reporting resources to manage assigned offer activity.
* Complete accurate data entry, status updates, task tracking, and workflow management within required systems.
* Share feedback on system usability, data quality, and process gaps to support ongoing improvements.

**Skills/competencies required**:

* 3+ years of experience in HR, Talent Acquisition operations, onboarding, recruiting coordination, or a similar operational role.
* Experience supporting time-sensitive processes across multiple collaborators, regions, or time zones .
* Solid attention to detail and ability to manage multiple offers, tasks, and follow-ups simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with candidates and internal partners.
* Demonstrated ability to work with confidential information and handle sensitive data with discretion.
* Proficiency with HR systems, applicant tracking systems, and Microsoft Office tools.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a global or multinational organization across multiple countries or regions.
* Familiarity with employment documentation, background screening, onboarding, and pre-hire requirements across different markets.
* Experience supporting process standardization, continuous improvement, or HR technology enhancement initiatives.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.

**Key Competencies**

* **Candidate Focus:** Prioritizes a clear, supportive candidate experience while maintaining operational accuracy.
* **Organization & Prioritization:** Manages multiple deadlines, tasks, and collaborator follow-ups in a fast-paced environment.
* **Collaboration:** Works effectively with cross-functional and cross-regional partners to complete offer and pre-hire activities.
* **Problem Solving:** Identifies routine issues, recommends practical solutions, and advances when appropriate.
* **Adaptability:** Works comfortably across different cultures, time zones, systems, and regional requirements.
* **Integrity & Confidentiality:** Handles sensitive candidate and employee information responsibly and ethically.

**How we support our colleagues**

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.

Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the role:**  
The People Experience Partner is a Tier 2 HR role within the regional HR delivery model, forming part of a co-located, clustered People Partnership team that delivers seamless, tech-forward employee journeys and experiences with clarity and confidence. The role provides specialist people partnership support to assigned client groups, business units, business functions and geographies, while also contributing to generalist work across the regional pool.

The role operates within the priorities, governance and service standards set for the regional HR delivery team.

Working under the direction of the Regional HR Lead, the People Experience Partner works with HR Business Leaders, Centres of Excellence and Innovation, People Solutions Advisors to resolve complex people matters, support leaders through core people processes, enable adoption of standard HR practices and escalate appropriately where regional or specialist intervention is required.

**How you will contribute:**  
  
Operate within the Tier 2 layer of the regional HR delivery model, coordinating effectively with the Tier 0 Direct Access, Tier 1 People Solutions Advisors, the Regional HR Lead, HR Business Leaders, Centres of Excellence and Innovation, and broader People Solutions to ensure matters are handled at the right tier and escalated appropriately.

Provide people partnership support to assigned client groups and leaders within the region, in alignment with priorities set by the Regional HR Lead and HR Business Leaders.

Coach and advise leaders on complex or sensitive people topics, including employee relations, performance, talent, succession, learning, mobility, rewards, change activity and organisation design support, applying sound judgement and escalating where broader regional, legal or specialist input is required.

Work with HR Business Leaders, Centres of Excellence and Innovation, People Solutions Advisors and the Regional HR Lead to implement agreed people initiatives and ensure leaders receive joined-up support through the HR operating model.

Apply standardised people processes, support leaders to manage routine people activities in line with approved processes, and contribute feedback to improve playbooks, tools and ways of working across assigned client groups and geographies.

Champion adoption of self-service, digital HR solutions, people data, analytics and AI-enabled tools within client groups, helping leaders navigate standard processes efficiently while focusing People Experience Partner support on higher-value and more complex people matters.

Bring a One HR enterprise mindset by sharing insight from cases, leader interactions and country or client-group needs to improve service quality, standardisation, employee experience and adoption of the regional HR delivery model.

**Skills and qualifications:**  

* Minimum six years of progressive Human Resources experience, including strong generalist HR experience in regional or global contexts.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology or a related field; advanced degree or professional Human Resources certification is a plus.
* Experience supporting leaders in complex, matrixed organisations and operating effectively within a clustered, shared-service or tiered HR model.
* Ability to manage complex Tier 2 people matters with sound judgement, clear escalation discipline and awareness of local employment requirements.
* Working knowledge across employee relations, performance management, talent, succession, learning, rewards, mobility, talent acquisition, organisation design support and change activity.
* Experience using people analytics, HR information systems, digital HR platforms and AI-enabled tools to generate insight, support decisions and improve ways of working.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, facilitation and coaching skills, with the ability to build trust with leaders and collaborate across HR Business Leaders, Centres of Excellence and Innovation, People Solutions Advisors and People Solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to support adoption of standardised people processes, self-service tools and new ways of working while maintaining a One HR enterprise mindset.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfort working through ambiguity, and willingness and ability to travel regionally or globally as required.

description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the role**
==================

The People Experience Partner - Cluster Lead leads a co-located team of People Experience Partners within a Global Capability Centre, delivering people partnership across an assigned geographical cluster. The role is accountable for how support is allocated, delivered and experienced by leaders across the countries, business units and functions in scope.

This is a working leadership role. Alongside leading the team, you remain hands-on in the most complex, sensitive and high-impact people matters in the cluster, acting as the escalation and decision point for People Experience Partners and as the named account contact for the HR Business Leaders your cluster serves.

You also hold a specialised regional practice area — for example leave management, employee relations, compensation and benefits, or organisation design and talent — acting as the region’s deep expert, setting standards, building capability and resolving matters that need specialist judgement. The role sits above the People Experience Partner in seniority and reports to the Regional HR Lead.

**How you will contribute**
===========================

**Leading the cluster team**
----------------------------

* Lead, coach and develop a co-located team of People Experience Partners, setting priorities, balancing workload and supporting capability and career development.
* Assign People Experience Partners to business units and functions within the cluster, ensuring clear coverage and resilience as demand, people and business priorities shift.
* Act as the escalation and decision point for complex, high-impact or sensitive people matters raised by the team, providing timely guidance and resolution.
* Build a strong team culture at the Global Capability Centre site, fostering learning, inclusion, peer coaching and continuous improvement across the cluster.

**Delivering HR partnering work**
---------------------------------

* Carry a personal portfolio of HR partnering work, taking the most complex and senior-facing people matters in the cluster — restructurings and reductions in force, sensitive employee relations cases, senior leader coaching and significant change activity.
* Coach and advise leaders across core people priorities — employee relations, performance, talent, succession, rewards, mobility, talent acquisition, change and organisation design — applying sound judgement and escalating where legal or Centre of Excellence and Innovation input is required.
* Model the expected standard of partnering and raise the quality of advice given to leaders across the cluster.

**Regional practice area specialisation**
-----------------------------------------

* Hold a named regional practice area — such as leave management, employee relations, compensation and benefits, or organisation design, learning and talent management — acting as the subject matter expert the region consults.
* Resolve the cases in that practice area that need genuine specialist judgement, wherever in the region they arise, working with the relevant Centre of Excellence and Innovation on policy interpretation, precedent and risk.
* Set and maintain the regional standard in your practice area through current playbooks, decision criteria, templates and guidance.
* Build capability in that practice area across People Experience Partners and People Solutions Advisors (PSA) through coaching, case review and training, so that routine matters are handled at the right tier and only true exceptions reach you.

**Stakeholder and account management**
--------------------------------------

* Act as the account manager and point of contact for the HR Business Leaders your cluster serves, keeping ownership clear and the number of contacts to a minimum.
* Own escalations from HR Business Leaders relating to your cluster, resolving them or routing them to the right accountable party with clear ownership and timelines.
* Partner with HR Business Leaders, People Solutions Advisors and Centres of Excellence and Innovation to adapt programmes, policies and tools to country and client-group needs.
* Represent the cluster to the Regional HR Lead and senior stakeholders, giving transparent reporting on service performance, risks and resourcing.

**Service quality, standards and compliance**
---------------------------------------------

* Ensure clean handoffs and clear escalation paths between Direct Access, People Solutions Advisors, People Experience Partners and specialist teams, so that cases sit at the right tier and are not passed unnecessarily.

* Monitor key performance indicators and service levels across the cluster, performing quality checks, analysing trends and implementing corrective action to maintain high standards.
* Drive standardisation of people processes and tools across the cluster, and enable people leaders to own routine people processes with timely support from HR.
* Ensure adherence to data privacy, employment and labour law and internal policy across the countries in your cluster, supporting audits and risk mitigation.

**Data, AI and digital enablement**
-----------------------------------

* Embed the use of people data, workforce analytics and AI-enabled tools in how the cluster works, using insight to identify trends, inform decisions and automate repeatable work.
* Drive adoption of digital HR platforms and self-service, so that People Experience Partner time is focused on higher-value and more complex people matters.
* Identify and deliver opportunities for automation, standardisation and process improvement in the cluster and in your practice area, sharing what works with the other clusters in the region.

**Skills and qualifications**
=============================

* Eight or more years of progressive Human Resources experience, including strong HR partnering experience in regional or global contexts.

* Deep expertise in at least one HR practice area — leave management, employee relations, compensation and benefits, or organisation design, learning and talent management — sufficient to act as the reference point for a region.
* Experience leading, coaching and developing others, whether as a people manager or as a team or workstream lead, with the ability to set priorities and enable on-the-job development.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organisational Psychology or a related field; a master's degree or professional HR certification is preferred.
* Proven experience in complex global matrix organisations, aligning priorities across regions, functions and geographies, and operating within a clustered, shared-service or tiered HR model.
* Knowledge of employment law and regulatory requirements across multiple countries, with the judgement to manage complex matters and the discipline to escalate appropriately.
* Credibility to influence and coach senior leaders and HR Business Leaders, with strong stakeholder management, facilitation and conflict management skills.

* Practical experience using people analytics, data visualisation, HR information systems and AI-enabled tools to inform decisions and improve service, with a track record of driving adoption.
* Change management experience delivering process and operating model change, with clear written and verbal communication, comfort with ambiguity, and willingness to travel regionally as required.

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  

* 10+ years in data governance, model risk, technology risk, compliance or a related analytical role.
* Bachelors degree in field like Computer Science, Information technology, Math, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance (with focus on analysis) etc. and/or relevant proven work experience is required

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

**Job Title: US Onboarding Analyst**

**Location:** Bengaluru

**Reports to:** Manager HR

**About Ceres India**

At Ceres India Private Limited, we support initiatives that help communities recover, rebuild, and strengthen resilience. As part of the Ceres Global network of companies, we contribute to disaster recovery, infrastructure restoration, environmental services, and critical response operations through engineering, technology, innovation, and operational excellence. From India, we help enable faster decisions, stronger delivery, and meaningful outcomes where they matter most. The purpose is at the core of what we do. We are building an environment where talent can do meaningful work, take ownership, grow with the business, and be part of something larger than themselves.

**Driven by Purpose, Powered by People**

At Ceres India, we believe you’re more than just an employee; you’re part of a team with a purpose and a meaningful mission. Every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope, helping communities recover and rebuild.

We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay, growth opportunities, travel, and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. If you show up with compassion, share the commitment, react with urgency, and deliver solutions, you’ll fit right in. We don’t just respond to challenges; we rise to them.

**What We Are Looking For**

The Onboarding Analyst – US Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end employee onboarding, ensuring a smooth and compliant transition for new hires using HRMS platforms such as Paycom. The role partners closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and IT teams to deliver an excellent new-hire experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage full-cycle onboarding for US employees (exempt and non-exempt).
* Initiate and track I-9 verification and E-Verify compliance
* Ensure completion of W-4, state tax forms, direct deposit, and policy acknowledgements
* Configure and maintain onboarding workflows in HRMS tool (Paycom preferred)
* Initiate and track pre-employment checks, documentation, drug screening vendors and compliance forms
* Coordinate with Payroll and Benefits teams for timely employee setup
* Ensure data accuracy across HR systems and employee records
* Communicate onboarding timelines and expectations to new hires and stakeholders
* Support audits, reporting, and HR metrics related to onboarding
* Troubleshoot HRMS system issues and provide user support

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 2-3 years of experience in US onboarding / HR operations
* Hands-on experience with HRMS tools – Paycom (preferred)
* Strong understanding of onboarding compliance and employment documentation
* Strong knowledge of US employment compliance (I-9, E-Verify, W-4, state new-hire reporting)
* Excellent attention to detail and data management skills
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination abilities
* Experience supporting US onboarding processes is a plus
* Flexibility to work across US Timezones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multi-state US onboarding
* Exposure to high-volume or remote onboarding
* Knowledge of US payroll and benefits processes
* Experience working with background check vendors

**What to Expect**

This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented role focused on delivering a seamless onboarding experience for new hires across the US. You'll manage multiple onboarding activities simultaneously, ensuring compliance with employment requirements while coordinating closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, IT, and hiring managers. Success in this role requires strong organization, accuracy, and the ability to adapt to changing hiring volumes and priorities while providing excellent support to new employees and stakeholders.

**Why Join Ceres India?**

At Ceres India, you won’t just have a job, you’ll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters.

We offer:

* A collaborative, mission-driven culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* The chance to make a lasting difference for communities.

MUFG Global Service Private Limited

Maintain confidentiality, data privacy and access controls for payroll and benefits information.



Provide dashboards covering service delivery, compliance, exceptions, risks and vendor performance.

Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Finance, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Procurement and Technology.

Partner with Workday and technology teams to improve data quality, controls, integrations, reporting and employee experience.



Lead or support implementations, user acceptance testing, change management and stabilization.



Use trend analysis to strengthen governance and support management decisions.

Lead, coach and develop team members across payroll, compliance and benefits administration.



Define responsibilities, service standards, review mechanisms and development priorities.



Promote ownership, collaboration, customer focus, risk awareness and continuous improvement.



Ensure process documentation, knowledge transfer and business continuity coverage.

title: Senior Manager, Global Benefits Solutions
description:
### **Senior Manager, Global Benefits Solutions**

* JR-164051
* Hybrid

* Bengaluru

* Human Resources

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

The Senior Manager, Global Benefits Solutions is responsible for the strategy and design of how Equinix's benefits programs are built, configured, and delivered through technology. Sitting within the Global Benefits Centre of Excellence, this role owns the end-to-end design of how benefits interact with systems, from eligibility rules and enrollment logic to data flows and configuration standards, across a 38-country footprint.

  
  

This is not a platform management role. It is a benefits system design and strategy role. The Senior Manager defines how benefits should work within systems like Equinix Benefits, Workday, and recognition platforms, setting the design standard, driving implementation, and ensuring that what employees experience matches what was intended.

The role provides senior input into platform decisions, annual change cycles, and cross-functional technology strategy, and acts as the primary benefits design voice in all HR technology conversations.

The role requires someone who understands both the benefits landscape and the systems that enable it, someone who can translate complex program requirements into scalable, compliant system design, and who has the judgment to govern risk, challenge vendors, and make sound trade-off decisions at enterprise scale.

Reporting – Senior Director, Global Benefits, Wellbeing & Recognition

  
  

**Responsibilities**

Key Accountabilities

The role carries accountability across five core areas:

Benefits System Design & Configuration Standards

* Own the strategy and design standard for how benefits programs are configured across all platforms, defining eligibility rules, enrollment logic, data flows, and end-to-end process design across all countries
* Ensure configuration decisions are intentional, consistent, and aligned with global program design principles, not inherited defaults or regional workarounds
* Take design ownership when new programs, plan changes, or country expansions require system configuration decisions
* Translate benefits program requirements into clear system design specifications for HRIT, vendor, and implementation teams
* Maintain a living design documentation library that captures configuration standards, decision rationale, and country-level variation rules
  

  

Global Benefits Platforms Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the global roadmap for benefits administration platforms, including Equinix Benefits and vendor solutions (e.g. PlanSource, Darwin, Benifex), defining priorities, sequencing, and phasing of platform enhancements, implementations, and annual change cycles
* Balance business needs, system constraints, risk, and capacity to drive effective platform decision-making
* Anticipate and plan for emerging technology requirements, ensuring the platforms roadmap supports future benefits strategy and global scaling needs
* Coordinate with HRIT, People Experience, and Payroll on implementation and annual review activity, acting as the senior owner for benefits systems outcomes across regions
  

  

Governance, Risk & Release Oversight

* Establish and oversee governance frameworks for benefits systems, including change control, release management, and risk mitigation
* Own readiness decision-making for major releases, implementations, and annual enrollment, ensuring testing standards and controls are consistently applied across platforms
* Proactively identify and manage system, data, and operational risks before they reach employees or create compliance exposure
  

  

Workday & HR Technology Leadership

* Serve as the senior benefits design lead for Workday implementations, enhancements, and integrations, defining how benefits requirements are translated into system configuration, not just flagging issues after the fact
* Partner with HRIT leadership to align benefits design requirements with the broader HR technology strategy and multi-year systems roadmap
* Ensure data integrity, eligibility accuracy, and payroll-adjacent controls are maintained across all integrated systems
  

  

Recognition Program Oversight & Vendor Strategy

* Own the strategy, governance, and evolution of Equinix's global recognition programs, including vendor strategy, platform design, and performance management
* Ensure recognition platforms are designed and configured to meet program objectives, scalable globally, and operationally effective across regions
* Own strategic vendor relationships across benefits platforms and recognition providers, setting expectations, managing escalations, and holding partners accountable for delivery
* Act as the senior point of contact for Benefits systems matters with HR, Finance, IT, and regional leaders
  

  

**Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field.

* CEBS designation or equivalent professional certification preferred
  

  

Experience

* 15+ experience leading global HR or benefits systems programs in complex, multi-country environments, with a strong focus on system design and strategy
* Deep expertise in benefits administration platforms and how benefits programs are configured within them, including hands-on experience with platforms such as PlanSource, Darwin, Benifex, or equivalents
* Strong experience partnering with Workday and HRIS teams on integrations and system changes, with the ability to define and defend benefits design requirements in technical forums
* Demonstrated experience overseeing recognition or rewards platforms, including vendor governance and program performance management
* Proven ability to manage risk, prioritize work, and make trade-off decisions at an enterprise level, comfortable with ambiguity and competing priorities
* Strong stakeholder influence and vendor management capability, able to hold senior partners accountable and build alignment across functions without formal authority
* Experience working within a global COE model, balancing central design governance with the operational realities of regional deployment
  

  

Skills and Attributes

* Strategic Design Ownership - Thinks upstream. Focused on how benefits should be designed and built to work in systems, not just whether systems are running. Brings intentionality to configuration decisions and sets a standard others can build on
* Strong Judgment and Prioritization - Makes clear decisions in complex, high-change environments. Able to weigh risk, business need, and capacity simultaneously and land on the right call without over-engineering the analysis
* Risk-Aware and Detail-Conscious - Balances speed with control and accuracy. Catches design and configuration issues early, and doesn't let urgency become a reason to compromise quality or governance
* Executive Presence - Credible and confident with senior HR, IT, Finance, and vendor leadership. Communicates platform strategy and design decisions clearly to non-technical audiences

description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: http://www.chubb.com/

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organisation that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details:**

**Job Title:** IGA Engineer

**Function/Department:** Security Engineering

**Location:** Hyderabad, Bangalore

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Engineer to design, develop, and configure robust identity management solutions on Chubb’s SailPoint IdentityNow (ISC) platform. In this role you will integrate the IGA platform with enterprise systems, build and maintain automated lifecycle processes, configure access certification campaigns, and contribute to the ongoing migration of applications from the legacy OIM platform to new platform. You will work closely with global IAM and project teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable technical configurations that streamline access control across the organisation. This role follows a hybrid working model based in India.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform end-to-end IGA application onboarding and development on SailPoint ISC, including access request catalogue configuration, UI customisations, access policy design, role management, and custom rule development.
* Configure and maintain SailPoint ISC connectors — including Active Directory / Entra ID, SCIM, JDBC, REST, and web-service connectors — to support seamless user lifecycle management across enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain BeanShell rules, Transform rules, and Provisioning Policies within SailPoint ISC to support custom lifecycle, aggregation, and provisioning logic.
* Design and support Identity Lifecycle Manager (LCM) processes — joiner, mover, leaver — ensuring automation aligns with HR and business-defined triggers.
* Configure and manage Access Certification (campaign) and Access Review processes to meet audit and compliance requirements.
* Integrate SailPoint ISC with enterprise platforms including Entra ID (Azure AD), PAM products, ServiceNow (ITSM), and other enterprise systems using REST APIs and SailPoint PAT-based authentication.
* Partner with project teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical designs, and validate solutions end-to-end.
* Support the ongoing migration of applications from Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) to SailPoint ISC, reviewing legacy OIM connector configurations and re-engineering them for ISC.
* Build and maintain automated monitoring capabilities to support system health and security compliance.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, resolve defects, and ensure stable performance of the IGA platform.
* Collaborate with cross-functional global teams — IAM Engineering, onboarding teams, Application teams, Audit, and ServiceNow — to deliver secure, efficient, and scalable identity solutions.
* Support ongoing platform enhancements, continuous improvement initiatives, and technical debt remediation.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in Identity Governance and Administration engineering
* 6-12 years of hands-on IGA engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver independently on assigned workstreams while collaborating effectively with global team members and stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityNow / ISC (required) — including Access Request, Lifecycle Manager, Certifications, Roles, Connectors, and the SailPoint ISC REST API. SailPoint IdentityNow Certified Engineer credential is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) is an advantage — knowledge of OIM connector types, adapter configuration, and reconciliation is valued in the context of OIM-to-ISC migration projects.
* Scripting proficiency in BeanShell and/or Java for IGA rule development within SailPoint ISC; REST API and JSON fluency for platform integrations and connector development.
* Experience working with Entra ID (Azure AD) and on-premises Active Directory, including connector configuration, group and role management, and lifecycle event handling.
* Experience with REST APIs and web services to enable system connectivity, automate identity-related processes, and support secure data exchange across enterprise applications.
* Experience integrating IGA platforms with ServiceNow for access request fulfilment and ticketing workflows is strongly preferred.
* Direct experience with SailPoint ISC connector types, including:
  + Active Directory / Entra ID Connector
  + SCIM 2.0 Connector
  + JDBC / Database Connector
  + Web Service / REST Connector
  + Virtual Appliance (VA) management
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams in a global, matrixed environment.
Experience working in agile/scrum delivery models within a global IAM team, including sprint planning, story estimation, and iterative release cycles.  

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.  

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!

Our constant focus on employee experience, along with a start-up-like culture, empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to Work: Chubb India has been recognised as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb, we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness, where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment  

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision-related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialised benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customised programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like a hybrid work environment, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.  

**Application Process**

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent and inclusive.

Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.

Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.

Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).

**Join Us**

With you, Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India’s journey.
