description:
**Job Description :**

**Job Title: Human Resource Operations Team Lead**
--------------------------------------------------

**About the Function:**
-----------------------

**Our Global Business Operations (GBO) team are facilitators, providing strategic, financial, and business services that are essential to the day-to-day performance of our business. With a team of over 2,000 dedicated and passionate people supporting 21 markets across the world, we have offices in Bangalore, Budapest, Bogota, and Manila.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our global remit offers huge learning opportunities. We encourage learning and development in skills needed now and in the future across digital, industry, professional, and domain. Wherever you start, you’ll be rewarded with a world view and the recognition you deserve in our inclusive and supportive culture.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**About the role:**
-------------------

**Diageo is the world’s leading premium drinks company with an outstanding collection of brands, such as Johnnie Walker, Smirnoff, Baileys, Captain Morgan, Tanqueray and Guinness. With over 200 brands in 180 countries and a global network of entrepreneurial individuals, our teams blend a diverse range of experience, knowledge and skills. We connect customers and consumers to our iconic products and build innovative experiences that bring people together to celebrate life.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**About the Function (GHRO)**
-----------------------------

**Global HR Operations (GHRO) is part of Diageo Business Services, providing HR support to ~23,000 employees in 70+ countries. Services include (among others) Resourcing, Onboarding, Offboarding, Compensation & Reward administration and Payroll. GHRO is foundational to delivering Diageo’s HR strategy and enabling an excellent employee & manager experience through consistent, trusted people processes.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Onboarding, Movers and Offboarding (JML) comprise the end-to-end activities associated with hire, move, and exit processes—designed to provide a brilliant employee experience and simple, reliable services for line managers.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Role Summary**
----------------

**The Senior Team Lead: HR Operations (First Point) – JML is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of Joiner, Mover and Leaver (JML) operations for the UKI and NAM markets, ensuring consistent execution, high quality customer experience, and rigorous compliance.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**This role leads and develops a high-performing First Point team and works across a complex customer network (HRBPs, line managers, employees, Diageo IS, process owners, and third-party providers). The role uses insights, analytics and continuous improvement methods to deliver agreed outcomes—SLA/KPI adherence, compliance, service perfection and operational efficiency.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**As a member of the First Point Operational** **Management/Leadership** **team, you will give to shaping and strengthening the global service delivery landscape.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Context / Scope**
-------------------

**First Point teams support employee lifecycle events including employee document generation and employee data maintenance in Workday, using enabling technologies such as ServiceNow (case management) and Doc Genie (where applicable). The work demands strong judgement, deep process understanding, and customer-centric execution.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Dimensions**
--------------

* **Market complexity: Multi-market coverage with a primary focus on UKI and NAM.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Leadership responsibility: Direct leadership of advisors/specialists across levels;** **collaboration/leadership** **across multiple locations (including partnership with teams in Budapest as relevant).**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Operational leadership: Key member of the First Point operational management team; drives performance, planning, prioritization, and delivery.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities-**
--------------------------------------------

**1) Service Delivery Excellence (JML – UKI & NAM)**
----------------------------------------------------

* **Own and deliver end-to-end JML operations (Onboarding, Movers, Offboarding) ensuring a brilliant, consistent customer experience for employees and line managers.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ensure service delivery meets or exceeds defined SLAs, KPIs and quality standards, including timeliness, accuracy, case resolution, and documentation quality.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Act as customer concern point for complex cases, service issues, and complaints—driving swift resolution and root-cause fixes.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**2) People Leadership & Capability Building**
----------------------------------------------

* **Recruit, coach, mentor and develop a high-performing, highly engaged team; build a culture of accountability, continuous learning and customer obsession.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ensure the team has the required Workday/process training and knowledge management to provide guide guidance and consistent execution.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Embed strong performance management: goal setting, coaching, quality calibration, and recognition.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**3) Continuous Improvement & Simplification**
----------------------------------------------

* **Drive the process improvement and simplification agenda across JML processes and enabling technologies (Workday, ServiceNow, document tools).**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Use operational metrics and customer insights to identify problems and deliver measurable improvements.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support global standardization while enabling effective local execution; lead change control and adoption within the team.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**4) Customer Partnership & Governance**
----------------------------------------

* **Partner closely with the global process owner(s) for** **Onboarding/Offboarding** **to strengthen process design and ensure operational readiness.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work directly with customer groups (HRBPs, managers, employees) and partner teams (Process Governance, Data, Payroll, IS, third parties) to ensure seamless end-to-end experience.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Give to operational governance—regular reviews, performance reporting, risk management, and customer communications.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**5) Compliance, Risk & Data Privacy (GDPR)**
---------------------------------------------

* **Act as an active ambassador for Diageo’s HR model and operational standards, holding teams and stakeholders accountable.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Raise awareness and demand compliance, with special focus on GDPR and internal controls; manage compliance breaches in line with Diageo procedures.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ensure accurate employee data maintenance and documentation standards across JML lifecycle activities.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**6) Analytics, Performance Management & Efficiency**
-----------------------------------------------------

* **Leverage analytics to manage performance—volume trends, backlog, quality, rework drivers, and root causes.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ensure consistent delivery of agreed SLAs/KPIs and embed a continuous improvement cadence.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support productivity and efficiency initiatives aligned with service strategy (including targeted efficiency improvements where applicable).**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**7) Project / Transition Support**
-----------------------------------

* **Provide proactive operational input for business projects such as restructures, annual HR cycles, and cross-functional initiatives.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for operational projects; manage scope, timeline, risks and change impacts.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with** **transition/governance** **teams to support sustainable service delivery transitions through clear governance, learning and experimentation.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What You Will Bring (Skills & Experience)**
---------------------------------------------

**Essential**
-------------

* **Shown people management experience in HR Operations, shared services, or service delivery environments.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong delivery track record against SLAs/KPIs, quality standards, and customer experience outcomes.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience working with Workday or comparable HRIS; confidence in navigating HR data/process interdependencies.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ability to engage, influence and build credibility with diverse stakeholders across multiple geographies and cultures.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated capability to lead change, simplify processes, and deliver continuous improvement initiatives.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong problem-solving skills—able to remove barriers and galvanize teams in ambiguity and fast-paced change.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong understanding of operational compliance and data privacy principles (including GDPR awareness).**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Fluency in English (written and spoken).**
  --------------------------------------------

**Desirable**
-------------

* **Advanced knowledge of Workday processes and navigation; experience with ServiceNow case management.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Exposure to document generation tools and operational controls (e.g., Doc Genie or equivalent).**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading multi-location or multi-lingual teams.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------
* **Additional language capability (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, French) is an advantage.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Prior experience in customer service/contact center environments (helpful for coaching, QA and service culture).**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Measures of Success -**
-------------------------

* **Consistent achievement of SLA/KPI targets across JML for UKI & NAM (timeliness, accuracy, resolution).**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improved customer experience metrics and reduced critical issues/complaints.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Reduced rework and errors through standard work, QA and training effectiveness.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Evidence of process simplification and measurable continuous improvement outcomes.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong team engagement, capability growth, and retention of critical skills.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong compliance posture with timely issue identification and closure.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Benefits & Culture-**
-----------------------

**Diageo offers a vibrant, inclusive environment and a broad set of benefits. Examples may include:**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Global collaboration (“work without borders”)**
  -------------------------------------------------
* **Access to extraordinary brand portfolio and employee communities/events**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Product allowance/discounts (location-specific)**
  ---------------------------------------------------
* **Wellbeing initiatives and fitness support (location-specific)**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------

***\*\*Benefits may vary by location and Diageo policy.***
----------------------------------------------------------

**Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------

**At Diageo, we celebrate diversity as a core enabler of our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of background, identity, or experience.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Experience / skills required:**
---------------------------------

**Flexible Working Statement: Flexibility is key to our success. From part-time and compressed hours to different locations, our people work flexibly in ways to suit them. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported from day one.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Diversity statement: Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We adopt diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you’ll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you. You’ll be part of and help build and champion an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different gender, ethnicity, ability, age, sexual orientation, social class, educational backgrounds, experiences, attitudes, and more.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer** **products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to the next level and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation of celebrations for consumers around the world.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you.**
------------------------------------------------------------

***If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you gain this information when you submit your application.***
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Worker Type :**

Regular

**Primary Location:**

Bangalore Karle Town SEZ

title: HR Generalist
description:
**HR Generalist**
=================

**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Work Mode:** On-site

**Experience:** 3–5 years

**About Habuild**
-----------------

Habuild is a fast-growing HealthTech company on a mission to help people build sustainable, healthy habits through yoga and technology. With a community of over 1.8 crore users, we are building technology-driven solutions that make wellness accessible to millions.

We are looking for an **HR Generalist** who can own the complete employee lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding to people operations, compliance, and employee engagement. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, takes ownership, and uses AI tools to make HR processes smarter and more efficient.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**1. People Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle, including offer letters, onboarding, employee records, attendance, leave management, and exit formalities.
* Maintain accurate employee documentation, HR databases, and personnel records.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, employee data, and monthly attendance and leave reconciliation.
* Build and improve HR processes, policies, and workflows to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

**2. Talent Acquisition**

* Own end-to-end hiring for business and technical roles, from understanding requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, offer management, and joining.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and build effective hiring pipelines.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience and drive timely hiring closures.
* Use AI tools and technology to improve sourcing, screening, communication, and recruitment efficiency.

**3. HR Compliance & Policies**

* Ensure adherence to applicable Indian HR and employment compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, and POSH.
* Maintain statutory records, employee documentation, and compliance-related trackers.
* Support the implementation and regular review of HR policies and processes.
* Coordinate with external consultants or vendors wherever required for payroll and statutory compliance.

**4. Performance Management & Employee Engagement**

* Coordinate performance review cycles, feedback collection, and appraisal processes.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, internal communication, and workplace culture-building activities.
* Assist in employer branding initiatives and strengthen Habuild’s positioning as an employer of choice.
* Act as a reliable point of contact for employees on HR-related queries and workplace matters.

**5. AI-Driven HR Operations**

* Use AI tools regularly to streamline HR workflows, improve productivity, and reduce manual effort.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks across recruitment, documentation, employee communication, and reporting.
* Demonstrate practical examples of how AI tools have improved the quality, speed, or efficiency of your HR work.

**Must-Have Requirements**
--------------------------

* **3–5 years of HR experience** in a startup or product-based company, with hands-on exposure to both people operations and talent acquisition.
* Experience owning the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee records, leave and attendance, payroll inputs, and exits.
* Working knowledge of Indian HR compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, and POSH.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end hiring for actual business or technical roles.
* **Strong AI proficiency:** Regularly uses AI tools in day-to-day HR work and can demonstrate practical use cases or workflows.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication skills, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Good-to-Have Requirements**
-----------------------------

* Experience as the first HR hire or in building HR processes from scratch at a startup.
* Experience hiring for engineering, product, or other technical roles.
* Exposure to employer branding and recruitment marketing.
* Experience running performance review and appraisal cycles.
* Proficiency in both Hindi and English.

**Who Should Apply?**
---------------------

We are looking for a well-rounded HR professional who combines **people operations, hiring, compliance, and technology-enabled problem-solving**.

This role is not suited to candidates whose experience is limited exclusively to recruitment, payroll, administration, or agency/RPO hiring. We value candidates who have worked across multiple HR functions and can demonstrate genuine ownership of processes from start to finish.

If you enjoy building systems, solving people-related challenges, and using AI to make HR more effective, we’d love to hear from you.

title: HR Executive
description:
Job Title: Human Resources Executive  
Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month  
Job Location: Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
Job Type: Full-time Experience: 2–4 years preferred

Job Description

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Executive to manage end-to-end recruitment, employee relations, HR operations, attendance, performance management, and company policies. The ideal candidate should be capable of maintaining a structured, disciplined, and performance-driven work environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end recruitment, including job postings, resume screening, candidate sourcing, interviews, and follow-ups.
* Recruit candidates for digital marketing, sales, academic counselling, aviation, and other business departments.
* Coordinate interview schedules, salary negotiations, offer letters, and joining formalities.
* Handle employee onboarding, induction, documentation, and maintenance of employee records.
* Monitor daily attendance, leave management, punctuality, and employee discipline.
* Coordinate with team leaders and managers to establish and monitor employee KPIs.
* Track employee performance, probation reviews, appraisals, and performance improvement plans.
* Address employee grievances, workplace conflicts, and employee engagement activities.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, incentives, attendance records, and exit formalities with the accounts team.
* Ensure employees follow company policies, reporting structures, and standard operating procedures.
* Prepare weekly recruitment reports and monthly HR performance reports for management.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and ensure proper documentation.
* Support management in improving employee productivity, retention, and organisational workflow.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in HR operations and recruitment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment processes and candidate sourcing platforms.
* Good communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and HR documentation.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple hiring requirements.
* Ability to handle employee matters professionally and enforce company policies fairly.
* A proactive, disciplined, and target-oriented approach to work.

Salary & Benefits

* Monthly salary: ₹25,000–₹35,000, depending on experience and skills.
* Opportunity to work closely with management and department heads.
* Professional growth and exposure to recruitment, HR operations, and performance management.
* Opportunity to contribute to building structured company processes and a strong workplace culture.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume, current salary, expected salary, notice period, and relevant HR experience.

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: In person, Koramangala, Bengaluru.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

Job Description

Darwinbox- one of Asia’s fastest Unicorns based out of DIFC, Dubai - is a mobile-first, AI-enabled cloud-based HR platform that partners with enterprises to unlock their HR potential. They automate an organization’s HR needs across the entire hire-to-retire employee lifecycle from Recruitment, Onboarding, Core transactions (Leave, attendance & Payroll) to engagement, Performance Management and People Analytics.

They support 800+ global enterprises covering 2+million employees across 143 countries (e.g., Nivea, Starbucks, Sephora, Zara, and AXA, along with Ghassan Aboud, Al Zayani, Property Finder, EFS Facilities Services, Jashanmal, Alinco, Lulu Group in the region). With marquee investors including the likes of Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia, TCV- they are the only Asian origin vendor on Gartner’s Magic Quadrant and are rated the highest globally at 4.8/5 Gartner’s customer review platform- Peer Insights.

You will serve as a bridge between business needs and technology, leveraging your expertise to drive impactful outcomes in workforce management. You will focus on improving customer engagement, product adoption, and ensuring long-term partnerships, while also identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities to maximize customer value.

* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Work closely with sales, marketing, and product development teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and a unified product roadmap.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders, using client feedback to influence product innovation and enhancements.

* **Experience:** Minimum 6+ years of experience in customer success or a similar role within the HR or HCM space, with a proven track record of driving customer outcomes and identifying cross-sell/upsell opportunities.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment while balancing strategic thinking and execution.

title: Talent Lead- Bengaluru, IND
description:
**About Diversified:**  
Diversified is a global leader in audio visual and media innovation, recognized for designing and building the world’s most experiential environments. Our award-winning team specializes in delivering solutions for the most complex, large-scale and immersive installations. Serving a global clientele that includes major media organizations and retailers, sports and live performance venues, corporate enterprises, and government agencies, Diversified partners with clients to create spaces that bring people together and keep them coming back.
  
  
**What to Expect:**  
At Diversified, we're on a mission to create a world without boundaries, where technology enables all people to connect and experience the moments that matter, wherever they choose to be. With clients spanning the globe and an exciting pipeline of projects across industries, Diversified offers more than just a job. We offer a career path with the flexibility to grow personally and professionally, wherever your ambitions take you.
  
As a Diversified associate, you'll dive headfirst into big, complex, and rewarding projects that push the boundaries of what's possible. Plus, you'll enjoy a flexible work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
  
IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, YOU CAN DO IT AT DIVERSIFIED.
  
  
Talent Acquisition Lead
  
India | Global Talent Acquisition
  

* Shift Timing - IST 5 PM - 2 AM

Overview of Position
  
The Talent Acquisition Lead is responsible for implementing talent acquisition processes across Diversified’s global operations, including the US, Canada, EMEA, Australia and India. Based in Bangalore, this position will lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists supporting sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer coordination, helping deliver consistent service and an outstanding experience for internal and external candidates.
  
The Talent Acquisition Lead partners with global (US-based) Talent Acquisition leadership, regional HR teams, and hiring leaders to translate agreed processes into practical workflows, support adoption, and contribute ideas for improvement. Success requires demonstrated experience implementing comparable recruitment processes across regions, excellent spoken and written English, and the ability to use ATS and candidate data to improve hiring efficiency and service quality.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  

* Implement talent acquisition processes globally, adapting execution to regional requirements in partnership with local HR while maintaining consistent standards.
* Develop and execute rollout plans covering process documentation, responsibilities, training, milestones, and adoption tracking; identify barriers and coordinate practical solutions with the appropriate leaders.
* Establish clear workflows and service expectations from requisition intake through sourcing, interview scheduling, offer coordination, and handoff to onboarding.
* Lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists through training, regular feedback, quality reviews, and hands-on support for complex or urgent needs.
* Help coordinate team priorities, monitor capacity and service delivery, and work with the appropriate leaders to address bottlenecks across regions and time zones.
* Ensure sourcing aligns with role requirements and agreed recruiting strategies, interview scheduling is responsive, and offer documentation and approvals are accurate and timely.
* Work collaboratively with senior leaders and hiring teams to understand hiring needs, share progress, and contribute practical ideas that support effective recruitment.
* Partner with recruiters, HRBPs, hiring managers, and external recruitment partners to clarify responsibilities, address questions, and support consistent follow-through.
* Provide a professional, respectful candidate experience through timely updates, clear interview instructions, reliable coordination, and appropriate communication when candidates are not selected.
* Gather candidate and hiring manager feedback and implement improvements to communication, scheduling, and offer processes that reflect Diversified’s values and employer brand.
* Partner with HR Operations and technology teams to align ATS workflows, templates, approvals, and reporting with the global process; support consistent system use and accurate records.
* Analyze ATS utilization, open requisition aging, time to fill, time to hire, time in stage, sourcing effectiveness, candidate conversion, withdrawals, and offer acceptance.
* Prepare recurring dashboards and concise reporting that explain trends, identify bottlenecks, recommend actions, and track the impact of process improvements.
* Establish consistent metric definitions and data quality checks with HR Operations; protect candidate confidentiality and follow company policies and applicable regional requirements in partnership with local HR.

Qualifications
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
* Experience: 8+ years of progressive talent acquisition or recruitment operations experience, including at least 3 years leading, guiding, and coaching a recruitment or talent acquisition support team.
* Global Implementation Experience: Demonstrated success implementing standardized recruitment processes across multiple countries or regions, including supporting US stakeholders from India or another global delivery location. Must provide concrete examples of personal ownership from planning through adoption and measurable outcomes.
* Team Leadership: Proven experience leading, guiding, and coaching specialists responsible for sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer preparation or coordination.
* English Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is essential, including the ability to participate effectively in discussions with senior leaders, share ideas clearly, write polished candidate communications, and explain data and process changes.
* Systems and Analytics: Strong working knowledge of enterprise ATS platforms, recruitment workflows, reporting, and data quality practices. Strong Excel skills and the ability to translate recruitment data into practical recommendations. Dayforce ATS and Power BI experience preferred.
* Skills and Competencies: Strong relationship-building, coaching, process implementation, problem-solving, and organizational skills; sound judgment and the ability to balance competing priorities and support change.
* Global Collaboration: Ability to work across cultures and time zones, with planned overlap with US and other regional business hours. Experience building or scaling global recruitment operations or shared services preferred.
* Industry Experience: Experience supporting technology, engineering, or project delivery recruitment preferred.

Key Success Metrics
  

* Delivers agreed global rollout milestones and achieves consistent process adoption across participating regions.
* Strengthens specialist capability and improves responsiveness, accuracy, and completion of sourcing, scheduling, and offer coordination activities.
* Improves ATS utilization, data completeness, and timely updates to requisition and candidate records.
* Reduces avoidable delays, aged open requisitions, and time spent in hiring stages against agreed baselines and targets.
* Improves candidate and hiring manager feedback, candidate progression, and offer acceptance through better communication and coordination.
* Provides accurate, timely reporting and recommendations that result in measurable recruitment process improvements.

**What We Offer:**  
Along with competitive compensation, you will be eligible for the following benefits:
  

* Multiple medical plan for self and family
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, and Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Commuter & Shift Benefits (US / APAC shifts)

To learn more about becoming part of the Diversified team, visit us at https://onediversified.com/careers/careers-at-diversified or email us at careers@onediversified.com.
  
  
Diversified is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All aspects of employment will be based on job requirements, individual qualifications, merit, performance, and business need.
  
  
We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
  
  
We believe in fair and equitable hiring practices and strive to create an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered.

title: Placement Manager
description:
# Job Description

## Placement Senior Manager / Manager – CDOE

\*\*Organisation:\*\* Shoolini University

\*\*Centre:\*\* Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE)

\*\*Location:\*\* Bangalore/Bangaluru

\*\*Experience:\*\* 5–10 years

\*\*Qualification:\*\* MBA or Postgraduate Degree preferred

\*\*Department:\*\* Career Services & Corporate Relations

### About Shoolini University – CDOE

Shoolini University’s Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE) is committed to delivering accessible, industry-relevant education that empowers learners to advance their careers. The Centre aims to strengthen employability through industry engagement, career development initiatives, corporate partnerships, and placement support for distance and online education learners.

### Role Overview

Shoolini University is seeking an experienced and results-oriented Placement Senior Manager / Manager to lead placement and career advancement initiatives for CDOE learners. The role will focus on building strong corporate relationships, developing employment opportunities, facilitating recruitment drives, and creating career pathways for MBA, postgraduate, and other eligible learners.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of corporate hiring requirements, proven experience in placements or talent acquisition, excellent networking skills, and the ability to drive measurable placement outcomes across industries.

### Key Responsibilities

\*\*1. Corporate Relations & Employer Partnerships\*\*

- Develop and manage relationships with corporates, recruitment agencies, industry bodies, and potential hiring partners.

- Build a strong employer network across sectors such as IT/ITeS, BFSI, consulting, FMCG, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and emerging industries.

- Identify employment opportunities aligned with the qualifications, experience, and career aspirations of CDOE learners.

- Establish strategic hiring partnerships, including preferred hiring arrangements, recruitment collaborations, and internship opportunities where applicable.

\*\*2. Placement Strategy & Execution\*\*

- Develop and implement placement strategies for eligible MBA, postgraduate, and other CDOE learners.

- Drive placement opportunities through campus recruitment, virtual hiring drives, off-campus recruitment, job fairs, and employer-led recruitment campaigns.

- Coordinate end-to-end placement activities, from employer outreach and candidate shortlisting to interview scheduling, offer management, and joining follow-ups.

- Facilitate lateral hiring opportunities for working professionals seeking career progression or a transition into new roles.

- Develop placement plans and hiring calendars aligned with learner profiles and employer requirements.

\*\*3. Career Development & Learner Engagement\*\*

- Assess learner profiles, work experience, skills, and career aspirations to improve job-role alignment.

- Coordinate with academic teams to identify employability gaps and support relevant training, resume-building, interview preparation, and career counselling initiatives.

- Organise webinars, industry interactions, career talks, mock interviews, and employer engagement sessions.

- Guide learners on job search strategies, professional networking, interview readiness, and career advancement.

\*\*4. Employer & Recruitment Ecosystem Development\*\*

- Build and maintain a database of hiring organisations, recruiters, job opportunities, and placement outcomes.

- Engage with HR leaders, talent acquisition heads, business leaders, and recruitment consultants to understand workforce requirements.

- Explore partnerships for internships, apprenticeships, live projects, and other relevant experiential opportunities.

- Maintain regular communication with employers to gather feedback and strengthen long-term hiring relationships.

\*\*5. Placement Operations, MIS & Reporting\*\*

- Track and report placement-related KPIs, including employer partnerships, job opportunities, interview participation, offers, joining rates, and learner engagement.

- Maintain accurate placement records, employer databases, recruitment calendars, and management dashboards.

- Prepare periodic placement reports and present progress, challenges, and improvement plans to university leadership.

- Ensure transparent communication with learners and employers throughout the recruitment process.

- Track outcomes in accordance with institutional placement policies and applicable guidelines.

\*\*6. Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination\*\*

- Lead and coordinate placement executives or career services team members, as applicable.

- Work closely with CDOE leadership, academic departments, learner support teams, and marketing teams to improve placement participation and outcomes.

- Develop standard operating procedures for employer engagement, placement drives, learner communication, and reporting.

- Contribute to continuous improvement in the overall career services experience for distance and online learners.

### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Number of active corporate hiring partnerships established.

- Number of relevant job opportunities generated for eligible learners.

- Number of recruitment drives and employer engagement initiatives conducted.

- Learner participation, interview conversion, offer conversion, and joining rates.

- Placement outcomes segmented by programme, experience level, industry, and job role.

- Employer satisfaction and repeat hiring partnerships.

- Timeliness and accuracy of placement MIS and management reporting.

### Eligibility Criteria

- MBA or a relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

- 5–10 years of relevant experience in university placements, corporate relations, talent acquisition, recruitment consulting, career services, or employability initiatives.

- Demonstrated experience in developing employer relationships and generating job opportunities.

- Strong understanding of recruitment processes, hiring trends, and corporate talent requirements.

- Experience working with MBA graduates, postgraduate candidates, experienced professionals, or online/distance education learners would be an advantage.

- Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deliver measurable business or placement outcomes.

### Required Skills & Competencies

- Excellent corporate networking, relationship management, and business development skills.

- Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to engage senior HR professionals and business decision

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

title: Learning Technology Solutions Manager
description:

I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Learning Technology Solutions Manager reports to the Learning & Development Solutions Lead in a Global Capability Center. Two positions will share responsibility for administering, governing, and optimizing the Learning and Talent Management technology portfolio. Product assignments will reflect evolving business and portfolio needs and may include established, emerging, and newly launched technologies. Together, the roles enable Takeda curators, learners, people leaders, and other users to access and effectively leverage the portfolio.

Working across global teams and time zones, this role is a hands-on partner and primary point of support for platform users and curators. It resolves tickets, troubleshoots product challenges, manages licenses and access, delivers training, and advises enterprise and functional teams on effective use of the portfolio. Key partners include product owners, technology teams, vendors, shared services, and functional learning teams, including GSQ and DD&T where applicable.

How you will contribute:

* Administer an assigned group of learning technology products, including configuration, access, permissions, publishing, testing, maintenance, and issue resolution.
* Adapt product responsibilities with the other Learning Technology Solutions Manager as technologies, priorities, capacity, and user needs evolve.
* Support readiness, launch, adoption, and transition to operations for new and emerging products.
* Triage and resolve user and curator tickets; investigate root causes, coordinate escalations, and communicate solutions and workarounds.
* Guide curators and users on how to use, manage, and optimize platforms; deliver onboarding, training, office hours, demonstrations, job aids, FAQs, and self-service resources.
* Manage licenses, subscriptions, access, utilization, renewals, and records with product owners, procurement, vendors, and technology teams.
* Partner with enterprise and functional learning teams, including GSQ and DD&T where applicable, to recommend scalable technology solutions and avoid unnecessary customization or duplication.
* Use ticket trends, feedback, license data, and analytics to identify product gaps, adoption barriers, and improvement opportunities.
* Maintain product documentation, governance standards, release communications, and knowledge articles; coordinate releases, incidents, enhancements, integrations, risks, and service improvements.

Skills and qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and 5 years of relevant experience in learning technology, platform administration, product support, learning operations, HR technology, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience supporting digital learning platforms such as BLOOM, Novo-Ed, Synthesia, content hubs, learning pathways, or similar products.
* Experience with ticket management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident escalation, user support, and knowledge management.
* Experience managing licenses, subscriptions, access, permissions, utilization, vendor relationships, and renewals.
* Ability to train and enable curators and users through demonstrations, facilitation, documentation, job aids, and self-service resources.
* Strong consultative skills, with the ability to translate enterprise or functional needs into practical, scalable technology solutions.
* Working knowledge of content curation, platform governance, metadata, testing, accessibility, quality assurance, and lifecycle management.
* Strong service orientation, problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to manage priorities and influence global, cross-functional stakeholders.

This role combines hands-on platform administration, troubleshooting, user and curator enablement, license management, and technology consultation. Its primary focus is delivering reliable, scalable, and user-centered learning technology products and services, with solution design and content curation consultation as needed.

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Crew Tech Lead
description:
**Organization**

At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.

  

**Job Title:** Crew Tech Lead

  

**Location:** Bengaluru

  

**Business & Team:**

Finance Core Platforms is responsible for the technology foundations that support the Bank’s core financial accounting, consolidation, close, reconciliation and financial reporting processes. The crew has primary technology accountability for Oracle PeopleSoft General Ledger, commonly referred to as PSGL, and the Oracle EPM platform, including the capabilities used for financial consolidation, account reconciliation, management and statutory reporting.

These platforms process and hold critical financial information and support Group financial close, financial control, statutory and regulatory reporting, liquidity reporting and downstream finance processes. The crew is responsible for the availability, integrity, security, engineering, integration and ongoing modernisation of these platforms.

As Crew Tech Lead, you will be the senior technology leader accountable for the engineering direction, architecture, lifecycle and operational performance of PSGL and Oracle EPM. You will combine strong knowledge of Oracle finance applications with an understanding of financial accounting, consolidation, close, reconciliation and reporting processes.

You will work closely with the Crew Lead, Finance business owners, architecture, engineering teams, Oracle and strategic delivery partners to set the target-state direction for these platforms. You will be expected to understand how configuration, customisation, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor product decisions affect finance processes, controls, reporting outcomes and long-term platform sustainability.

  

**Impact & contribution:**

* A clear, endorsed technology strategy and roadmap for PSGL and Oracle EPM, covering sustainability, simplification, lifecycle management and target-state direction.
* Measurable improvement in the resilience, security, recoverability and operational performance of PSGL and EPM.
* Reduced platform customisation and technical debt, with documented treatment plans for remaining material items.
* Improved engineering automation across testing, deployment, configuration assurance, monitoring and operational controls.
* Reliable delivery of upgrades and change without disruption to critical finance close and reporting periods.
* Clear ownership and traceability of integrations and financial data flows into and out of PSGL and EPM.
* Stronger internal Oracle and finance-platform engineering capability, with reduced key-person and supplier dependency.
* Transparent vendor performance, licensing, investment and product-roadmap decisions.
* Earlier identification and resolution of issues that could affect ledger integrity, consolidation, reconciliation or statutory and regulatory reporting.
Finance stakeholders have confidence that the platforms are safe, supportable and aligned to the future direction of Finance.  

**Reporting lines:** Engineering General Manager

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Technology strategy and engineering leadership**

* Set and own the technology strategy and roadmap for PSGL and Oracle EPM, aligned with the Bank’s finance strategy, enterprise architecture, data strategy and engineering standards.

* Provide credible technical leadership across Oracle PeopleSoft Financials and Oracle EPM, including application architecture, configuration, customisation, integration, data movement, security, environments, testing, release management and production support.

* Understand the engineering characteristics of vendor platforms and establish fit-for-purpose engineering practices covering source and configuration management, automated testing, deployment, environment management, observability, resilience and release assurance.

* Determine where requirements should be met through product configuration, platform extensions, custom engineering, integration services or changes to business processes.

* Challenge unnecessary customisation and define a deliberate strategy for simplifying the platforms, reducing technical debt and maintaining viable upgrade and migration pathways.

* Own the architectural direction for integrations into and out of PSGL and Oracle EPM, including ledger feeds, reference data, reporting, reconciliation, close and downstream data consumption.

* Assess Oracle product roadmaps, releases and service changes and translate them into implications, decisions and investment priorities for the Bank.

* Ensure material platform decisions consider finance controls, data integrity, auditability, traceability, security, resilience, vendor supportability and whole-of-life cost.

Maintain an informed view of the future ERP and EPM landscape and guide the transition from current platforms toward agreed target-state capabilities.  

  

**Finance domain and platform leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Develop a strong understanding of the end-to-end finance processes supported by PSGL and Oracle EPM, including general ledger processing, journal management, chart of accounts and chart-field management, financial close, consolidation, reconciliations, management reporting, statutory reporting and regulatory reporting.
* Translate finance requirements and control obligations into clear platform, architecture and engineering outcomes.
* Understand the flow of financial data from source systems and sub-ledgers into PSGL, through consolidation and reconciliation, and into downstream reporting and data platforms.
* Ensure technology changes preserve accounting integrity, balanced postings, reconciliation, lineage, auditability and the ability to reproduce financial outcomes.
* Partner with Finance leaders, financial controllers, system accountants, Product Owners and technology teams to identify root causes rather than treating technology symptoms in isolation.
* Set direction across current-state sustainability, platform simplification and longer-term ERP/EPM modernisation.
Evaluate the implications of introducing new finance capabilities into or around PSGL and EPM, including the impact on finance processes, controls, integration, operating model and vendor dependency.  

**Portfolio, program and change leadership**
--------------------------------------------

* Lead the PSGL and Oracle EPM change portfolio, balancing regulatory, financial-close, resilience, lifecycle, security, simplification and business-change priorities.
* Oversee major Oracle upgrades, patches, SaaS releases, integration changes and platform migrations, ensuring appropriate impact assessment, testing, cutover and business readiness.
* Establish release and environment strategies that protect critical finance periods, including month-end, quarter-end, year-end and external reporting cycles.
* Ensure business, engineering, operational and control readiness is established before material platform changes are implemented.
* Maintain clear governance over platform customisations, technical debt, product gaps, vendor dependencies and modernisation decisions.
Lead option assessments for material platform decisions, including configuration versus customisation, vendor capability versus internal engineering, and tactical versus strategic solutions.  

**Planning, risk and dependencies**
-----------------------------------

* Partner with the Crew Lead to translate business priorities into an executable portfolio and represent the Crew Lead in planning, operations and governance when required
* Support quarterly planning and cross-domain dependency forums, ensuring the crew’s priorities and constraints are understood and appropriately represented.
* Identify material risks, interdependencies, issues and impediments early; establish mitigation, ownership, escalation and resolution strategies.
* Provide strategic guidance to Product Owners, Crew Leads and delivery leaders to resolve complex issues and protect critical outcomes.
* Maintain an integrated roadmap covering PSGL, Oracle EPM, infrastructure, integrations, data dependencies, vendor releases and finance business milestones.
* Identify and actively manage dependencies across source systems, sub-ledgers, PSGL, EPM, reconciliation platforms, reporting platforms and enterprise data services.
* Protect critical finance events through appropriate release controls, blackout periods, operational readiness, contingency planning and heightened support.
* Ensure risks relating to financial data integrity, reconciliation, reporting completeness, platform availability, vendor changes and unsupported technology are clearly understood and owned.
* Define measurable lifecycle plans for platform upgrades, customisation reduction, automation, resilience improvement and eventual migration or retirement.
Ensure significant engineering decisions include documented options, business and non-functional requirements, risks, cost and target-state alignment.  

**People and capability leadership**
------------------------------------

* Build and sustain internal capability across Oracle PeopleSoft Financials, PeopleTools, Oracle EPM, finance-platform integration, testing and production engineering.
* Reduce dependency on individual specialists and external suppliers by strengthening documentation, cross-skilling, succession planning and internal technical leadership.

* Establish clear technical ownership across PSGL, Oracle EPM and their supporting integrations.

* Ensure engineers understand the finance processes and control outcomes supported by the platforms, not only the underlying technology.

* Develop engineering leaders who can operate effectively across packaged applications, SaaS services, legacy infrastructure and modern integration and automation practices.

Determine the appropriate balance of internal capability, Oracle expertise, strategic partners and specialist vendors.  



**Stakeholder, commercial and supplier leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Act as the senior technology counterpart for Oracle across PSGL and EPM product strategy, service performance, incidents, support, roadmap, licensing and commercial discussions.
* Hold Oracle and other delivery partners accountable for product quality, defect resolution, release transparency, service performance and committed outcomes.

* Translate Oracle product and licensing proposals into clear technology, finance, operational and whole-of-life cost implications.

* Maintain transparent oversight of software licensing, support agreements, cloud consumption, specialist services and partner capability.

* Work closely with Finance executives and platform owners to ensure product decisions reflect business priorities rather than being driven solely by vendor roadmaps.

Lead material vendor escalations where platform defects or service changes place financial close, reporting or control outcomes at risk.  



**Essential Skills:**

* Significant leadership experience with Oracle PeopleSoft Financials, particularly General Ledger, or a comparable enterprise-grade finance ERP platform.

* Strong experience with Oracle Enterprise Performance Management capabilities, preferably including Financial Consolidation and Close, Account Reconciliation, Essbase and EPM integration tooling.

* Demonstrated understanding of engineering and delivery practices for packaged enterprise applications, including configuration management, customisation, integration, automated testing, release management, patching, upgrades and production support.

* Strong understanding of core finance processes, including general ledger, journals, chart of accounts, financial close, consolidation, reconciliations, financial controls, statutory reporting and regulatory reporting.

* Experience setting technology strategy and roadmaps for critical finance platforms in a large, highly governed organisation.

* Demonstrated ability to translate finance requirements into platform architecture, engineering priorities and measurable technology outcomes.

* Experience managing complex integrations between source systems, sub-ledgers, enterprise finance platforms, reconciliation tools, reporting systems and data platforms.

* Experience managing material vendor relationships, software licensing, product roadmaps, managed services and major incident escalation.

* Demonstrated leadership of platform upgrades, lifecycle remediation, customisation reduction or major ERP/EPM transformation.

* Strong understanding of auditability, data integrity, reconciliation, security, resilience and operational controls within financial systems.

* Oracle People Tools and PeopleSoft application lifecycle experience.

* Oracle EPM Cloud experience across FCCS, ARCS, Essbase, EDMCS, EPM Automate or equivalent capabilities.

* Experience with Oracle integration patterns and enterprise data integration.

* Experience modernising legacy finance platforms or preparing for transition to a SaaS ERP/EPM target state.

* Experience operating critical financial platforms through month-end, year-end and external reporting periods.

* Financial-services experience in a regulated organisation.

Accounting or finance qualifications, or demonstrated equivalent finance-domain expertise.  



**Education Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Engineering

title: Global Head - Travel & Hospitality
description:
Job Title: Global Head - Travel & Hospitality

City: Bengaluru

State/Province: Karnataka

Posting Start Date: 10/13/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

The Global Head of Travel & Hospitality owns Wipro's end-to-end travel and hospitality value chain for ~250,000 employees across 65+ countries . The role is accountable for four integrated sub-functions: Travel Operations (delivered through WTSL, Wipro's in-house IATA-accredited 24×7 travel management company operating as a profit centre with its own P&L), Hospitality & Guest House reservations, Airlines & Hotel Contracting & RFP Management, and MICE bookings (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Events).

The mandate is to run Travel & Hospitality as a control-and-value lever: driving measurable cost optimisation through airline and hotel supplier leverage, GDS/PCC fare economics, PLB and segment-income retention, and the structural advantage of the in-house TMC model; enforcing global travel policy, duty-of-care governance and GST-compliant contracting at source; and continuously elevating the traveller experience through self-booking adoption, disruption management and AI-enabled tooling.

Lead the travel-side AI and agentic-AI transformation agenda across the full trip lifecycle, owns travel integration for acquired entities, Expected business impact includes double-digit annual travel cost savings, sustained travel SLAs of 92%+ and hospitality SLAs of 95%+, guest-house utilisation of 80%+, and crisis-response capability of under 30 minutes for Tier-1 travel-risk events.

**͏Roles & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

**1. Functional Responsibilities**

* **WTSL & Travel Operations —** Own strategy, P&L and 24×7 operations of the in-house IATA-accredited TMC (WTSL): airline and hotel commercial negotiation, corporate fare-code and restricted-RBD deal structures, GDS/PCC fare filing and rate loading, PLB and segment-income optimisation, BSP settlement, and ADM/ACM recovery.
* **Hotel Contracting & RFP —** Own the global hotel RFP programme end-to-end — rate negotiation, Last Room Availability and value-add contracting, zero-markup net-rate delivery, GST-compliant invoicing at source, and contract continuity with no rate gap at renewal.
* **Hospitality & Guest Houses —** Run guest-house reservation management and hospitality SLA governance globally; own utilisation, cost-per-night and guest-experience metrics; manage the hospitality supplier ecosystem.
* **MICE —** Own MICE demand end-to-end — group bookings
* **Policy & Booking Compliance —** Enforce travel policy at the point of booking through the self-booking and pre-trip approval stack (SAP Concur and internal approval platforms); drive self-booking adoption and in-policy booking rates while protecting employee experience.
* **AI & Digital Transformation —** Lead the travel-lifecycle AI transformation — embedded AI in booking and servicing tools, agentic automation of traveller and approver actions (including disruption management), and predictive intelligence ahead of trip decisions — framed as behaviour, controls and automation, not a systems implementation.
* **Duty of Care & Travel Risk —** Co-own traveller risk management with Global Security Team.
* **M&A Travel Integration —** Own travel integration for acquired entities — booking-platform migration, policy harmonisation, traveller communication and go-live stabilisation — using a repeatable M&A integration playbook.
* **Sustainability & ESG —** Deliver carbon data coverage across bookings, Scope 3 emissions reporting readiness (CSRD), and sustainability clauses in all travel and hospitality vendor contracts.
* **Governance Cadence —** Publish the monthly Travel & Hospitality governance scorecard and quarterly programme reporting to senior leadership; maintain auditable SLA tracking through enterprise IT service management.

**͏**
-----

**2. Stakeholder Management**

* **Leadership reporting —** Report to the Head of Global Operations with a regular review cadence; represent the function to the CHRO organisation with impact-forward reporting on savings, SLAs, transformation and risk posture.
* **CFO & Finance partnership —** Own the WTSL P&L narrative with Finance — retained-income economics (PLB, segment income, hotel commissions), net operating cost, and the evidence base for the build-versus-buy case for the in-house TMC model, including independent fare audits.
* **Cross-functional partnership —** Partner with the Global Security Group on duty of care and crisis response; with CIO/BITS on booking-platform integrations; with the payables/FSS organisation on IATA and hotel settlement; and with HR on policy harmonisation and traveller communications.
* **External & supplier ecosystem —** Own senior relationships with airlines, hotel chains and consortia, the GDS provider, and travel-technology vendors; protect the function's ownership of travel partner management while collaborating constructively with central procurement on negotiations.
* **Traveller voice —** Champion the traveller experience at leadership level — CSAT/NPS accountability for travel and hospitality touchpoints, executive and VIP desk service standards, and change-management communication for every major rollout.

**͏**
-----

**3. Team Management**

* **Organisation leadership —** Lead a multi-layered global organisation across Travel Operations, Hospitality, MICE and special projects/analytics, operating 24×7 across time zones.
* **Succession & capability building —** Build succession depth in an operations-heavy team: develop strategic and analytical capability in operational leaders, manage planned retirements and leadership transitions without service disruption, and absorb talent from acquired entities into the operating structure.
* **Performance management —** Calibrate leadership style per leader — autonomy for strategically strong leads, structured cadence and oversight for execution-focused leads — while keeping accountability unambiguous.
* **Engagement & cadence —** Run rewards & recognition, leadership offsites and an engagement cadence that keeps a globally distributed, crisis-exposed 24×7 operation motivated and audit-ready.

**͏Requirements / Pre-requisites Required for the Role**
--------------------------------------------------------

**1. Educational Qualification Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Hospitality/Travel Management
* MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification in Business/Operations (strongly preferred).
* Industry credentials valued: IATA-accredited agency operations exposure, GBTA/CCTE certification, ISO 31030 familiarity, GDS (Sabre/Amadeus) proficiency.

**2. Work Experience Required**

* 18 - 22 years of total experience in Airlines/Travel management Companies with a minimum of 8 years heading a global corporate travel and/or hospitality function for a large multinational (75,000+ employees or $75M+ managed travel spend).
* Demonstrated P&L ownership of a travel operation — ideally an in-house or hybrid TMC — including GDS economics (PCC, fare filing, corporate fare codes/RBDs, PLB, segment income), BSP settlement, and airline/hotel commercial negotiation at named-account level.
* Proven hotel programme leadership: global RFP cycles, LRA and value-add contracting, guest-house or serviced-accommodation operations, and hospitality SLA management.
* Hands-on leadership of enterprise booking-platform estates (SAP Concur or equivalent OBT, pre-trip approval workflows) and MICE/group-travel operations, including platform automation programmes.
* Proven delivery of duty-of-care/travel-risk frameworks with real-time traveller tracking, and of M&A travel integration onto common platforms.
* Track record of quantified outcomes — travel cost reduction of 15%+ on comparable portfolios, SLA performance sustained through geopolitical crisis events, and measurable adoption gains on self-booking.
* Experience in India-headquartered global environments with GST-compliant travel contracting knowledge is a strong advantage.

**3. Behavioural Competencies**

* **Strategic & commercial acumen —** Treats travel as a business with retained-income economics, not a cost centre — commercial instinct on fare structures, supplier incentives and the in-house TMC value stack.
* **Executive presence —** Communicates impact-forward at CEO/CHRO/CXO level; builds the evidence case for the operating model rather than asserting it; makes the team's work visible.
* **Data-driven decision-making —** Builds decisions on baselines, targets and audited evidence; insists on discovery and ground-truth input before design; resists anecdote-led decision-making.
* **Judgement under competing goals —** Balances policy enforcement with traveller experience deliberately — knows when soft controls with downstream governance beat hard stops.
* **Change & transformation leadership —** Leads AI adoption personally; converts operational leaders into AI-literate operators; distinguishes automation opportunity from platform replacement.
* **Organisational savvy —** Navigates organisational boundaries (procurement, security, finance, IT) with political sensitivity — protecting functional ownership of partner management while remaining collaborative.
* **Resilience & crisis command —** Calm, decisive crisis command — proven ability to run 24×7 travel operations through geopolitical disruption, system outages and mass rebooking events while holding SLAs.
* **Integrity & governance mindset —** High integrity in a supplier-facing, incentive-rich domain.
