title: Sourcing Specialist
description:
**What's Ditto?**

Ditto’s mission is to help people make well-informed insurance decisions - from expert advisory and policy purchases to dedicated claim support. We pioneered the industry’s first “No-Spam” policy, challenging traditional insurance approaches and putting customer trust first. Over the past five years, we’ve helped 700,000+ people make personalized decisions on health and term insurance, earning a 4.9/5 rating from 32,000+ reviews on Google.

Ditto is part of the Finshots family (500K+ subscribers) and is backed by Zerodha, India’s largest stockbroker. We were also recognized as LinkedIn’s Top Startup in India in both 2022 and 2023.

**The Context**

Ditto is scaling fast. Our advisory team alone hires at high volume, and we're opening up roles across marketing, ops, tech, and specialised regional and multilingual hiring.

The bottleneck at this scale isn't screening candidates. It's finding them — reaching the right people in markets where the obvious channels don't work, and building pipelines that consistently deliver on tough briefs.

That's what this role owns.

**The Role**

You'll own sourcing across multiple positions — advisory bulk hiring at scale, non-advisory specialised hiring, regional and multilingual pipelines. You'll report into the HR team and work closely with hiring managers across departments.

Some examples of what you might own:

* **Bulk regional pipelines —** build the sourcing engine for Tamil-, Telugu-, or Kannada-speaking advisor hires — where LinkedIn and Naukri don't get you all the way, and you need to find channels that do.
* **Specialised non-advisory hiring —** source for niche roles in marketing, ops, or tech where the candidate pool is small and passive engagement matters more than volume.
* **Agency management —** onboard and manage recruitment agencies as an extension of the sourcing function — with real accountability on quality, not just volume.
* **Talent mapping —** build competitor and market maps for recurring and strategic hires, so we're not sourcing cold every time.

Whatever the role, you own the sourcing end-to-end — from strategy to first response.

**How This Role Evolves**

Excel at sourcing and other TA roles open up over time — TA Lead, specialised ownership of bulk-hiring or non-advisory hiring, lateral moves as the function grows. That's not the point of the role, it's what tends to happen when the craft is real. If your plan is to escape sourcing as fast as possible, this isn't the right role.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4–6 years of hands-on sourcing, with real ownership of bulk or high-volume mandates.
* Strong craft — Boolean, X-ray, LinkedIn advanced search, passive candidate outreach. The sourcing toolkit at working depth, not surface-familiar.
* Experience sourcing across channels beyond LinkedIn and Naukri — regional portals, communities, referrals, agencies. You know where different candidate profiles actually live.
* Comfort managing recruitment agencies as an extension of your own sourcing. You communicate the spec, hold partners to quality, and know when to push back.
* Enough analytical range to read funnel data and diagnose what's not converting.
* Bias toward finding talent where others can't. That's the muscle we're hiring for.

**A note on what this role is not**

This is not a coordination or scheduling role. If you want to run interview logistics and calendar management, this will frustrate you. It's not a role where you hand mandates to agencies and wait for callbacks — you're doing the sourcing yourself, at scale. And it's not for someone whose plan is to get out of sourcing as fast as possible. The craft is the job. If you do it well, other TA roles open up — but only because you were great at sourcing first.

**Why Join Ditto**

* Real ownership of a sourcing function at a company scaling hiring significantly.
* A TA team that's building forward, not maintaining what exists.
* Direct visibility into how a growing company gets built — you're the first conversation many joiners have with Ditto.
* Craft compounds. Great sourcing here sets you up for the TA roles that open up as we scale.
* A company where the mission is genuinely lived — a 4.9 Google rating from 30,000+ users tells its own story.

**Perks**

* Comprehensive health and term insurance.
* Compensation as per industry standards.
* Learning allowances and growth opportunities.

**Our Interview Process**

We want to respect your time. There are 4 rounds, and we aim to complete all of them within 3 weeks.

**The schedule:**

* 1. Introductory call with HR

* 2. Task / Assignment (3 business days from receipt)

* 3. Task presentation + Case discussion with the Hiring Manager

* 4. Founders round

**This is an in-office role. Our address is: Fortuna-1, No 680, 15th Cross, J.P Nagar 2nd Phase, J P Nagar, Bangalore South – 560078, Karnataka, India.**

*Please Note: Beware of recruitment scams. Ditto does not charge any fees at any stage of the hiring process. If you receive any suspicious message claiming to be from Ditto, please verify through our official channels.*

DLP Triage & Processing · Own the end-to-end triage lifecycle for DLP alerts across endpoints, cloud environments (M365, Google Workspace, AWS), and email — from initial alert review through disposition and escalation. · Classify and prioritize incidents by sensitivity, intent, and potential business impact; apply consistent triage frameworks to ensure efficient and defensible case handling. · Identify policy gaps, false-positive patterns, and emerging exfiltration vectors; recommend DLP policy refinements to reduce risk while minimizing friction for legitimate business activities. · Maintain accurate, timely case records in the case management system, ensuring chain-of-custody integrity for all evidence. Investigations · Lead and conduct end-to-end investigations of potential insider risk incidents — including IP theft, data exfiltration, policy violations, sabotage, and pre-departure data staging. · Collect, preserve, and analyze digital evidence from endpoint forensics, cloud storage, communication platforms, and HR systems in accordance with legal and evidentiary standards. · Produce comprehensive, well-structured investigation reports documenting findings, timelines, impact assessments, and recommended actions suitable for legal, HR, and executive audiences. · Manage multiple concurrent active investigations with rigor, discretion, and appropriate urgency. Subject Interviews · Plan and conduct structured subject interviews in coordination with Legal, HR, and business leadership — applying established interview methodologies tailored to insider risk contexts (e.g., cognitive interviewing, motivational interviewing). · Conduct witness interviews to gather corroborating information and context; document findings with accuracy and impartiality. · Maintain composure and objectivity in sensitive, adversarial, or emotionally charged interview settings; protect subject dignity while gathering actionable intelligence. Legal Collaboration & Case Adjudication · Partner closely with Legal and Employment Law to ensure investigations comply with applicable labor laws, privacy regulations, and evidentiary standards across all operating jurisdictions (U.S., India, Israel, EU, and Asia-Pacific). · Present investigation findings, evidence packages, and risk assessments to Legal and HR for case adjudication — including decisions on disciplinary action, civil litigation, criminal referral, or administrative closure. · Support the preparation of materials for regulatory inquiries, litigation holds, and law enforcement cooperation when required. · Track and document case dispositions and lessons learned to continuously improve program policy and legal defensibility. Threat Intelligence & Risk Program Development · Develop and maintain an insider threat intelligence capability — tracking threat actor TTPs relevant to the semiconductor industry, including economic espionage, nation-state recruitment, and supply chain manipulation. · Produce threat intelligence products (briefings, advisories, risk reports) for security leadership, HR, and business unit heads to inform enterprise risk decisions. · Monitor the external threat landscape, including geopolitical developments, export control changes, and industry-specific threat reporting from CISA, FBI, and

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Skill Requirement :** Required · 7+ years of progressive experience in insider threat, corporate investigations, counterintelligence, digital forensics, or a closely related security discipline. · Demonstrated expertise with DLP platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Symantec DLP, Forcepoint, Zscaler) including policy tuning, triage workflows, and incident adjudication. · Proficiency with SIEM platforms (XSIAM, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalent) and UEBA/UAM tools for behavioral analysis and anomaly detection. · Hands-on experience conducting complex civil or corporate investigations — from initial tip through evidence collection, interviews, reporting, and legal referral. · Experience conducting structured subject interviews and witness interviews in a corporate or law enforcement context. · Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Legal, HR, IT, and senior leadership in a highly confidential environment. · Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical audiences. · Demonstrated knowledge of applicable privacy and employment laws across multiple jurisdictions (particularly U.S., EU GDPR, and Asia-Pacific regimes). · Hands-on experience operating AI-powered insider risk or UEBA platforms — including use case configuration, cohort/module development, and risk score tuning — with a clear understanding of how AI-assisted detection outputs translate into investigation workflows. Preferred · Prior experience in the semiconductor, defense technology, or critical technology sectors with heightened awareness of IP protection. · Experience in or with federal law enforcement, intelligence community, or military counterintelligence. · Background in threat intelligence production (STIX/TAXII, indicator management, adversary TTP analysis). · Familiarity with digital forensic tools (EnCase, FTK, Cellebrite, or equivalent) and e-discovery platforms. · Experience with SOAR platforms and automation of investigation workflows. · Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK; for Enterprise and Insider Threat frameworks. · Experience using generative AI / LLM tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate investigative analysis, summarize case evidence, draft reports, or build detection logic. · Familiarity with the ethical, legal, and governance considerations of deploying AI in a workforce monitoring context, including explainability requirements and bias mitigation. Education & Certifications · Bachelor\'s degree in Cybersecurity, Criminal Justice, Intelligence Studies, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree a plus. · Relevant professional certifications valued: CISSP, CISM, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CFCE, EnCE, CCITP (CERT Insider Threat Professional), or equivalent.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Other Requirement :** You think like an investigator AND a data analyst — equally comfortable in a boardroom briefing and deep in SIEM query language. You harness AI as a force multiplier — you know how to configure detection use cases, build meaningful cohorts, and tune behavioral modules without losing sight of the human judgment that makes investigations defensible. You operate with impeccable judgment and discretion — you understand that access to sensitive data and AI-assisted monitoring is a privilege with strict ethical obligations. You are proactive, not reactive — you identify and reduce risk before incidents occur. You build trust across organizational boundaries — Legal trusts your evidence, HR trusts your process, and business leaders trust your judgment. You thrive in ambiguity and complexity — insider risk rarely comes neatly packaged, and you know how to structure uncertainty into defensible conclusions.

Core Mission
  
  
The Enterprise Applied AI Solution Specialist is a hands-on engineer who builds and deploys practical AI solutions that improve internal workflows and employee productivity. The role focuses on implementing agentic and Generative AI features using established patterns, grounded in enterprise knowledge and data.
  
  
This individual partners closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into usable, reliable capabilities while operating within enterprise constraints such as security, governance, and user trust. The position is ideal for a builder who ships, iterates quickly, and continuously improves solution quality through feedback and measurement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
This is a delivery-focused role combining hands-on implementation with light product ownership and operational discipline.
  
  
1. Applied Solution Delivery & Iteration (65% of time)
  
Build and enhance AI-powered features (e.g., copilots, summarization, classification, routing, Q&A) aligned to defined business workflows.
  
Partner with business users to clarify requirements, run demos, capture feedback, and iterate toward measurable outcomes.
  
Support pilot launches, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to smooth adoption through user training and clear documentation.
  
  
2. Knowledge-Based Agents & Conversational Design (25% of time)
  
Develop agents grounded in the company’s internal knowledge base, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns and retrieval quality improvements.
  
Design conversational flows for internal functions (e.g., HR helpdesk), including intent handling, escalation paths, and handoff to human support when needed.
  
Implement simple agentic or predictive models for operational use cases (e.g., predicting customer support ticket volume) under guidance from senior engineers.
  
  
3. Product Execution, Quality & Documentation (10% of time)
  
Manage the feature backlog for an AI product area: write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and coordinate UAT.
  
Contribute to evaluation and regression testing using approved checklists; help monitor quality, latency, and cost for deployed features.
  
Create and maintain documentation (how-to guides, runbooks, and user enablement materials) to support long-term sustainability.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
3+ years of experience in software engineering or applied solutions development (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Proficiency in Python and API-based integration; working knowledge of SQL and data access patterns.
  
Working familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  
Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and the ability to implement tool/function calling patterns.
  
Basic understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and data governance requirements; ability to follow established guardrails and escalate risks early.
  
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Ideal Candidate Profile: Who Thrives in This Role
  
Builders Over Theorists: You enjoy shipping working software and iterating based on user feedback.
  
User-Centered Mindset: You like sitting with users, mapping workflows, and improving day-to-day productivity.
  
Pragmatic Technologist: You choose simple, reliable approaches and adopt new techniques when they clearly improve outcomes.
  
Quality-Driven: You care about correctness, safety, and operational reliability, and you follow established production standards.
  
Continuous Learner: You stay current on rapidly evolving GenAI capabilities and apply them responsibly.
  
Generous Collaborator: You document clearly, communicate proactively, and work well across teams.

title: Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations
description:
Join our Global Workforce Systems team as an Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations and quickly expand your Workday knowledge through hands-on experience. You will manage JIRA tickets, process routine Workday transactions, maintain accurate employee data, and support process documentation. We are looking for someone with one to two years of Workday experience who is curious, careful, and committed to delivering accurate results.  
  
This is a regular, full-time position based in Bangalore, India and requires a work schedule that provides coverage during core U.S. business hours.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the first level of review and support for HRIS and Workday requests submitted through JIRA, ensuring requests are acknowledged, assessed, and appropriately routed.
* Support the day-to-day management of the JIRA ticket queue by reviewing new tickets, prioritizing routine requests according to established guidelines, monitoring aging items, updating statuses, and following up as needed.
* Evaluate incoming tickets for completeness, urgency, business impact, dependencies, and appropriate next steps.
* Resolve routine Workday questions, requests, transactions, and data issues using established procedures and documented solutions.
* Proactively request missing information or clarification when a ticket does not contain sufficient details to investigate or complete the request accurately.
* Escalate complex, high-risk, time-sensitive, or unresolved issues to the appropriate HRIS team member with clear documentation of the issue, troubleshooting performed, supporting information, and recommended next steps.
* Maintain complete and timely JIRA documentation, including the original request, investigation performed, actions taken, stakeholder communication, decisions, and final resolution.
* Monitor open tickets and dependencies and proactively follow up when information, approvals, testing, or action is outstanding.
* Identify tickets at risk of missing established service expectations or deadlines and escalate appropriately.

**What You Bring**

* Hands-on experience reviewing or processing employee data and transactions in Workday.
* Experience using JIRA or a comparable ticket/case-management platform, including reviewing, assigning, prioritizing, documenting, tracking, escalating, and resolving support requests.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a ticket queue independently, balance competing priorities, and follow requests through to resolution.
* Experience creating or maintaining workflows, process documentation, SOPs, job aids, or knowledge articles.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially inaccurate information.
* A proactive approach to work, including the ability to identify outstanding actions, anticipate potential issues, and follow up without waiting for direction.
* Strong problem-solving and investigative skills with the judgment to distinguish between issues that can be resolved independently and those requiring escalation.
* Ability to follow detailed procedures while recognizing opportunities to improve existing processes.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tickets, recurring responsibilities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical or process-related information in a way that is understandable to different audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across teams, locations, and time zones.
* Ability to appropriately handle confidential employee and organizational information.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Experience supporting Workday Core HCM and one or more related areas such as Recruiting, Benefits, Compensation, Talent, Absence, or other employee lifecycle functionality.
* Experience with JIRA-based HRIS support operations, including queue management, ticket prioritization, escalation, and reporting.

Job Description: HR & Operations Manager

**Company:** Sujays Dental Care **Job Title:** HR & Operations Manager **Department:** HR & Practice Operations **Reports To:** Managing Director / Lead Dentist / Practice Owner **Location:** On-site (Bengaluru, India) **Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

Sujays Dental Care is seeking a dynamic, multi-faceted **HR & Operations Manager** to bridge staff management and daily clinical operations. In this dual-function role, you will be responsible for building a high-performing clinical and support team while optimizing daily clinic workflows, patient experience, vendor management, and facility standards. This role requires an operational mindset combined with strong people management skills to ensure our practice runs smoothly, profitably, and in compliance with healthcare standards.

Roles and ResponsibilitiesHuman Resources Management

* **Talent Acquisition & Staffing:** Lead end-to-end recruitment for associate dentists, dental hygienists, assistants, front office staff, and billing personnel.
* **Onboarding & Credentialing:** Manage the onboarding process and maintain updated credentialing files (Karnataka Dental Council registrations, certifications, health records).
* **Employee Relations & Culture:** Address employee queries, resolve interpersonal conflicts between clinical and administrative teams, and foster a patient-first team culture.
* **Performance & Development:** Conduct performance reviews, manage KPIs for non-clinical staff, and organize mandatory infection control, patient care, and customer service training.
* **Payroll & Benefits:** Oversee attendance, leaves, shift rosters, incentive calculations, and coordinate with accounting for timely monthly payroll processing.

Practice & Operational Management

* **Daily Clinic Workflows:** Oversee front-desk operations, patient flow, appointment scheduling, and appointment follow-ups to minimize wait times and maximize schedule efficiency.
* **Inventory & Procurement:** Manage dental supplies, clinical instruments, office consumables, and vendor relationships to control costs and prevent stockouts.
* **Facility & Maintenance:** Ensure the clinic environment meets safety, cleanliness, and hygiene standards; oversee biomedical waste management and equipment maintenance contracts.
* **Patient Experience & Quality Assurance:** Monitor patient feedback, address grievances, and refine operational processes to continuously raise care and service quality.
* **Compliance & Administrative Standards:** Ensure full compliance with healthcare regulations, local labor laws, clinic health & safety protocols, and bio-waste management rules.

Key Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in HR, Healthcare Management, Business Administration (MBA or MHA preferred).
* **Experience:** 4–8 years of experience in HR and operations, preferably in healthcare, dental clinics, hospitals, or multi-specialty medical centers.
* **Key Skills:**
* Dual expertise in team management and operational/facility workflows.
* Strong leadership, conflict resolution, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with Dental Practice Management Software, HRIS, and MS Office.
* Vendor negotiation, inventory management, and basic financial acumen

* Communicate a compelling AI and technology\-enabled change agenda, helping senior leaders understand the “what, so what, and now what” of opportunities to improve productivity, strengthen capabilities, and support business growth.

**Change Leadership**

**Thought Leadership**

* Serve as a senior subject matter expert on Digital Products, Data Platforms, Artificial Intelligence and Asset Management technology, partnering with business, technology and platform leaders to shape future\-state capabilities.

**Change Leadership**

* Influence enterprise\-wide change agendas by providing expertise on business process transformation, platform modernization, digital adoption, and organizational effectiveness.

**Capability Expansion:**

Promote an inclusive, collaborative, and growth\-oriented culture that supports innovation, engagement, and career development across diverse teams.

* Proven track record of leading transformational change initiatives and driving adoption across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proven ability as a proactive hands\-on leader and people manager to effectively drive and execute to high standards across a diverse and increasingly complex book of business.
* Ability to build authentic and high\-performing teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, and strong partner engagement.
* Strong track record of assessing risk, identifying opportunities, communicating solutions, and driving meaningful change.
* Highly organized, detail oriented and results focused individual with a strong track record in managing teams and self to deliver on multiple initiatives both locally and globally.
* Foster an environment which encourages ownership, excellence, employee engagement, teamwork, and communication.

* Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build trusted partnerships, challenge constructively, and drive alignment across complex global organizations.
* Strong understanding of asset management operating models, investment lifecycle processes, operational risk frameworks, data governance, and control environments.
* Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, digital workflow technologies, and data analytics, with the ability to identify and scale practical business use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to assess emerging industry trends, technologies, and best practices and translate them into practical business opportunities and operating model improvements.

description:
Job Description – IT Administrator

**Job Title:** IT Administrator  
**Department:** IT / Administration  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Head of Operations / HR / Management

About the Role

We are looking for a hands\-on **IT Administrator** to manage and support the company’s day\-to\-day IT infrastructure, systems, devices, user access, and IT security.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment and should be able to independently troubleshoot issues, manage IT assets, coordinate with vendors, and ensure employees have the required systems and access to perform their work efficiently.

Key Responsibilities1\. IT Infrastructure \& Support

* Manage day\-to\-day IT operations and provide technical support to employees.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, Wi\-Fi, printer, and other IT\-related issues.
* Maintain office IT infrastructure including routers, switches, access points, printers, UPS, and other equipment.
* Monitor system and network performance and coordinate with service providers when required.
* Maintain proper documentation of IT infrastructure, configurations, and vendors.

2\. Laptop \& IT Asset Management

* Manage the complete lifecycle of company laptops, desktops, monitors, peripherals, and other IT assets.
* Maintain an updated IT asset inventory and asset allocation records.
* Configure and deploy laptops and systems for new employees.
* Ensure proper collection, inspection, and secure wiping of devices during employee exits.
* Coordinate repairs, warranty claims, AMC, and replacement of IT equipment.
* Implement appropriate controls to prevent loss or misuse of company assets.

3\. User \& Access Management

* Create, modify, and deactivate employee accounts and system access.
* Manage access to email, Google Workspace/Microsoft 365, Slack, HRMS, cloud applications, and other business tools.
* Ensure access is provided based on role and business requirements.
* Immediately revoke access for employees leaving the organisation.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and maintain proper access records.

4\. IT Security

* Implement and maintain basic IT security controls across company systems.
* Ensure laptops and systems have appropriate antivirus/endpoint protection and security updates.
* Support password, MFA, device security, and access\-control practices.
* Monitor and report suspicious activities, security incidents, or unauthorised access.
* Work with external cybersecurity vendors/consultants when required.
* Conduct periodic security awareness initiatives for employees.

5\. Vendor \& Service Provider Management

* Coordinate with internet service providers, hardware vendors, software vendors, and IT support partners.
* Evaluate quotations and assist with procurement of IT equipment and software.
* Track IT contracts, AMC, warranties, subscriptions, and renewals.
* Ensure timely resolution of vendor\-related issues.

6\. IT Policies \& Documentation

* Develop and maintain IT policies, SOPs, and guidelines.
* Maintain records for IT assets, software licenses, user access, and IT incidents.
* Support implementation of company policies related to information security and acceptable use of IT resources.
* Assist HR and management during employee onboarding and offboarding.

7\. Backup \& Business Continuity

* Ensure appropriate backup processes are implemented for critical company data and systems.
* Periodically verify backup availability and restoration processes.
* Support disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

Onboarding \& Offboarding

The IT Administrator will work closely with **HR and department heads** to ensure:

**Employee Onboarding**

* Laptop/system allocation
* Email and application account creation
* Access provisioning
* Basic IT orientation
* Asset acknowledgement

**Employee Offboarding**

* Disable all user accounts and access
* Recover laptops and IT assets
* Transfer/secure company data
* Revoke application and cloud access
* Update asset and access records

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **2–5 years of experience** in IT administration, IT support, or system administration.
* Strong knowledge of Windows/macOS operating systems.
* Good understanding of networking, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365\.
* Experience in laptop/device and IT asset management.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity and endpoint security.
* Good vendor\-management and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and resolve issues quickly.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with an early\-stage/startup environment.
* Experience managing cloud\-based applications and SaaS tools.
* Knowledge of MDM solutions such as Google Endpoint Management, Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or similar.
* Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure/GCP.
* Familiarity with IT security frameworks and best practices.
* Experience implementing IT policies and access\-control processes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* IT issues resolved within defined timelines.
* System and network uptime.
* Accurate IT asset inventory.
* Timely onboarding/offboarding access management.
* Timely renewal of IT licenses and subscriptions.
* Reduction in recurring IT issues.
* Compliance with IT security policies.
* Employee satisfaction with IT support.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **hands\-on, proactive, organised, security\-conscious, and comfortable taking ownership** of the company's IT operations. The person should be able to work independently, prioritise multiple requests, and build scalable IT processes as the organisation grows.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Chief of Staff & Executive Assistant to Founder & CEO
description:
**Designation:** **Chief of Staff \& Executive Assistant to Founder \& CEO**
============================================================================

**Location:** Bengaluru, India — Hybrid / primarily office\-based
  

**Reports to:** Founder \& CEO
  

**Experience:** Ideally 6–10 years
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time
  

**Working Hours:** India\-based role with **daily overlap with U.S. business hours,**

**This role is based in Bengaluru but is specifically designed to provide daily overlap with U.S. working hours.**

A typical work schedule is expected to be approximately:


**3:00/4:00 PM IST to 12:00/1:00 AM IST**

**About Organisation:**

We are a fast\-growing healthcare technology company building technology\-enabled virtual care solutions for specialty medical practices in the United States.


Our platform helps specialty practices deliver scalable care outside the clinic through virtual care programs, patient engagement, technology, clinical workflows and AI\-enabled solutions.


As our organisation continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional **Chief of Staff \& Executive Assistant to the Founder \& CEO** , based in Bengaluru.


This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.


The person will work closely with the Founder \& CEO across company strategy, leadership coordination, board preparation, customer initiatives, product priorities, hiring, business analysis and day\-to\-day CEO\-office operations.


The right person will become a trusted extension of the CEO.


**The Role**
============

The primary objective of this position is simple:


**Make the CEO and the organization significantly more effective.**

The role combines two responsibilities:


### **Executive Leverage**

Help the CEO manage time, information, communication, meetings, travel, priorities and follow\-through.


### **Chief of Staff / Business Execution**

Help translate CEO priorities into action across the company, coordinate senior leaders, drive strategic initiatives and prepare the CEO for important decisions.


Becauserimarily operates in the United States, this role will be based in Bengaluru but will operate substantially during overlapping U.S. business hours.


This is an important part of the position.


The person should expect to work with the CEO and U.S. leadership team **every working day** , rather than simply joining occasional evening calls.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1\. Run the CEO Office**
--------------------------

Create a disciplined operating system around the CEO.


Maintain a clear view of:


* · CEO priorities
* · Key decisions
* · Delegated items
* · Follow\-ups
* · Important relationships
* · Upcoming meetings
* · Customer commitments
* · Board commitments
* · Strategic initiatives
* · Recruiting priorities
* · Important deadlines
* Nothing important should get lost.
* Proactively identify what requires the CEO’s attention rather than waiting for instructions.

**2\. Calendar \& Priority Management**
---------------------------------------

* Own and actively manage the CEO’s calendar.
* This is not simply a scheduling function.
* Understand:
* · Why a meeting is required
* · Whether the CEO needs to attend
* · Who else should participate
* · What decision is expected
* · Whether something can be delegated
* · Whether the issue can be handled asynchronously
* Protect the CEO’s time for the highest\-value activities.
* Coordinate meetings across U.S., India and international time zones.

Because this role works daily with the CEO during U.S. hours, the individual should be available to handle real\-time scheduling changes, priorities and issues during the CEO’s working day.


**3\. Daily CEO Coordination**
------------------------------

* Maintain a highly effective daily operating cadence with the CEO.
* This may include:
* · Reviewing priorities for the day
* · Preparing upcoming meetings
* · Identifying decisions required
* · Reviewing outstanding follow\-ups
* · Coordinating with senior executives
* · Tracking delegated actions
* · Surfacing issues requiring CEO intervention
* · Preparing information required for upcoming decisions
* The goal is to develop enough context that the individual increasingly anticipates what the CEO needs before being asked.

**4\. Meeting Preparation**
---------------------------

* Prepare the CEO for important:
* · Leadership meetings
* · Customer meetings
* · Board meetings
* · Investor discussions
* · Candidate interviews
* · Partnership discussions
* · Strategic planning sessions

For significant meetings, prepare concise briefing materials covering:


**Objective**  

Why are we having this meeting?


**Context**  

What does the CEO need to know?


**Decision**  

What decision or outcome is required?


**Issues**  

What are the unresolved questions or risks?


**Recommendation**  

What should we do?


The objective is for the CEO to enter important meetings already prepared.


**5\. Leadership Team Coordination**
------------------------------------

* Work closely with senior leaders across:
* · Product
* · Engineering
* · Finance
* · Sales
* · Operations
* · Clinical
* · Patient Engagement
* · Marketing
* · HR
* Track decisions and commitments made in leadership meetings.
* Follow up with owners.
* Ensure deadlines are met.
* Escalate issues when required.

The candidate must be comfortable following up with senior executives and holding people accountable while maintaining strong working relationships.


**6\. Strategic Projects**
--------------------------

* Take ownership of selected CEO\-led initiatives.
* Examples could include:
* · New product initiatives
* · Market expansion
* · Competitive analysis
* · Pricing strategy
* · Business model analysis
* · Strategic partnerships
* · M\&A opportunities
* · Customer initiatives
* · New business opportunities
* · AI initiatives
* · Organizational projects
* · Executive hiring
* · Operating\-plan initiatives

**8\. Board \& Investor Support**
---------------------------------

Support preparation for board meetings and investor discussions.


Responsibilities may include:


· Coordinating board materials


· Gathering functional updates


· Reviewing presentations


· Preparing CEO talking points


· Tracking board requests


· Managing follow\-ups


· Maintaining important board documentation


The candidate will have access to highly confidential company information and must demonstrate exceptional discretion.


**9\. Executive Communication**
-------------------------------

Help draft and refine communications from the CEO, including:


· Internal emails


· Leadership communications


· Customer communications


· Board communications


· Candidate outreach


· Investor communications


· Meeting summaries


· Presentations


Excellent written and spoken English is essential.


The individual should be able to communicate comfortably with senior U.S.\-based executives, customers, physicians, investors and partners.


**10\. Travel \& Logistics**
----------------------------

Coordinate CEO travel when required, including international travel.


Responsibilities may include:


· Flights


· Hotels


· Ground transportation


· Meeting logistics


· Itineraries


· Schedule coordination


· Last\-minute changes


Travel planning should optimize both business productivity and CEO time.


The individual may occasionally be required to travel within India or internationally.


This allows the individual to:


· Work with the CEO in real time


· Participate in leadership meetings


· Join important customer discussions


· Coordinate directly with U.S. executives


· Respond to issues during the U.S. business day


· Complete follow\-ups while U.S. teams are still online


This is **not an occasional late\-evening\-call requirement** .


Daily U.S. overlap is a normal and fundamental part of the position.


Candidates seeking a conventional 9 AM–6 PM India working schedule should not apply.


At the same time, we expect sustainable working hours. The position should not routinely require both a full Indian workday and a full U.S. workday.


**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Exceptional Organization**
----------------------------

You can manage dozens of concurrent priorities without losing track of details.


**Strong Business Judgment**
----------------------------

You understand what deserves CEO attention and what does not.


You know when to escalate, when to delegate and when to solve something yourself.


**Intellectual Curiosity**
--------------------------

You can quickly understand unfamiliar industries, technologies, financial concepts and business problems.


**High Ownership**
------------------

You naturally think:


**“How do I get this done?”**

rather than:


**“Whose responsibility is this?”**

**Bias Toward Action**
----------------------

You identify problems before they become urgent and proactively resolve them.


**Strong Analytical Ability**
-----------------------------

You are comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets, business metrics and structured problem solving.


**Excellent Communication**
---------------------------

You can communicate comfortably with:


· Senior executives


· Physicians


· Customers


· Investors


· Board members


· Employees


· External partners


**Persistence**
---------------

You are comfortable following up repeatedly when something needs to get completed.


**Low Ego**
-----------

You are equally comfortable preparing a strategic business analysis and fixing a calendar or travel issue.


Neither feels beneath you.


**Discretion**
--------------

You will have access to highly confidential business and personal information.


Trust and integrity are non\-negotiable.


**Ideal Background**
====================

We are deliberately flexible about exact background.


Strong candidates may come from:


· Chief of Staff roles


· Founder’s Office roles


· CEO Office roles


· Senior Executive Assistant roles


· Strategy and operations


· Management consulting


· Investment banking


· Startup operations


· Business operations


· Program management


We expect the strongest candidates to have approximately **6–10 years of professional experience** , although exceptional candidates outside this range will be considered.


A bachelor’s degree is required.


An MBA is helpful but not required.


Experience working directly with **U.S.\-based executives or customers** is highly desirable.


Experience in healthcare, technology, SaaS, startups or U.S.\-focused businesses is useful but not mandatory.


**Important: This Is a Hybrid Role**
====================================

Candidates should clearly understand the nature of this position.


This is **not a pure strategy Chief of Staff role** .


And it is **not a traditional Executive Assistant role** .


**The ideal candidate enjoys both.**

* You may spend one hour helping analyze a new business opportunity and the next ensuring an important CEO meeting gets rescheduled correctly.
* You may help prepare a board presentation, participate in a leadership meeting, analyze a business issue and coordinate CEO travel within the same week.
* You need to be comfortable operating across the entire spectrum.
* AI \& Technology Orientation
* We are building an increasingly AI\-driven company, and we expect the CEO Office to operate the same way.
* You should be highly comfortable using AI and modern productivity tools for:
* · Research
* · Market analysis
* · Competitive analysis
* · Meeting preparation
* · Meeting summaries
* · Document creation
* · Presentation development
* · Data analysis
* · Email drafting
* · Information organization
* · Workflow automation

title: Gen AI Contractor
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



EarnIn's Gen AI Team is on a mission to deliver the best agentic experience for our customers — accurate, fast, and set up for success. At the heart of that mission is Evaluation\-Driven Development (EDD): a closed loop of human judgment and calibrated LLM scorers that lets us ship new chatbot capabilities with confidence, measure performance in real time, and tie every change to business outcomes.



To help us execute on this vision, we are hiring a Gen AI Contractor for the Analytics Engineering Team. This position is based in Bengaluru, India, requires two days a week in\-office as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement starting in January 2027\.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Help build and run evaluations for our LLM\-powered chatbot systems, contributing to our goal of making evals a standard practice across all teams at EarnIn
* Support the design and calibration of LLM\-as\-judge scorers, working closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) to align automated scoring with human ground truth

**Service Delivery \& Operations**

* Oversee end\-to\-end delivery, support, and operational performance of assigned products and platforms.

* Ensure delivery commitments are met regarding scope, quality, timelines, and business outcomes.

**Agile Delivery \& DevOps Leadership**

* Lead and direct Product DevOps Squads to deliver new capabilities and applications using Agile methodologies.
* Support and mentor Managed Service Providers (MSPs) in Sprint\-based delivery and release management practices.
* Leverage ServiceNow Release Management and Project Portfolio Management capabilities to improve delivery outcomes.
* Drive adoption of best practices, automation, and continuous process improvement.

**Program \& Portfolio Management**

* Apply robust programme management principles across assigned product portfolios.
* Manage complex transformation initiatives and workstreams from planning through execution.
* Deliver programmes through strategic partnerships with third\-party vendors and managed service providers.
* Govern project execution using ServiceNow Project \& Portfolio Management tools.

**Enterprise Architecture \& Integration**

* Collaborate closely with the CH CTO Enterprise Architecture team.
* Define and implement enterprise\-wide tooling strategies and architecture frameworks.
* Design large\-scale integrations across platforms, applications, and services.
* Build common tools architectures that enable standardization, automation, and proactive operations.

**Governance \& Reporting**

* Provide management, operational, and technical reporting to leadership teams.
* Monitor platform performance, service metrics, operational health, and programme delivery outcomes.
* Support governance activities and ensure compliance with enterprise standards and policies.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **15\+ years of experience** in Enterprise Service Management, ServiceNow, Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, or related technology domains.
* Proven experience managing and governing enterprise\-scale Service Management platforms in large global organizations.
* Strong experience in delivering complex technology programmes, platform transformations, and large\-scale implementations.
* Expertise in stakeholder management, business partnering, and influencing senior leadership.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams, Agile delivery squads, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs).
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident, Change, Problem, and Service Request Management.
* Experience developing high\-level solution designs, technology roadmaps, and enterprise\-wide architectures.
* Demonstrated experience in large\-scale platform integration and solution delivery.
* Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep technical expertise in the **ServiceNow platform** , including architecture, implementation, and governance.
* Experience with ServiceNow modules such as:



	+ IT Service Management (ITSM)
	+ IT Operations Management (ITOM)
	+ CMDB
	+ Event Management
	+ IT Business Management (ITBM)
	+ Customer Service Management (CSM)
	+ HR Service Delivery (HRSD)
	+ Legal Service Delivery
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist, or Certified Technical Architect certifications.
* Strong enterprise architecture experience, including designing integrated tool ecosystems and automation frameworks.

* Experience using ServiceNow Project \& Portfolio Management (PPM) for programme governance and delivery.
* Exposure to testing and quality management tools such as **AQM** and **TOSCA** .
* Proven ability to drive service modernization, automation, and proactive operations strategies.
* Experience supporting global business functions such as HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and ERP through enterprise service management platforms.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to identify innovative solutions and influence strategic decision\-making.

The team plays a pivotal role in driving digital transformation, service excellence, automation, and operational efficiency across Haleon's technology landscape.

title: Manager - Workday HCM
description:
The Manager, HR Technology is responsible for leading the daily HR Technology operations, SLA compliance, and technical deliverables of the Bangalore\-based support team while serving as an active, hands\-on technical contributor. This role balances people management, coaching, and directing work with active participation and leadership in Workday and other related projects, as well as managing key customers and partnerships.


The ideal candidate possesses a strong leadership background and a broad, versatile configuration skillset across Workday Core HCM and within multiple functional modules. This position is highly operational, focusing on ticket\-queue optimization, process design, global release coordination, and mentoring a team of analysts with varying levels of experience.


Principal Accountabilities:


* Directly lead and inspire the Bangalore\-based HR Technology analyst team, focusing heavily on mentoring, coaching, developing, and actively engaging team members.
* Oversee the daily incoming ticket queues and task assignments for the local team, monitoring SLAs and identifying operational bottlenecks to implement queue management best practices for timely and high\-quality support resolution.
* Serve as the primary on\-the\-ground point of escalation for complex technical issues, troubleshooting, and configuration roadblocks encountered by the team.
* Actively contribute as a hands\-on technical expert by personally resolving high\-impact, tier\-3 support tickets and executing complex configuration changes, testing, and system maintenance within Workday.
* Apply broad configuration expertise across Workday Core HCM, Business Process Framework, Security Groups, and additional modules (such as Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, Absence, Benefits, or Learning) to support business requirements.
* Lead local and global system enhancement initiatives, small\-to\-mid\-sized projects, and configuration rollouts, ensuring all deliverables are executed on schedule and meet compliance standards.
* Partner closely with global HR Tech leadership to align on support priorities, resource planning, and project roadmaps, while overseeing local efforts for automated regression testing and Workday biannual release testing cycles.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to regional and global HR stakeholders, translating business requirements into scalable Workday system solutions.

Skills and Software Requirements:


* A minimum of 7 years of hands\-on experience in HR systems, with at least 5 years dedicated specifically to Workday HCM configuration, reporting, security, and support.
* A minimum of 2 years of formal people management or team leadership experience, with a proven track record of supervising direct reports and managing support queues.
* Broad\-based, deep Workday configuration experience; strong functional knowledge of Core HCM, Business Process Framework, Reporting and Security configuration is required. Practical configuration experience in multiple functional areas (such as Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, Benefits, or Learning) is highly desirable.
* Excellent analytical and diagnostic skills within a complex, multi\-module Workday environment.
* Outstanding interpersonal and business communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build strong, collaborative partnerships across global time zones.
* Strong organizational skills and experience managing multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Platform Engineer Contractor
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join EarnIn's Platform Services team for an internship building AI\-powered solutions that directly impact our Platform Infrastructure. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work across two connected workstreams — reducing platform toil and accelerating delivery for every engineer at EarnIn — under the guidance of senior platform engineers. This position is based in Bengaluru, India, with two days a week in\-office required as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement with a start date in January 2027\.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Build components of the AI First Responder agent — an automated on\-call triage system that integrates Datadog, Incident.io, and Slack — including agent tooling, evaluation harnesses, and integration workflows.
* Contribute to the IaC migration away from Terraform Cloud — refactoring Terraform modules, cleaning up policies, and building migration scaffolding that clears tech debt and accelerates platform delivery.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) throughout both workstreams to develop applied AI skills in a real infrastructure context.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and well\-documented code that lasts beyond the internship.
* Collaborate with engineers across the Bengaluru and Mountain View Platform teams; present your work and learnings to the broader team.
* Shadow incident triage and on\-call workflows to build context on production operations (no on\-call responsibilities).


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university
* Experience with Python, Go, or another backend language — coursework or personal projects count.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), containers (Docker), or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts (Terraform, Kubernetes); classroom or personal\-project experience counts.
* Eagerness to learn and actively use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow — this is a core expectation, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Comfort working in a Linux/CLI environment and with Git\-based version control.
* Ability to communicate progress proactively, ask good questions, and document your work clearly.
* Self\-starter mindset — you take initiative, seek feedback, and iterate quickly; moderate guidance is a plus.
* Prior internship or project experience in platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or site reliability is a plus.
* Familiarity with Datadog, PagerDuty, or similar observability and incident\-management tools is a plus.
* Experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) or building agent\-style workflows in a project context is a plus.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or Helm in any environment (lab, personal cluster, coursework) is a plus.


\#LI\-Hybrid

  

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. This role works closely with HR Knowledge Owners, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Knowledge Authors, HR Service Delivery teams, and HRSD Superusers to manage the complete knowledge lifecycle.

* Manage Knowledge Structure in ServiceNow: Maintain the functional organization of HR knowledge within ServiceNow HRSD, partner with the ServiceNow platform team on required technical configuration, and ensure content is structured consistently for easy discovery by employees and HR agents.

description:
Job Summary
  
The HCM Systems Analyst – Dayforce is a hands\-on configuration role responsible for building, configuring, maintaining, and optimizing the organization’s Dayforce HCM platform across Core HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance/Workforce Management, Recruiting, Performance, Compensation, and Learning.
  
This role serves as a functional and technical Dayforce resource, partnering with HR Operations, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Learning, HR Business Partners, IT, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective and scalable system solutions.
  
The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on Dayforce configuration experience and is comfortable independently researching issues, building solutions, testing changes, troubleshooting complex problems, and continuously improving the platform within a complex, global HCM environment.
  
Primary Duties and Responsibilities
  
* Configure, maintain, and optimize Dayforce modules, including:
* Core HR / People
* Payroll
* Time \& Attendance / Workforce Management
* Recruiting
* Performance Management
* Compensation
* Learning
* Build and modify Dayforce configuration, including workflows, forms, approval processes, eligibility rules, business rules, security roles, notifications, and other system functionality.
* Translate business requirements into effective Dayforce solutions while considering system scalability, usability, data integrity, and downstream impacts.
* Partner with HR and Payroll teams to design and implement system enhancements and process improvements.
* Troubleshoot complex system, configuration, and data issues; identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support configuration and system administration for recurring HR processes, including payroll, performance reviews, compensation cycles, recruiting activities, learning programs, and employee lifecycle events.
* Perform impact analysis, configuration, testing, and validation for system changes, enhancements, releases, and new functionality.
* Develop and execute test scenarios and support user acceptance and regression testing.
* Monitor Dayforce releases and product updates, evaluate potential impact, and recommend opportunities to leverage new functionality.
* Maintain system security and role\-based access in accordance with organizational and data privacy requirements.
* Support Dayforce reporting, data imports and exports, interfaces, integrations, and data validation activities.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity across the HCM platform and assist with identifying and resolving data quality issues.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, simplify workflows, and improve the employee and manager experience.
* Maintain system configuration documentation, process documentation, and change records.
* Provide technical and functional support to HR system users and assist with training and knowledge transfer as needed.
* Partner with Dayforce Support and external vendors to research and resolve product or configuration issues when necessary.
* Participate in HCM projects, implementations, integrations, acquisitions, and other HR technology initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders and team members across multiple countries and time zones.


Education and Certification
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
* Dayforce certifications are preferred.
* Additional HR technology, payroll, project management, or systems certifications are an advantage.
* Equivalent combinations of education and relevant hands\-on Dayforce experience will be considered.


Competencies, Skills and Experience
  
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience configuring, administering, and supporting Dayforce in a complex organizational environment.
* Strong Dayforce configuration experience across multiple modules; experience with Core HR and Workforce Management is strongly preferred, with experience in additional modules such as Payroll, Recruiting, Performance, Compensation, and Learning highly valued.
* Experience supporting a global or multi\-country HCM environment preferred.
* Ability to independently configure and troubleshoot Dayforce rather than relying primarily on vendor or implementation partner resources.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and the employee lifecycle, including organizational management, employee data, payroll, time and attendance, recruiting, performance management, compensation, and learning.
* Strong systems\-thinking skills and the ability to understand upstream and downstream impacts of system, process, and data changes.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
* Experience with system testing, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and change management.
* Knowledge of HCM integrations, data imports and exports, APIs, reporting, and data structures preferred.
* Understanding of HR data security, role\-based access, and data privacy principles.
* Ability to translate business needs into clear functional and system requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and system integrity.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with a high degree of independence.
* Demonstrated curiosity and resourcefulness, with the ability to research unfamiliar functionality and develop solutions independently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within global, cross\-functional teams.
* Flexibility to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple time zones.
