description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.



A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."



* Location
Bengaluru
* Employment type
Full Time Permanent
* Department
People \& HR
* Deadline
2026\-09\-21

  
Candidate profile (title) Who you are
Candidate profile (text) \- Default language You are an experienced P\&C professional with minimum 7\+ years who enjoys working with people, processes and data – and understands how important accuracy, compliance and empathy are in People Services. You bring solid expertise in HR and personnel administration, including payroll\-related processes, taxation and legal requirements, and you feel confident working with HR systems and tools (such as Success Factors, Service Now, Global View or equivalent) as well as Microsoft Office.
  

  

You are comfortable taking ownership of your tasks and working independently, while also valuing collaboration and diverse perspectives. You express your ideas openly, listen carefully to others and make thoughtful, well balanced decisions. You are reliable and ready to step up when challenges arise – someone your team can depend on.
  

Clear communication and active listening come naturally to you. You are a collaborative team player who works towards shared goals and builds positive relationships with ease.
  

  

You like structure and clarity, and you understand the value of following established processes step by step to ensure high\-quality outcomes. At the same time, you are curious and persistent: when something doesn’t look right, you take the time to investigate, understand the root cause and resolve issues thoroughly and accurately.
  

You feel confident navigating in complexity and at the same time organizing data and managing documentation in a clear and structured way is your natural talent.
  

  

You have a problem solving mindset and act quickly when action is needed. You learn from experience and proactively introduce improvements, controls or safeguards to prevent issues from recurring. You enjoy out of the box thinking and drive ideas that support continuous improvement.
  

  

You think end to end, understanding how your work impacts colleagues, stakeholders and the wider organization. You are comfortable working with KPIs, supporting service quality and leading initiatives that deliver meaningful results. You enjoy taking responsibility and are motivated by achieving and exceeding agreed goals.
  

  

You care about your growth, understand what you look for in your career journey, actively develop and learn continuously. You are self aware, open to feedback and keen to build your expertise further.
  

  

Australia HR operations process experience is mandate. This role requires you to have a strong knowledge of Success Factors, Service Now or equivalent applications. ADP Global View Knowledge is an added advantage.
  

  

This role is situated within Bangalore and will report directly to the GBO People Services Team Leader or GBO People Services Manager in India.
  

Also, this role requires to work in 5:30 am to 2:30 pm shift timing to support Australia Customers on a rotational basis and it is a hybrid model of 3 days working from office per week.
Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us
Key responsibilities (text) As part of the People Services team, you will play a key role in delivering end to end People Services for co workers, line managers and P\&C partners supporting Australia. Your work ensures that personal data is handled with care, accuracy and confidentiality – from employment contracts and employee changes to payroll related records and reporting.
  

You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across HR and GBO, contributing to reliable operations and a positive co worker experience.
  

  

You will be responsible for:
  

* Undertake responsibility in your area of competence to deliver high\-professional, accurate, timely, compliant and consistent services according to KPIs and SLAs
* Ensure that Personnel Administration / Payroll processes are in line with global processes/directions, legal and taxation standards, country specific requirements and comply with legislative obligations and internal auditing requirements
* Entering payroll and personal data into Success Factors/Other HR Systems according to the documents received on time, and according to the procedures
* Accountable to perform analysis on the special issues, annual issues, and periodic issues.
* Provide support to local P\&C units in all Personnel Administration and Payroll related topics
* Committed responsibility during the implementation of new initiatives, programs, policies and services and the integration and transition of HR transactional processes from different IKEA countries into GBO
* Monitor the quality of services in your area of responsibility and partner with other internal and external departments and HR locations to improve customer satisfaction
* Actively involved in coaching and developing Junior co\-workers
* Assume responsibility for other tasks and projects assigned.
* Accept and perform additional tasks delegated by team leader.
Team vision ( title) About this work area
Team vision (text) Global Business Operation (GBO) is a function within the IKEA Group of companies. We work with transactional services in the field of Finance and HR. We deliver our services through our regional hubs, located in Poznan, Shanghai, Bangalore and Baltimore. To provide professional, service minded, support to the core business – that’s our business! To secure best practice, efficient end\-to\-end HR administration processes from the co\-worker, line manager \& HR unit to GBO for service delivery. Working together to achieve IKEA performance goals by freeing the business to focus on the core objectives
### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home\-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.  

  

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co\-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.  

  

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.
### **What we all have in common**


* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing \& delivering while learning \& developing
* Having fun!

title: Senior HR Partner, Amazon International Stores and G&A
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon, HR Partners are known for their deep knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as front\-line talent consultants to the business, supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They offer credible and compelling advice to business managers on how to manage their team. HR Partners collaborate with HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees across the region. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them at scale, in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The Senior HR Partner (Sr. HRP) collaborates with business managers to support them with sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Sr. HRPs drive scalable process improvements and standardization at a country, regional as well as global level. The Sr. HRP is expected to work with global HRPs and COE functions to drive WW HRP goals and initiatives.  

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases, including process steps, coaching and guidance to deliver fair and high\-bar performance management experience.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR Generalist: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience and change initiatives.


This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives.  

  

Job is open for Bangalore and Hyderabad locations**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of HR generalist, management, or business partner role experience
* Knowledge of HR, HR management, organizational development concepts
* Experience in problem solving and delivering results

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
* Experience managing time efficiently, meeting personal goals, and working effectively with internal, partner, and customer teams
* Experience delivering complex, data\-driven recommendations to senior leaders
* Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience managing teams

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Lead, Business Continuity Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Lead, Business Continuity Manager (APAC Location)**

**Location**


Bangalore / Pune

**Position Summary**


The Lead, Business Continuity Management (APAC Location) is responsible for the development, implementation, governance, testing, and continuous improvement of Business Continuity Management (BCM).


This role serves as the primary APAC focal point for technology continuity planning while partnering with global technology teams, infrastructure organizations, cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business units, and regional regulators. The incumbent will ensure that critical technology services can withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptive events while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regional regulatory requirements.


The role requires balancing regional execution with global alignment, ensuring APAC\-specific risks, regulatory obligations, and operational requirements are effectively incorporated into the enterprise resilience framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Continuity Strategy \& Governance**

* Lead the APAC Technology Business Continuity Program.
* Develop and maintain regional technology continuity and resilience strategies aligned with global frameworks.
* Ensure regional BCM practices are aligned with enterprise risk management standards and global technology policies.
* Establish governance forums, metrics, reporting, and executive dashboards for continuity and resilience programs.
* Support annual reviews of continuity policies, standards, procedures, and recovery strategies.

**Continuity Planning \& Preparedness**

* Develop, maintain, and govern Technology Business Continuity Plans (BCPs).
* Ensure recovery plans exist for critical platforms, infrastructure services, applications, and technology processes.
* Coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments across APAC technology functions.
* Assess dependencies involving third\-party vendors, cloud service providers, and critical technology partners.
* Maintain inventories of critical services, applications, recovery strategies, and recovery objectives.

**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience Testing**

* Coordinate disaster recovery testing programs across APAC technology teams.
* Manage tabletop exercises, simulation exercises, crisis management drills, and failover testing activities.
* Validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
* Track remediation of gaps identified through testing and post\-incident reviews.
* Produce executive summaries and lessons\-learned reports following exercises.

**Operational Resilience**

* Support identification and mapping of Important Business Services (IBS) and technology dependencies.
* Assess resilience vulnerabilities across people, process, technology, facilities, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Assist in establishing impact tolerances and resilience performance measures.
* Support enterprise operational resilience initiatives and regional regulatory requirements.

**Crisis Management \& Incident Response**

* Support technology crisis management and major incident response activities.
* Participate in regional command centers during significant incidents.
* Coordinate communications, issue escalation, decision tracking, and recovery governance during disruptions.
* Facilitate post\-incident reviews and corrective action plans.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary APAC liaison between global BCM teams and regional technology leadership.
* Partner with:


	+ Infrastructure Engineering
	+ Cyber Security
	+ IT Operations
	+ Technology Risk Management
	+ Enterprise Risk
	+ Corporate Services
	+ Business Units
* Provide guidance and coaching to technology teams regarding continuity planning requirements.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**

* CBCP (Certified Business Continuity Professional)
* MBCI (Member, Business Continuity Institute)
* ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
* PMP
* ITIL

**Experience**

* 8\-12 years of experience in Business Continuity Management, Disaster Recovery, Operational Resilience, Technology Risk, or Technology Operations.
* Minimum 3\-5 years managing continuity programs within a technology organization.
* Experience supporting large\-scale global technology environments.
* Experience managing regulatory, audit, and risk management engagements.
* Financial services experience preferred but not mandatory.

**Technical Knowledge**


Strong understanding of:

* Business Continuity Management (BCM)
* Disaster Recovery (DR)

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking
* Executive Communication
* Stakeholder Influence
* Risk\-Based Decision Making
* Program Management
* Problem Solving
* Cross\-Cultural Leadership
* Collaboration Across Global Teams
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**Success Measures**


The role will be measured by:

* Completion and quality of APAC continuity plans.
* Regulatory and audit outcomes.
* DR testing completion and success rates.
* Reduction in continuity\-related risk exposure.
* Timely closure of resilience remediation activities.
* Executive and regulatory reporting quality.
* Recovery readiness for critical technology services.
* Alignment of APAC resilience practices with global standards.

**Scope of Responsibility**

* Regional ownership of Technology BCM and Operational Resilience for APAC.
* Coordination with global continuity and recovery teams.
* Support for technology operations spanning multiple APAC countries and time zones.
* Influence across infrastructure, application delivery, cyber security, and technology operations teams.
* Participation in executive crisis management and major incident governance.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 \- all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors \- including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is an exciting opportunity to be a foundational member of Rippling’s IT Implementation team!
   

  

 As an Implementation Specialist, IT you will partner with our largest customers (US and Global). You will be working with our customers’ IT departments to understand their requirements and guide/train them to adopt our Apps, Devices, Identity, and Inventory Management Solutions. You will manage an evolving book of business and be the internal go\-to for all things related to Rippling’s IT solution.
   

  

 The IT implementation team at Rippling is growing, along with our focus on our IT solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to not only work with our largest customers but also work cross\-functionally to improve our product, adoption, and customer experience for IT.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Become an expert on Rippling’s IT offering\- You’ll be a go\-to resource for our clients within 30 days and an IT subject matter expert for your Rippling colleagues within 60 days.
* Be a trusted implementation partner to our clients:
* 
+ You’ll need to understand the client’s current technology requirements as it relates to Rippling.
+ You’ll need to guide the customer to install and adopt Rippling’s IT solutions
+ You’ll need to train the customer on Rippling IT products
+ You’ll work closely with Implementation and the rest of the Customer Experience organization to ensure the client is set up for success.

* Partner with our Solutions Consulting, Implementation, and Product teams to evolve our process and product
* Develop and document IT implementation processes and best practices.


**What You Will Need**
* A passion and curiosity for all things related to IT
* 4\+ years of experience managing an IT set\-up at a company, helping customers implement IT products, or selling IT solutions. This role requires a strong understanding of the below:

+ Fleet Management, UEM, RMM, MDM, device and identity provisioning, Zero Touch, and Endpoint Lifecycle Management. Familiarity with other IT products such as Google, Azure and Okta.

* Strong project management and organizational skills: high attention to detail with excellent time management skills.
* Ability to manage client relationships: strong communication and presentation skills
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by a fast\-paced environment and excited to build

title: HR Operation Specialist
description:
**Join Our Journey at VuNet**
=============================


**VuNet** is a pioneer in *Business Journey Observability*, leveraging Big Data and Machine Learning to transform digital experiences across the financial services. Our deep\-tech platform provides end\-to\-end visibility into customer journeys — empowering proactive issue resolution, operational resilience, and superior user satisfaction.


If you’ve ever used instant payment systems like UPI, chances are you’ve already experienced the power of our platform — we monitor over *28 billion digital transactions monthly*(that’s equal to watching 3 years of tik\-tok videos)**,** *touching 300 million users* with leading banks and financial institutions*.*


VuNet is Series B funded, part of NASSCOM DeepTech Club, awarded NASSCOM’s AI Gamechanger, recognized in Forbes DGEMS 200 and by several global analysts including Gartner, Omdia.


We’re building a new category of observability purpose\-built for complex digital journeys — across payments, lending, core banking and more — already powering some of the largest banks in India and MEA.


**Your Role: HR Operation Specialist**
======================================

We are looking for an **HR Operations Specialist** to manage and execute day\-to\-day HR operations while ensuring a seamless employee experience, accurate HR data, statutory compliance, and timely delivery of HR processes.


The role will work closely with employees, managers, Finance, IT, Administration, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of employee lifecycle processes. The ideal candidate should be detail\-oriented, process\-driven, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple HR operations simultaneously.


Are you excited to be a part of VuNet's trailblazing team? Join VuNet and make a difference


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


### **1\. Employee Lifecycle Operations**


* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, employee documentation, transfers, confirmations, and exits.
* Ensure joining formalities, documentation, background verification, and HR system updates are completed within defined SLAs.
* Maintain accurate and updated employee master data and personnel records.
* Coordinate with IT and relevant stakeholders to ensure system and access readiness on the employee’s date of joining.
* Ensure timely completion of exit formalities, clearance, documentation, and HR\-related separation activities.

### **2\. Payroll \& Compensation Operations**


* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and ensure accurate and timely submission within payroll cut\-off timelines.
* Validate attendance, leave, loss of pay, new joiner, exit, salary revision, and other payroll\-related inputs.
* Coordinate with Finance/payroll vendors to resolve payroll discrepancies and employee queries.
* Support compensation\-related activities including salary revisions, arrears, reimbursements, and other employee compensation processes.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of payroll and compensation data.

### **3\. Statutory Compliance \& Risk Management**

* Support HR statutory compliance activities and ensure required records are maintained accurately.
* Coordinate compliance requirements related to **POSH, Form D, LWF**, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, declarations, and supporting documentation for audit readiness.
* Coordinate with external consultants/vendors for statutory compliance requirements and resolution of queries.
* Support internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.

### **4\. HRIS, MIS \& Data Governance**

* Maintain accurate employee information in the HRIS/HRMS and ensure timely updates for employee movements and changes.
* Prepare and publish periodic HR MIS, dashboards, headcount reports, and management reports.
* Maintain HR trackers, employee records, MOMs, and operational reports with high accuracy.
* Ensure HR data confidentiality, access control, and appropriate handling of sensitive employee information.
* Support HRIS enhancements, system upgrades, testing, and implementation of new HR processes/modules. Identify data inconsistencies and ensure timely correction

### **5\. Employee Experience \& HR Service Delivery**

* Act as a point of contact for employees on HR operational queries related to policies, payroll, attendance, leave, benefits, HR processes, and documentation.
* Resolve employee queries within defined SLAs and maintain proper query tracking.
* Provide clear, accurate, and consistent guidance on HR policies and processes.
* Identify recurring employee concerns and recommend improvements to HR processes.
* Maintain a professional and service\-oriented approach while handling employee interactions.

### **6\. Employee Engagement**

* Support planning and execution of the annual/monthly employee engagement calendar.
* Conduct new\-joiner pulse checks and coordinate periodic employee feedback initiatives
* Coordinate monthly celebrations, employee activities, team engagement initiatives, and cross\-functional events.
* Work with employee engagement SPOCs to plan and execute activities effectively.
* Track participation, feedback, and outcomes of engagement initiatives.
* Support initiatives focused on employee connect, collaboration, and workplace culture.

### **7\. Talent Acquisition Support**

* Support campus and fresher hiring activities including coordination with colleges, candidates, interview panels, and internal stakeholders.
* Provide recruitment coordination support for lateral hiring across functions.
* Schedule interviews, coordinate feedback, maintain recruitment trackers, and ensure timely candidate communication.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and interview panels to ensure smooth movement of candidates through the hiring process.
* Support recruitment documentation, offer coordination, and pre\-joining activities.
* Contribute to improving candidate experience and hiring turnaround time.

### **8\. Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**

* Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing HR processes and recommend practical improvements.
* Develop, review, and maintain HR SOPs, process documents, checklists, and operational guidelines
* Support automation and digitization initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time.
* Ensure adherence to defined HR processes and controls.
* Support periodic process reviews and implementation of corrective actions arising from audits or operational reviews.

### **9\. Administration \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate procurement of supplies required for employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Manage procurement and distribution of office stationery and HR\-related supplies.
* Raise and track purchase orders/requests and ensure timely delivery of required items.
* Coordinate with vendors and monitor service quality, cost, timelines, renewals, and payments.
* Maintain vendor records and support periodic vendor performance reviews.
* Coordinate procurement of e\-stamp/e\-stamp\-related documentation and agreements through relevant banking/vendor channels.
* Maintain appropriate documentation for administrative purchases and vendor transactions.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**
==============================

### **Mandatory Skills**


* Strong understanding of **HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle Management**
* Good knowledge of **Payroll, Attendance \& Leave Administration**
* Working knowledge of **HR statutory compliance**
* Experience with **HRMS/HRIS and HR data management**
* Strong **MIS and Excel/Google Sheets** skills
* Good stakeholder and employee management skills
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
* Good written and verbal communication
* Ability to manage confidential employee information
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills
* Process\-oriented and solution\-focused approach
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Good understanding of employee engagement and HR processes

**Preferred Experience**
========================


* 6 Months \- 3 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Generalist, HR Shared Services, or a similar role.
* Experience working in a **technology/product/SaaS organization** will be an advantage.
* Hands\-on experience with an **HRMS/HRIS**, payroll coordination, employee lifecycle processes, and HR MIS.
* Exposure to statutory compliance, employee engagement, recruitment coordination, and administration is preferred.

**Key Success Metrics**
=======================


### **Success in this role will be measured through:**

* Timely and accurate employee lifecycle execution
* Payroll input accuracy and adherence to payroll cut\-offs
* Statutory compliance and audit readiness
* HRIS/data accuracy and timely MIS reporting
* Employee query resolution within defined SLAs
* Successful execution of engagement initiatives
* Recruitment coordination and hiring turnaround
* SOP/process improvements and reduction in manual effort

**Why Join Us?**
================


This role offers an opportunity to work across **HR Operations, Employee Experience, HRIS, Compliance, Talent Acquisition, Engagement, and Administration**, providing broad exposure to the complete HR function in a growing organization.


**What We Offer**
=================

### **Life at VuNet: Building the Future Together**


At VuNet, we’re building a world\-class observability platform, proudly **Made in India —** and we're just getting started.


We’re a team of passionate problem\-solvers who love tackling complex challenges. We learn fast, adapt quickly, and stay curious — especially when it comes to exploring and staying ahead of the curve with emerging technologies likeGen AI**.**


More than just a tech company, VuNet is a place where collaboration, learning, and innovation are part of everyday life. We believe in working together, taking ownership, and growing as a team.


If you’re looking to work on cutting\-edge technology, make a real impact, and grow with a supportive team — you’ll feel right at home at **VuNet**.


**Benefits For You**
--------------------


* Health insurance coverage for you, your parents, and dependents.
* Mental wellness and 1:1 counselling support.
* A learning culture that promotes growth, innovation, and ownership.
* Transparent, Inclusive, and high\-trust workplace culture.
* New Gen AI and integrated Technology workspace.
* Supportive career development programs to expand your skills and enhance expertise with various training programs.

**The Opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to creating a sustainable energy future through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. We are looking for a Compensation \& Benefits Analyst to join our Global HR Services team and play a critical role in delivering compensation and benefits support across multiple geographies.


In this role, you will partner with HR teams, business leaders, employees, and external vendors to ensure the efficient administration of compensation programs and employee benefits. You will be responsible for supporting key annual compensation processes, maintaining data accuracy within Workday, providing insightful reporting and analytics, and ensuring a high level of service delivery to stakeholders worldwide.


This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain global exposure while working on complex compensation programs, incentive plans, salary reviews, and benefits administration. You will collaborate with colleagues across regions, contribute to process improvements, and help drive operational excellence within a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


As part of a high\-performing HR Services organization, you will leverage analytical thinking, digital tools, and process expertise to enhance employee experience, ensure compliance, and support strategic business objectives. If you are detail\-oriented, customer\-focused, and passionate about compensation and benefits, this role provides an exciting platform for professional growth and impact.


**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentive (STI) programs, Long\-Term Incentive (LTI) programs, scorecards, and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
* Administer compensation programs across multiple countries and regulatory environments while maintaining compliance with company policies and local requirements.
* Maintain, validate, and monitor compensation\-related employee data in Workday, ensuring data integrity and accuracy across HR systems.
* Generate standard and ad hoc compensation reports, analytics, and insights to support global and regional stakeholders in decision\-making.
* Coordinate and support regional and global employee benefits programs, including vendor management and service delivery activities.
* Manage end\-to\-end compensation transactions, including data validation, calculations, approvals, and payout readiness through established workflows and systems such as ServiceNow.
* Ensure delivery of compensation services in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), maintaining high standards of quality, turnaround time, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) to ensure process consistency and compliance.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service excellence.
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and global teams while leveraging digital and analytical tools to improve productivity and decision\-making.

**Your Background**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in HR Shared Services, Compensation Operations, or Compensation \& Benefits Administration within a global organization.
* Hands\-on experience supporting compensation programs, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentives (STI), Long\-Term Incentives (LTI), salary administration, and compensation reporting.
* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday, including compensation data management, reporting, and process administration.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of PowerPoint, Power BI, and other digital reporting tools.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders across different functions and geographies.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Experience supporting employee benefits administration and vendor coordination is preferred.

**More About Us**

At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure. We foster an inclusive and collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and continuous learning is supported.


Joining our team means working alongside talented professionals across the globe while contributing to meaningful work that supports employees and business success. We offer opportunities for career growth, global exposure, and professional development in an environment built on integrity, safety, and respect.

You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. title: Senior Specialist - Identity & Access Management (PAM))
description:
**Job Description :**

**About us:**


With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.


Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.


Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more

 **About the Function:**


Digital \& Technology (D\&T) is transforming how Diageo works, from how we source ingredients to how we connect with customers and consumers around the world.


This is where data, technology and creativity come together to solve real business challenges and unlock new opportunities. Whether it’s building platforms, using data to drive decisions or shaping digital experiences, the work here has tangible impact across every part of our business.


You’ll be part of a team that’s constantly learning, experimenting and pushing boundaries, with the freedom to explore new ideas and the support to turn them into reality.

**About the role**


The IAM Senior Specialist is responsible for engineering, administration, governance, and continuous improvement of the Saviynt CPAM privileged access management platform. The role owns CPAM configuration, privileged account onboarding, credential vaulting, session monitoring, credential rotation, request and approval workflows, and operational control effectiveness across server, cloud, database, application, and high\-risk identity environments.


The role is CPAM\-first and requires a strong Identity \& Access Management and cyber security mindset. Knowledge of Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Azure RBAC, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, and wider Microsoft Entra security controls is advantageous, but the primary accountability is Saviynt CPAM and privileged access governance.


Context and Scope  

Within Digital \& Technology, the Identity \& Access Management function secures access to business\-critical systems, directories, privileged accounts, administrative roles, service accounts, and digital identities across the enterprise. The organisation already uses Saviynt IGA capabilities for identity lifecycle management of privileged access, and this role will strengthen the CPAM layer that controls, monitors, governs, and evidences privileged access activity.


The role partners with security, infrastructure, cloud, database, application, HR, audit, managed service providers, and vendor teams to design, implement, support, and improve privileged access services that are secure, scalable, resilient, and audit ready.


Key Accountabilities  

1\. Saviynt CPAM Product Engineering and Administration  

* Manage day\-to\-day administration, configuration, support, and optimisation of Saviynt CPAM as the enterprise privileged access management solution.
* Configure and maintain CPAM request workflows, approval workflows, privileged roles, access policies, technical rules, email templates, entitlement structures, and operational jobs.
* Configure and support core PAM capabilities including credential vaulting, password checkout/check\-in, credential rotation, session monitoring, session recording, and privileged access policy enforcement.
* Support onboarding and maintenance of privileged accounts across Windows/Linux servers, databases, cloud platforms, applications, service accounts, emergency accounts, and other high\-risk access scenarios.
* Support upgrades, patching, release validation, defect resolution, performance tuning, and product enhancement activities to maintain CPAM reliability and security.


2\. Privileged Access Lifecycle and Saviynt IGA Integration  

* Integrate Saviynt CPAM with Saviynt IGA capabilities to enable end\-to\-end privileged access lifecycle management from request, approval, provisioning, monitoring, certification, and revocation.
* Design and maintain privileged access models aligned to least privilege, Zero Trust, segregation of duties, ownership, business justification, and audit requirements.
* Configure Just\-In\-Time (JIT), time\-bound, emergency, and eligible vs active access models to reduce standing privileges and improve control maturity.
* Define access request patterns, approval chains, privileged role structures, entitlement ownership, recertification requirements, and policy attestation processes.
* Support joiner, mover, leaver, and role\-change scenarios for privileged access in coordination with Saviynt IGA lifecycle processes.


3\. PAM Security Controls, Risk and Compliance  

* Implement and enforce privileged access controls for administrative, shared, local administrator, service, emergency, and high\-risk accounts.
* Drive control improvements across credential rotation, session visibility, break\-glass access, orphaned privileged accounts, dormant privileged access, and privileged access exceptions.
* Produce operational and compliance evidence, dashboards, risk insights, and audit artefacts for internal audit, external audit, cyber assurance, and security governance activities.
* Support access reviews, entitlement recertification, privileged account attestation, and remediation tracking for privileged access domains.
* Apply cyber security principles to identify privileged access risks, strengthen access governance, and reduce exposure from excessive or persistent privileges.


4\. CPAM Onboarding, Integration and Automation  

* Lead or support onboarding of servers, databases, cloud resources, applications, privileged accounts, and non\-human identities into Saviynt CPAM.
* Work with infrastructure, cloud, database, and application teams to define onboarding standards, access models, connectors, policies, session controls, and credential rotation requirements.
* Support CPAM integrations using REST APIs, connectors, JSON, PowerShell, SQL/KQL, Microsoft Graph API where relevant, and other automation techniques.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual provisioning effort, improve request turnaround times, strengthen evidence collection, and increase operational consistency.
* Collaborate with Saviynt and internal engineering teams to assess product gaps, prioritise enhancements, test fixes, and improve the end\-to\-end PAM service experience.


5\. Operational Support and Stakeholder Management  

* Act as the Senior Specialist for Saviynt CPAM\-related incidents, service requests, enhancements, troubleshooting, product guidance, and operational governance.
* Provide technical support for complex CPAM issues across workflow, connector, account onboarding, session management, credential rotation, and access policy areas.
* Work effectively with global stakeholders across security, infrastructure, cloud, application teams, vendors, managed service partners, and audit teams.
* Maintain high\-quality design documentation, operational runbooks, support procedures, standards, knowledge articles, and evidence packs.

 **Experience/skills required:**

* 8\+ years of experience in Identity \& Access Management, cyber security, privileged access management, infrastructure security, or related enterprise security operations.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in Saviynt CPAM configuration, administration, access workflows, privileged account onboarding, access policies, credential vaulting, session monitoring/recording, credential rotation, reporting, and operational troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of PAM concepts including least privilege, JIT access, break\-glass access, password checkout/check\-in, privileged session management, account discovery, local administrator controls, service account governance, and recertification.
* Experience integrating CPAM with Saviynt IGA for privileged access lifecycle management, access requests, approvals, certifications, entitlement ownership, and policy controls.
* Good working knowledge of Active Directory, Windows and Linux server administration concepts, cloud platforms, databases, privileged account types, service accounts, and common administrative access patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with APIs, connectors, JSON, PowerShell, SQL/KQL, Microsoft Graph API where relevant, and automation approaches used in IAM/PAM operations.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust, least privilege, segregation of duties, RBAC, identity lifecycle management, audit evidence, and control monitoring.
* Advantageous: knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID security capabilities including Entra PIM, Azure RBAC, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, Access Reviews, app registrations, enterprise applications, and privileged cloud role governance.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* Proven experience in IAM, PAM, or cyber security engineering with increasing responsibility in a global enterprise environment.
* Saviynt CPAM and/or Saviynt IGA product experience is strongly preferred. Saviynt product certifications are advantageous.
* Relevant certifications are advantageous IAM/PAM/security certifications.

**Leadership and Personal Attributes**
======================================

* Strong identity security and cyber risk mindset, with the ability to challenge access models and identify control gaps in privileged access processes.
* Strong communication and articulation skills, with the ability to explain PAM risks, controls, and technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Highly collaborative and comfortable working across global teams, cultures, time zones, vendors, and managed service partners.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business and security requirements into secure, scalable CPAM solutions.
* Self\-driven, organised, delivery\-focused, and disciplined in documentation, operational governance, audit evidence, and continuous improvement.

**Measures of Success**
=======================

* Saviynt CPAM service remains stable, secure, supportable, and fit for purpose.
* Privileged access is governed through robust lifecycle controls, least privilege, strong auditability, timely certifications, and clear ownership.
* Privileged accounts, server access, database access, cloud access, and emergency access are onboarded into CPAM using consistent standards and documented controls.
* Standing privileged access is reduced through JIT, time\-bound, eligible, and policy\-based access models, and stakeholders view CPAM services as responsive, controlled, dependable, and aligned to cyber security priorities.

**Working with Us**


Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.


We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

  

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.


We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.


Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.


Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*

 ***Recruitment Scam Warning***

*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

title: Lead Process Specialist - HR Policy & Compliance
description:
**About Target**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Our purpose—helping all families discover the joy of everyday life—is brought to life through our values, culture and commitment to our guests, communities and team members.


Joining Target means being part of a culture grounded in care, growth and winning together. We value diverse perspectives, encourage authentic connections and create an environment where every team member can contribute, grow and make a meaningful impact.

**Overview of Target in India**


Target in India is an integral part of Target’s global organization, bringing together more than 5,000 team members in Bengaluru who contribute to enterprise\-wide strategy, technology, data, product, operations and business capabilities.

**About the Team**


Target Human Resources plays a critical role in building the high\-performing, diverse and engaged teams that power Target’s strategy and guest experience. Supporting team members across stores, supply chain and headquarters, HR serves as a strategic partner to the business—shaping organizational capability, strengthening leadership and creating an environment where team members can grow and thrive.

**About this Opportunity** The **HR Policy \& Compliance team** is responsible for supporting compliance with applicable employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies. As a member of the HR Compliance team, you will be responsible for the day\-to\-day execution and administration of assigned statutory and HR compliance activities.


This role will focus on ensuring timely completion of statutory filings, remittances, payments, maintenance of statutory records and registers, resolution of Team Member queries, and accurate compliance documentation. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to support effective and timely compliance execution.


As a Lead process specialist, you'll take the lead in:

**Statutory Compliance Execution**

* Ensure timely and accurate filing of statutory returns, remittance of statutory contributions, and completion of compliance\-related payments within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, returns, challans, certificates, and other compliance\-related documentation as required under applicable laws.
* Maintain and monitor compliance calendars and trackers to ensure timely completion of statutory and internal compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, HR Operations, and other relevant stakeholders to obtain and validate information required for statutory compliance activities.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders and external consultants/vendors to ensure timely completion and closure of assigned compliance activities.
* Support periodic reconciliation and validation of statutory contributions, payments, and related records and identify discrepancies for resolution.

**Provident Fund and Team Member Support**

* Handle Team Member queries related to Provident Fund (PF) and other assigned statutory compliance matters and provide accurate and timely resolution.
* Support PF\-related processes, including contribution reconciliation, remittances, UAN\-related activities, documentation, and resolution of discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Payroll, HR Operations, and relevant stakeholders to investigate and resolve PF\-related issues.
* Escalate complex, sensitive, or high\-risk compliance matters to senior members of the HR Compliance team.
* Manage Compliance mailbox and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure the queries are resolved

**Compliance Records and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date compliance trackers, records, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare compliance MIS, reports, dashboards, and data required for periodic reviews.
* Conduct periodic reviews of compliance records and documentation to identify missing information, discrepancies, or potential compliance gaps and support their resolution.
* Ensure appropriate record retention and organization of compliance\-related documents.

**Audits, Inspections and Regulatory Support**

* Support internal and external audits, statutory inspections, and regulatory inquiries by coordinating and providing required records, data, and documentation.
* Track audit findings and compliance action items and follow up with relevant stakeholders to support timely closure.
* Assist in preparing documentation and information required for responses to regulatory notices and other statutory requirements.

**Process and Operational Support**

* Support the implementation of changes to statutory processes, compliance requirements, and internal procedures under the guidance of senior members of the HR Compliance team.
* Identify recurring process gaps, documentation issues, or operational inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
* Support other HR compliance activities and projects as assigned.

**HR Crisis Management**

* Support the identification and tracking of potential HR crisis scenarios at TII in liaison with relevant stakeholders, including maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date crisis management data, records, and trackers.
* Support the coordination and execution of HR crisis management processes, including timely communication and documentation in accordance with established protocols.
* Maintain and update crisis management records, emergency contact information, and related documentation.
* Support periodic reviews and reporting of HR crisis management data and action items.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Law, or a related field.
* 3–4 years of relevant experience in statutory compliance, HR compliance, payroll, HR operations, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of applicable Indian labour and employment laws and statutory compliance requirements.
* Knowledge of Provident Fund and other employment\-related statutory requirements is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple compliance activities and deadlines.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong documentation, record management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.
* Self\-driven approach, Problem\-solving ability with adherence to deadlines and tight timelines
* Experience in project tracking (setting up a project plan, managing risk and issue logs, reporting, and governance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a corporate environment with established HR and compliance processes.
* Experience with statutory compliance processes, compliance calendars and trackers, reconciliations, reporting, and audit documentation.
* Knowledge of or certification in statutory compliance, labour laws, or HR compliance.
* Hands\-on experience managing PF\-related processes, reconciliations, UAN\-related activities, and Team Member queries.
* Experience coordinating with Payroll, Finance, HR Operations, Legal, external consultants, vendors, or similar cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Exposure to internal/external audits, statutory inspections, or regulatory documentation would be an advantage.

description:

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. **About the role**

The **HRBP Lead – GCC** for India Center provides strategic partnership to the HBS Capability Center Head, India and the x\-functional HBS leadership team in India, contributing to decision\-making and business plans that align with Haleon's ambitions and drive growth. Reporting to the Global HRBL for HBS, the role partners closely with senior business leadership and HR COEs Centres of Excellence (CoEs), and to shape the strategic business and people agenda for HBS in India. The role is accountable for translating business priorities into integrated workforce, talent, organisation, capability, and culture solutions in India center. The role also holds dual responsibility for covering as the HRBP for GFS (Global Finance Services) function, as part of the HBS ecosystem.


**Role Responsibilities**

* Drive the effective implementation of the HBS operating models and organisational design in India, in close partnership with functional HR Partners.
* Translate and embed the overarching strategic workforce and capability plans within HBS in India, and for GFS globally with a particular focus on building digital, data \& AI capabilities and the continuous excellence and end user experience mindset.
* Participate in the Haleon India Leadership forum to drive enterprise agenda for Haleon across entity governance, cross\-business dependencies, risk/legal/compliance oversight, CSR, external stakeholder engagement, reputation and culture in the country.
* Embed and oversee the use of enterprise\-wide performance management frameworks to cultivate a high\-performance culture.
* Act as a trusted advisor and executive coach to senior leaders.
* Drive culture change, acting as a change leader to create a consumer\-first, performance\-oriented, and agile culture.
* Coach leaders and managers to lead inclusively, build team effectiveness, improve manager capability
* Drive the execution and embedding of succession planning and talent pipeline strategies for key senior leadership roles.
* Provide strategic oversight, decision making and governance for complex and high\-risk colleague and industrial relations cases.
* Partner with specialist CoE teams to deliver India centre and GFS projects.

**Essential**

* 14\+ years of experience in a HR Business Partner role or similar strategic HR role, ability to work with autonomy on the HR agenda
* Strategic \& Business Acumen: Strong business and financial literacy, with a deep understanding of the business services model, global market, and competitive context.
* Leadership \& Influence: A trusted advisor and sparring partner with strong influencing, coaching, and relationship\-building skills to guide senior leaders.
* Change Leadership and Agility: Proven skills to lead complex organisational change, ensure effective communication plans, and embed new ways of working.
* Collaboration: An experienced matrix leader who works in an integrated way with CoE and People Services expertise to deliver results.
* Data Literacy: Strong analytical capability and data literacy to inform decision\-making and demonstrate the value of interventions.
* Deep understanding and skill in working with cultural nuances and diverse market labour relations contexts.
* Experience in actively leading digital and AI adoption within HR and the wider business.
* Mindset and Agility – able to navigate complex, ambiguous challenges and find solutions to problems, drawing on a solution focused, growth mindset.

**Preferred**

* Skilled in assessing and developing senior leaders and future potential.
* Global leadership experience

Location – Bangalore

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**Meet Our Team:**
------------------



As a member of an innovative team of IT professionals, you will work closely with talented engineers and product owners across the globe to deploy and support enterprise applications that are used to run our business at Pega. The IT Application Support team plays an important role in helping Pega to grow by ensuring that our enterprise applications are working seamlessly in support of Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, Consulting, HR, Order Management, and IT functions internally as well as for our external stakeholders, clients and partners. We strive for excellence and embrace agile methodologies to achieve it.

**Picture Yourself at Pega:**
-----------------------------



Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role you will \- The Application Support Engineer is a key member of the IT Production Support team. You will execute IT application support and release activities. Envision and support adherence to best practices and standards. You will collaboratively work with other application support Engineers on automation initiatives and collaborate effectively with business users to resolve support issues and improve IT developed business applications.


At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.


We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

**What You'll Do at Pega:**
---------------------------


* Provide exceptional technical support to end users by investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving issues within EBS applications using established support tools and best practices.
* Develop a strong understanding of product functionality and leverage that knowledge to deliver effective client\-focused solutions.
* Monitor application health, stability, and performance to ensure a high\-quality user experience.
* Execute code migrations and operational runbooks in accordance with established deployment and change management processes.
* Communicate proactively with clients and stakeholders on issue status, progress updates, and resolution outcomes.
* Collaborate with senior support engineers or Dev teams to identify root causes, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Respond promptly and professionally to client and engineering escalations, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) for response times, and issue resolution.
* Create and maintain knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and documentation for known issues and solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by recommending enhancements to support processes, tools, and best practices based on operational experience.
* Analyze application logs, system diagnostics, and core files to identify recurring trends, underlying issues, and opportunities for proactive problem prevention.
* You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast\-changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
**Who You Are:**
----------------


* Strong hands\-on experience supporting Pega Infinity applications in a production environment.
* Excellent understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Solid knowledge of production support operations, system monitoring, issue triaging, root cause analysis, and incident resolution.
* Proven ability to analyze, troubleshoot, and debug complex production issues independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
* Flexible to work in rotational shifts, participate in on\-call support, and provide quarter\-end production support as per business requirements.
* Good understanding of databases, SQL queries, data analysis, and integration points with upstream and downstream systems.
* Experience in identifying performance bottlenecks and working with cross\-functional teams to ensure system stability and availability.
* Knowledge of Java\-based applications, services, and integrations would be an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to provide clear, concise, and professional updates to stakeholders and clients.
* Strong client\-facing, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self\-motivated professionals with a strong desire to continuously learn, adapt to new technologies, and improve operational excellence.
* Demonstrated analytical thinking, problem\-solving ability, and attention to detail in a fast\-paced production support environment.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure while meeting service level agreements (SLAs) and business commitments.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-powered tools, Generative AI technologies are an added advantage.
* Ability to leverage AI for incident analysis, root cause identification, knowledge management, operational efficiency improvements, and support process optimization will be highly valued.
* Apply critical thinking to all AI\-generated outputs \- validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in testing and production environments.
**What You've Accomplished:**
-----------------------------


* 3\-5 years of experience in Production Support and troubleshooting to ensure high system availability and timely resolution of critical incidents.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related areas
* Working programming knowledge in Pega Infinity and experience
* Ability to rapidly gain in\-depth knowledge of existing internal applications
* Effective oral and written communication skills, including poise in pressure situations
* Ability to identify, propose and implement solutions.
* Experience in Oracle and/or DB2 and MS/SQL
**Pega Offers You:**
--------------------


* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company.
* The opportunity to make a tangible impact on Pega's business operations and ability to scale.
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices


\#LI\-SJ1


  
**AI in Action – Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment**  

Pega embraces the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve efficiency, consistency, and fairness across our business. We encourage thoughtful and ethical adoption of AI technologies that support people—not replace them. We may use AI‑enabled tools in our recruitment process. These tools are designed to assist us by providing insights and operational support.



All hiring decisions are made based on human review and judgment. You may have the right to request human review, provide additional information, or raise questions about how such tools are used.


**Culture**  

At Pegasystems, we foster an environment where people feel valued and empowered to contribute their best. With global clients across industries and regions, we know our success depends on the unique perspectives, experiences, and talents of our people. Ours is a workplace where everyone can grow, collaborate, and deliver meaningful outcomes.



We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences and focus on the core competencies and mindset needed to thrive in a role.



As an Equal Opportunity employer, Pegasystems will not discriminate in its employment practices due to an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran or disability status, or any other category protected by law.



This same mindset shapes how we work, encouraging curiosity, continuous learning, and smarter ways of working with AI. At Pegasystems, we believe the best ideas come from curious people who embrace change, learn continuously, and use AI to work smarter and move faster. Guided by our values, we bring a growth mindset to every challenge and create lasting impact together.


**Export Compliance**  

For positions requiring access to technical data subject to export control regulations such as this, Pegasystems may need to obtain export license approval from the U.S. Government and EU Authorities for certain individuals.


**Accommodations**  

If you require reasonable accommodations under the Americans with Disabilities Act (US only) or comparable regional regulations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us here or contact (US only) 1\-888\-PEGA\-NOW and/or 225 Wyman Street Waltham, MA 02451 ATTN: Benefits.

title: Director, Employee Relations
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Employee Relations Manager
  
  

About JLL
  
  

**JLL (NYSE:** JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our vision is to reimagine the world of real estate, creating rewarding opportunities and amazing spaces where people can achieve their ambitions. In doing so, we will build a better tomorrow for our clients, our people, and our communities. JLL is a Fortune 500 company with annual revenue of $16\.3 billion, operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce of more than 102,000 as of December 2022\. JLL is the brand name, and a registered trademark, of Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated.
  
  

We are looking for an Employee Relations Manager to join our APAC Employee Relations team. The incumbent will be responsible for addressing employee relations matters ranging from policy violations and interpretations and investigating and resolving employee complaints.
  
  

**Key Accountabilities:**  

Partner with PXPs in investigations and fact finding on Employee Relations issues.
  
Resolve straightforward problems by applying relevant policies, past practices and/or best practices to reach a conclusion.
  
Provide consultation, guidance and coaching to Managers and HR Business Partners to address employee behavior and performance concerns and provide guidance and assist with the development and delivery of appropriate feedback or corrective/disciplinary actions.
  
Track and analyze ER data to identify ER trends, propose and implement improvements.
  
Define, design, and deliver ER solutions on topics including HR policies, disciplinary procedures, working time etc. to ensure compliance with statutory requirements.
  
Maintain required documentation within JLL's case management system including intake and investigation notes, supporting documents and final reports and/or evidence of action taken.
  
Advise on highly complex ER cases/problems by evaluating pertinent information, analyzing findings, and applying relevant Company policies and practices to reach a conclusion.
  
Build organizational capability in managing ER matters by educating managers and HR colleagues in ER processes and practices.
  
Actively participate and provide support in projects developing new ER processes and other HR process improvements.
  
Partner with Legal department as needed to ensure JLL policies and practices are compliant with local laws and regulations.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you need:**  

**Skills and Competencies:**  

TECHNICAL
  
HR system experience preferred (ServiceNow or Workday experience a plus)
  
Excellent ability to gather, synthesize, analyze, and report ER data
  
Sound knowledge and experience of POSH
  
Experience in conducting investigations
  
  

INTERPERSONAL
  
Exceptional written and verbal communications skills
  
Excellence in making independent decisions with a high degree of tact and diplomacy
  
Routine application of collaboration, conflict resolution and negotiation skills
  
Ability to recommend and/or apply appropriate action based on policy/procedure and/or business practice while navigating complexities
  
Effective in exercising good judgment, articulating reasoned rationale for ER recommendations to persuade business partners
  
History of well\-developed integrity and ethical behavior and maintaining confidentiality
  
Ability to maintain neutrality and calm demeanor in tense and conflicting situations
  
  

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  
Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Industrial or Labor Relations
  
Law degree would be preferable
  
5\+ years of Human Resources experience / Employee Relations
  
Must have solid ER case management, investigations, and investigation report writing experience
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we foster an open and collaborative working environment. This environment, combined with the best minds in the business and supported by a platform of cutting\-edge research and new gen technology, ensures that you realise your full potential. If you harbour a passion for learning and are interested in new technologies, JLL will continuously provide you with platforms to enrich your technical domains. It’s no surprise that JLL has been recognized by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the 2022 World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 15th consecutive year.
  
  

Apply today!
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
